example: I would like a cup of tea, please.
example_zh: 请给我一杯茶。

example: You will be paid according to your ability.
example_zh: 你会根据自己的能力得到报酬。

example: No student was able to answer the question.
example_zh: 没有一个学生能回答这个问题。

zh: 副. 大约、四处、在附近；介. 在…周围、大约、有关
example: What about a cold drink?
example_zh: 来杯冷饮怎么样？

zh: 副. 在上面；介. 在上方、超出
example: Above all, I want to see him again.
example_zh: 最重要的是，我想再见到他。

zh: 副. 往国外、到室外、到处
example: Traveling abroad is one of my favorite things.
example_zh: 出国旅行是我最喜欢的事情之一。

zh: 形. 缺席的、不在的、缺乏的
example: That's why I was absent from school yesterday.
example_zh: 这就是我昨天缺课的原因。

zh: 副. 完全地、绝对地、确确实实地
example: The movie was absolutely awful.
example_zh: 那部电影非常糟糕。

example: She has a beautiful French accent.
example_zh: 她有一口好听的法语口音。

example: Of course I accepted his offer of support.
example_zh: 我当然接受了他提供的支持。

zh: 形. 可接受的、合意的、可忍受的
example: Driving after drinking alcohol is not acceptable behavior.
example_zh: 喝酒后开车是不可接受的行为。

example: Every student has free access to the library.
example_zh: 每个学生都可以免费使用图书馆。

zh: 名. 意外事件、机遇、事故
example: We got involved in a traffic accident.
example_zh: 我们卷入了一起交通事故。

zh: 名. 膳宿、预订铺位、适应性调节
example: The hotel has accommodation for one hundred.
example_zh: 这家酒店可供一百人住宿。

zh: 动. 陪伴、伴随、补充、伴奏
example: He suggested that I accompany him to the party.
example_zh: 他建议我陪他去参加聚会。

zh: 介. 根据、按照、取决于
example: The conference went off according to the plan.
example_zh: 会议按计划进行。

example: You need not take account of the fact.
example_zh: 你不必考虑这个事实。

zh: 名. 会计人员、会计师
example: The company took action against its former accountant.
example_zh: 公司对前任会计采取了行动。

example: Give me an accurate report of what happened.
example_zh: 给我一份关于所发生事情的准确报告。

example: I ache for a sight of the sea.
example_zh: 我渴望看一眼大海。

zh: 动. 完成、达到、如愿以偿
example: We must achieve our aim at any price.
example_zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价实现目标。

example: What do you consider your greatest achievement?
example_zh: 你认为你最大的成就是什么？

zh: 副. 交叉、到另一边、在对面；介. 越过、穿过、与…相交叉
example: The flower shop is just across the street.
example_zh: 花店就在街对面。

zh: 动. 扮演、装作、行动、表演
example: She acted as if she knew French well.
example_zh: 她表现得好像很懂法语。

zh: 名. 行动、活动、动作；动. 对…起诉
example: The action took place in a mountain village.
example_zh: 这件事发生在一个山村。

zh: 形. 活跃的、起作用的、积极的
example: Grandfather is still very active for his age.
example_zh: 就他的年龄来说，爷爷仍然非常活跃。

example: The office was full of activity all day.
example_zh: 办公室里整天都很忙碌。

example: The actor came out from behind the curtain.
example_zh: 演员从幕布后面走出来。

example: The actress looks younger than she really is.
example_zh: 这位女演员看起来比她实际年龄年轻。

zh: 副. 事实上、竟然、如今
example: Actually, I didn't know anything about those plans.
example_zh: 其实，我对那些计划一无所知。

example: He ran an ad in the paper.
example_zh: 他在报纸上登了一则广告。

zh: 动. 增加、添加、附带说明、做加法
example: It will not add anything to the situation.
example_zh: 这不会对情况有任何帮助。

zh: 名. 加法、增加的人(或物)
example: We are expecting an addition to our family.
example_zh: 我们期待着家里增添一名新成员。

example: First find out her name and address.
example_zh: 先弄清楚她的姓名和地址。

zh: 动. 赞美、钦佩、爱慕、称赞
example: I admire you for keeping your head.
example_zh: 我佩服你保持冷静。

zh: 名. 准许进入、入场费、录用
example: Admission to the show is by ticket only.
example_zh: 演出凭票入场。

zh: 动. 承认、接受、允许进入、开向
example: The man admitted having broken into the house.
example_zh: 那个男人承认闯入了那所房子。

zh: 形. 成年的、成熟的；名. 成人、成虫
example: That child talks as if he were an adult.
example_zh: 那个孩子说话像个大人。

zh: 名. 前进、进展、行过的路程
example: Our plans are to advance toward the city.
example_zh: 我们的计划是向城市推进。

zh: 形. 在前的、高级的、先进的
example: The price in January advanced 20% year to year.
example_zh: 一月份的价格比去年同期上涨了20%。

example: You have the advantage of a good education.
example_zh: 你的优势是受过良好的教育。

example: I read a book of adventure stories.
example_zh: 我读了一本冒险故事书。

example: There are too many adverts on youtube.
example_zh: YouTube上的广告太多了。

zh: 动. 做广告、通知、公布
example: I think I will advertise in the paper.
example_zh: 我想我会在报纸上登广告。

zh: 名. 广告、启事、广告宣传
example: He cut the advertisement out of the newspaper.
example_zh: 他从报纸上剪下了那则广告。

example: You had better ask the doctor for advice.
example_zh: 你最好向医生征求建议。

zh: 动. 劝告、给…出主意、通知、提意见
example: The doctor advised her to enter the hospital.
example_zh: 医生建议她住院。

example: The aeroplane set off early in the morning.
example_zh: 飞机一大早就起飞了。

example: I was much affected by the sad news.
example_zh: 我深受那条悲伤消息的影响。

zh: 动. 买得起、足以、给予
example: I cannot afford to buy such a thing.
example_zh: 我买不起这样的东西。

zh: 形. 害怕的、恐怕的、遗憾的
example: I was almost afraid to talk to you.
example_zh: 我几乎不敢跟你说话。

zh: 副. 后来；介. 在…之后、由于
example: I will see him after I get back.
example_zh: 我回来后就会见他。

example: The meeting began at five in the afternoon.
example_zh: 会议在下午五点开始。

example: I felt very light on my feet afterwards.
example_zh: 之后我感到脚步非常轻快。

zh: 副. 再一次、又、到原处
example: You have made the very same mistake again.
example_zh: 你又犯了完全相同的错误。

example: We watched England play against France.
example_zh: 我们观看了英格兰队对法国队的比赛。

example: I don’t know his age.
example_zh: 我不知道他的年龄。

zh: 形. 老的、陈的、有…岁的
example: He works hard to support his aged mother.
example_zh: 他努力工作来养活年迈的母亲。

zh: 名. 代理机构、经销商、中介
example: Rosetta was built by the European Space Agency.
example_zh: 罗塞塔号是由欧洲航天局建造的。

zh: abbr. 晚期糖基化终末产物（Advanced Glycation End Products）
example: It took ages for the bus to arrive.
example_zh: 公共汽车过了很久才到。

example: You only started this job an hour ago.
example_zh: 你一小时前才开始这份工作。

zh: 动. 承认、认定、同意、赞成
example: She agreed with him about the holiday plan.
example_zh: 在度假计划上，她同意他的意见。

example: Go straight ahead until you reach the church.
example_zh: 一直往前走，直到你到达教堂。

zh: 名. 目标、瞄准、击中目标的能力；动. 瞄准、对准目标、致力、打算
example: What is the central aim of this plan?
example_zh: 这个计划的中心目标是什么？

example: But for air, all living things would die.
example_zh: 如果没有空气，所有生物都会死。

zh: 名. 用空调设备调节空气、空调设备
example: Our office is very comfortable with air conditioning.
example_zh: 我们的办公室有空调，很舒服。

zh: 名. 空军、美国航空队
example: He wanted to be an Air Force pilot.
example_zh: 他想成为一名空军飞行员。

zh: 名. 航线、航线的设备、航空公司
example: They are a good airline to fly with.
example_zh: 他们是一家很好的航空公司，很适合乘坐。

example: The airport was closed because of the fog.
example_zh: 机场因为大雾关闭了。

example: The news of the accident caused public alarm.
example_zh: 事故的消息引起了公众的恐慌。

example: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

example: You should stick those pictures in your album.
example_zh: 你应该把那些照片贴进你的相册里。

zh: 副. 一样、以同样的方式
example: The father and his son were very alike.
example_zh: 父亲和他的儿子非常相像。

zh: 形. 活着的、活泼的、敏感的
example: The river was alive with fresh water fish.
example_zh: 这条河里满是淡水鱼。

zh: 副. 全部、全然；代. 全部
example: All you can do is trust one another.
example_zh: 你们能做的就是互相信任。

example: Don't worry, everything will be all right.
example_zh: 别担心，一切都会好的。

zh: 动. 允许、同意给予、承认、容许
example: Allow an hour to get to the station.
example_zh: 到车站要预留一个小时。

example: I was almost run over by a car.
example_zh: 我差点被一辆车撞到。

zh: 形. 孤独的、单独的、独自的；副. 独自地
example: It's because you don't want to be alone.
example_zh: 那是因为你不想一个人待着。

example: We can get along very well without you.
example_zh: 没有你我们也能相处得很好。

example: Reading aloud was a great effort for him.
example_zh: 大声朗读对他来说很费力。

example: A is the first letter of the alphabet.
example_zh: A是字母表的第一个字母。

example: You may have read this book already.
example_zh: 你可能已经读过这本书了。

example: Not only you but also I was involved.
example_zh: 不仅你，我也牵涉其中。

example: Although I trusted the map, it was mistaken.
example_zh: 虽然我信任那张地图，但它是错的。

zh: 副. 完全地、总而言之
example: The house was altogether destroyed by the fire.
example_zh: 房子被大火完全摧毁了。

example: This is always the way it has been.
example_zh: 这一直都是这样。

example: The train leaves at nine a.m.
example_zh: 火车上午九点出发。

example: I was not so much scared as amazed.
example_zh: 与其说我害怕，不如说我惊讶。

example: It is amazing that you won the prize.
example_zh: 你得了奖，真令人惊讶。

example: He had the ambition to be prime minister.
example_zh: 他有当首相的雄心。

example: Don't worry. The ambulance will be here soon.
example_zh: 别担心。救护车很快就到。

example: Mr. Children is very popular among young people.
example_zh: Mr. Children 很受年轻人欢迎。

example: What an incredible amount of work he has done!
example_zh: 他做了多得令人难以置信的工作！

zh: 形. 有趣的、引人发笑的
example: I told an amusing story to the children.
example_zh: 我给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。

example: It costs an arm and a leg.
example_zh: 这要花一大笔钱。

zh: 形. 古代的、古老的、年老的
example: I wish I could see the ancient world.
example_zh: 我希望我能看到古代世界。

example: Oh, my white pants! And they were new.
example_zh: 哦，我的白裤子！它们还是新的。

example: I said nothing, and that made him angry.
example_zh: 我什么也没说，这让他生气了。

example: The lion is called the king of animals.
example_zh: 狮子被称为动物之王。

example: He stood ankle-deep in the water.
example_zh: 他站在水里，水没过脚踝。

example: Today we celebrate the 125th anniversary of Esperanto!
example_zh: 今天我们庆祝世界语诞生125周年！

zh: 动. 宣布、声称、显示、当报幕员
example: The result of the election will be announced tomorrow.
example_zh: 选举结果将于明天公布。

example: We should have paid attention to the announcement.
example_zh: 我们本应该留意那个通知。

example: I get annoyed when I am kept waiting.
example_zh: 当别人让我一直等着时，我会很生气。

example: I was annoyed that she was still asleep.
example_zh: 她还在睡觉，这让我很生气。

zh: 形. 每年的、一年一次的、全年的
example: We always look forward to Tom's annual visit.
example_zh: 我们总是期待汤姆一年一次的来访。

zh: 代. 又一个、另一个、类似的另一个
example: I told them to send me another ticket.
example_zh: 我叫他们再给我寄一张票。

zh: 名. 答案、回答、回报；动. 回答、反驳、适应、答应
example: Your question is hard for me to answer.
example_zh: 你的问题对我来说很难回答。

example: Please leave a message on the answerphone.
example_zh: 请在电话答录机上留言。

example: An ant can lift more than 50 times its weight.
example_zh: 一只蚂蚁能举起超过自身体重50倍的东西。

zh: 形. 古老的、古风的、旧式的；名. 古董、古物
example: This antique clock is worth one thousand dollars.
example_zh: 这座古董钟值一千美元。

zh: 形. 忧虑的、发愁的、渴望的
example: Everybody was anxious to know what had happened.
example_zh: 大家都急于知道发生了什么。

example: You are not a child any more.
example_zh: 你不再是个孩子了。

example: It isn't like anybody takes responsibility then anyway.
example_zh: 反正到那时也不会有人承担责任。

example: Having failed four times, he didn't try anymore.
example_zh: 失败了四次之后，他不再尝试了。

example: Anyone with an opinion please raise their hand.
example_zh: 有意见的人请举手。

example: You are welcome to do anything you like.
example_zh: 你想做什么都可以。

example: Anyway, she didn't get what she hoped for.
example_zh: 不管怎样，她没有得到她希望的东西。

example: Curious to say, I didn't find it anywhere.
example_zh: 说来奇怪，我到处都没找到它。

zh: 副. 成零碎、成距离、分别地
example: Apart from the plot, the book interested me.
example_zh: 除了情节以外，这本书让我感兴趣。

example: He is a teacher apart from the rest.
example_zh: 他跟其他人不一样，是个老师。

example: There is an apartment house near my house.
example_zh: 我家附近有一栋公寓楼。

example: They live in a tall apartment building near the park.
example_zh: 他们住在公园附近的一栋很高的公寓楼里。

example: If you're going to apologise, sooner is better.
example_zh: 如果你要道歉，越早越好。

example: I wish to say a word of apology.
example_zh: 我想说一句道歉的话。

zh: 名. 应用、应用程序、相联并行处理器
example: This app will help you improve your English level.
example_zh: 这个应用程序会帮助你提高英语水平。

example: It appears to me that you are right.
example_zh: 在我看来，你是对的。

example: A great man doesn't care about his appearance.
example_zh: 伟人不在乎自己的外表。

example: One of the apples fell to the ground.
example_zh: 其中一个苹果掉到了地上。

zh: 名. 应用、申请、志愿书
example: This method has no application to the case.
example_zh: 这种方法不适用于这个案例。

zh: 动. 涂、应用、申请、适用
example: What you have said doesn't apply to you.
example_zh: 你所说的话不适用于你。

zh: 名. 约会、委任的职位、委派
example: You can meet Dr. White only by appointment.
example_zh: 你只能预约才能见到怀特医生。

zh: 动. 接近、近似、找…商量、靠近
example: My boss told me I'm hard to approach.
example_zh: 我的老板告诉我，我很难接近。

zh: 动. 赞同、核准、为…提供证据、赞许
example: I entirely approve of what you say.
example_zh: 我完全同意你说的话。

example: There are approximately 2 million words in the dictionary.
example_zh: 这本词典里大约有两百万个单词。

zh: 名. 建筑师、设计者、缔造者
example: The architect left his wife after two years.
example_zh: 那位建筑师两年后离开了他的妻子。

zh: 名. 建筑学、建筑式样
example: Talking about music is like dancing about architecture.
example_zh: 谈论音乐就像围着建筑跳舞。

example: What's going on in that area right now?
example_zh: 那个地区现在发生什么事了？

zh: 动. 主张、辩论、证明、提出理由
example: There is no point arguing about the matter.
example_zh: 为这件事争论没有意义。

example: There is a good argument for that decision.
example_zh: 那个决定有充分的理由。

example: The boy can solve any problem in arithmetic.
example_zh: 这个男孩能解决任何算术题。

zh: 名. 手臂、袖子、狭长港湾
example: I think my right arm is broken.
example_zh: 我觉得我的右臂骨折了。

example: He won't let anybody sit in his armchair.
example_zh: 他不让任何人坐他的扶手椅。

example: Our army attacked the enemy during the night.
example_zh: 我们的军队在夜里攻击了敌人。

zh: 副. 兜着圈子、在附近、到处；介. 包围、在…周围、四处
example: There is a bookstore just around the corner.
example_zh: 拐角处就有一家书店。

zh: 动. 安排、排列、达成协议
example: I'd like to learn how to arrange flowers.
example_zh: 我想学插花。

example: Flower arrangement is a traditional art in Japan.
example_zh: 插花在日本是一种传统艺术。

example: The policeman arrested the man on the spot.
example_zh: 警察当场逮捕了那个男人。

zh: 名. 到达、抵达、到达者
example: The party started soon after his arrival.
example_zh: 他到达后不久，聚会就开始了。

example: You had better not start until they arrive.
example_zh: 你最好等他们到了再开始。

zh: 名. 艺术、人文科学、技术
example: Everyone is more or less interested in art.
example_zh: 每个人或多或少都对艺术感兴趣。

example: This article was written by a college professor.
example_zh: 这篇文章是一位大学教授写的。

example: The poor man finally became a great artist.
example_zh: 这个可怜的男人最终成了一名伟大的艺术家。

zh: 连. 当…之时、以…的方式、像…一样；副. 同样地、例如；介. 做为、当作
example: You have the same racket as I have.
example_zh: 你有一个和我一样的球拍。

example: The man was ashamed of being born poor.
example_zh: 那个男人因出身贫穷而感到羞愧。

example: He asked me if I could speak English.
example_zh: 他问我会不会说英语。

zh: 形. 睡着的、长眠的、麻木的
example: On his return he found her daughter asleep.
example_zh: 他回来时发现她女儿睡着了。

example: We must work as long as we live.
example_zh: 只要我们活着，就必须工作。

example: You should buy some cough medicine and aspirin.
example_zh: 你应该买一些咳嗽药和阿司匹林。

zh: 动. 帮助、促进、协助、参加
example: I often assist my sister to do her homework.
example_zh: 我经常帮助我的姐妹做作业。

example: She works as an assistant to the manager.
example_zh: 她给经理当助理。

zh: 名. 太空旅行者、宇航员
example: She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
example_zh: 她将成为第一位日本女宇航员。

example: I like tea, and I like coffee as well.
example_zh: 我喜欢茶，也喜欢咖啡。

example: Look at me when I talk to you!
example_zh: 我跟你说话的时候看着我！

example: My email address is david@gmail.com.
example_zh: 我的电子邮箱地址是 david@gmail.com。

example: I didn't understand anything at all.
example_zh: 我完全没明白。

example: At first sight, he seemed kind and gentle.
example_zh: 第一眼看上去，他显得亲切又温和。

zh: 名. 运动员、运动选手
example: The athlete was full of spirit and confidence.
example_zh: 那名运动员充满斗志和信心。

example: Athletics are an important part of school life.
example_zh: 体育运动是学校生活的重要组成部分。

example: At last, the truth became known to us.
example_zh: 最后，我们知道了真相。

example: The trip will take at least five days.
example_zh: 这次旅行至少要五天。

example: There is a friendly atmosphere in the office.
example_zh: 办公室里气氛很友好。

example: It is necessary that you start at once.
example_zh: 你有必要马上出发。

example: There's very little money coming in at present.
example_zh: 目前进来的钱非常少。

zh: 动. 附上、使依附、使附属、附属
example: You must attach this label to your suitcase.
example_zh: 你必须把这个标签贴在你的行李箱上。

zh: 名. 攻击、抨击；动. 攻击、抨击、动手干
example: A tiger will attack people when it is hungry.
example_zh: 老虎饿了的时候会攻击人。

example: The attempt ended in failure for want of support.
example_zh: 这次尝试因为缺少支持而失败了。

zh: 动. 参加、照料、伴随、专心于
example: I have an urgent matter to attend to.
example_zh: 我有一件紧急的事情要处理。

example: You should pay attention to your well-being.
example_zh: 你应该注意你的健康。

example: At the same time, he began to run.
example_zh: 与此同时，他开始跑了起来。

example: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
example_zh: 尽量对每件事都抱有积极的态度。

zh: 动. 吸引、诱惑、有吸引力
example: Children often cry just to attract attention.
example_zh: 孩子们常常只是为了吸引注意而哭。

zh: 名. 吸引、吸引人的事物、吸引力
example: Detective stories hold a special attraction for me.
example_zh: 侦探小说对我有特别的吸引力。

zh: 形. 吸引人的、有魅力的
example: The walls are an attractive colour.
example_zh: 墙的颜色很好看。

example: The excited audience ran into the concert hall.
example_zh: 兴奋的观众跑进了音乐厅。

example: This doll is a gift from my aunt.
example_zh: 这个娃娃是我阿姨送的礼物。

zh: 名. 作家、作家的著作、创始人
example: The author of this book is still young.
example_zh: 这本书的作者还很年轻。

example: It looks as if autumn is really here.
example_zh: 看起来秋天真的到了。

zh: 形. 可利用的、可获得的、有效的
example: We have little money available for the research.
example_zh: 我们几乎没有钱做这项研究。

zh: 形. 平均的、中等的、平常的；名. 平均、平均数、一般水平
example: At worst, I will get an average mark.
example_zh: 最坏的情况下，我会得到一个平均分。

example: Avoid crossing this street when it is raining.
example_zh: 下雨时避免过这条街。

example: Awake or asleep, she was thinking about it.
example_zh: 不管醒着还是睡着，她都在想这件事。

example: He’s gone away.
example_zh: 他走了。

zh: 形. 引起敬畏的、可怕的
example: It was awesome to meet you in real life!
example_zh: 在现实生活中见到你真是太棒了！

zh: 形. 可怕的、庄严的、虔敬的
example: It's an awful shame your wife couldn't come.
example_zh: 你妻子不能来真是太遗憾了。

example: Look at a baby sleeping in the bed.
example_zh: 看一个在床上睡觉的婴儿。

example: I am supposed to babysit the children tonight.
example_zh: 我今晚要照看孩子们。

zh: 名. 临时照顾幼儿者
example: Mother asked the babysitter to watch the children.
example_zh: 妈妈让保姆照看孩子们。

zh: 名. 背部、后面；副. 向后地；形. 后面的
example: I'll call them tomorrow when I come back.
example_zh: 我明天回来时给他们打电话。

example: No cultural background is necessary to understand art.
example_zh: 理解艺术不需要文化背景。

example: She has a background in teaching.
example_zh: 她有教学方面的背景。

zh: 名. 远足用的背包、双肩背包、背包
example: She is carrying a backpack on her back.
example_zh: 她背着一个背包。

example: Oleg heard scary stories from other backpackers.
example_zh: 奥列格从其他背包客那里听到了吓人的故事。

example: Yanni went on a backpacking trip in Algeria.
example_zh: 雅尼在阿尔及利亚进行了一次背包旅行。

example: The actress fell backwards from the stage.
example_zh: 那位女演员从舞台上向后摔了下去。

example: • (be) bad for somebody.
example_zh: • 对某人有害。

zh: 副. 严重地、恶劣地、极度地
example: I am badly in need of your help.
example_zh: 我非常需要你的帮助。

example: I want to learn how to play badminton.
example_zh: 我想学怎么打羽毛球。

example: Someone has left a bag on the bench.
example_zh: 有人把包落在长椅上了。

example: Please have my baggage brought to the station.
example_zh: 请让人把我的行李送到车站。

example: My mother baked a cake for my birthday.
example_zh: 我妈妈为我的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

example: He set his son up as a baker.
example_zh: 他让儿子当上了面包师。

example: Sure enough, the ghost appeared on the balcony.
example_zh: 果然，那个鬼出现在阳台上。

zh: 形. 秃头的、光秃的、单调的
example: Don't worry too much, or you'll go bald.
example_zh: 别太担心，不然你会秃头的。

example: We'll likely go to the ball game tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们明天可能会去看球赛。

example: Her ambition is to be a ballet dancer.
example_zh: 她的志向是成为一名芭蕾舞演员。

example: Our hot-air balloon rose into the sky.
example_zh: 我们的热气球升上了天空。

example: I have never fed my dog a banana.
example_zh: 我从来没给我的狗喂过香蕉。

example: The band are on tour this month.
example_zh: 这个月乐队在巡回演出。

example: Let me put a fresh bandage on your arm.
example_zh: 让我给你的手臂缠上新绷带。

example: I changed my money in the bank.
example_zh: 我在银行换了钱。

zh: 名. 银行存款、银行往来帐户
example: There's no money left in my bank account.
example_zh: 我的银行账户里没有钱了。

example: I thought you said Tom was a banker.
example_zh: 我以为你说过汤姆是银行家。

example: I was banking on him to help me.
example_zh: 我指望他来帮我。

example: The two men were drinking in a bar.
example_zh: 那两个男人在一家酒吧喝酒。

zh: 名. 烤肉；动. 烤肉、烧烤
example: We often have barbecue parties in our backyard.
example_zh: 我们经常在后院举行烧烤聚会。

example: The barber has cut your hair very short.
example_zh: 理发师把你的头发剪得很短。

zh: 名. 交易、买卖协定、特价商品
example: I didn't bargain for Mary's coming so soon.
example_zh: 我没料到玛丽会这么快来。

example: Almost all Japanese boys like to play baseball.
example_zh: 几乎所有日本男孩都喜欢打棒球。

example: The story is based on his own experience.
example_zh: 这个故事是根据他自己的经历写的。

example: The family is the basic unit of society.
example_zh: 家庭是社会的基本单位。

example: The basin of a river usually has rich farmland.
example_zh: 河流的流域通常有肥沃的农田。

example: Put all your waste paper in this basket.
example_zh: 把你所有的废纸都放进这个篮子里。

example: She is a member of the basketball club.
example_zh: 她是篮球俱乐部的成员。

example: The boy has a bat under his arm.
example_zh: 那个男孩腋下夹着一根球棒。

example: There's only one bath towel in our bathroom.
example_zh: 我们浴室里只有一条浴巾。

example: Don't forget to pack your bathing suit for the holiday.
example_zh: 别忘了带上你的泳衣去度假。

example: Don't leave the bathroom in such a mess.
example_zh: 别把浴室弄得这么乱。

example: He has the water running in the bathtub.
example_zh: 他让浴缸里的水一直流着。

example: The next day the battery was flat again.
example_zh: 第二天电池又没电了。

example: Making a good start is half the battle.
example_zh: 有一个好的开始就成功了一半。

zh: 名. 海湾、狗吠声、月桂
example: The bay is full of boats and people.
example_zh: 海湾里满是船只和人。

example: It would be something I'd have to program.
example_zh: 那将是我必须编程的东西。

example: I am taking a holiday at the beach.
example_zh: 我正在海边度假。

example: A bean can answer all the questions.
example_zh: 一颗豆子能回答所有问题。

example: A bear will not touch a dead body.
example_zh: 熊不会碰尸体。

example: I know that German with a long beard.
example_zh: 我认识那个留长胡子的德国人。

example: We beat about for a solution to the problem.
example_zh: 我们四处寻找解决这个问题的办法。

example: To my surprise, he had a beautiful voice.
example_zh: 令我惊讶的是，他有一副好嗓子。

example: The beauty of the scenery was beyond description.
example_zh: 这景色美得无法形容。

example: You're lucky because he didn't bite you.
example_zh: 你很幸运，因为他没有咬你。

example: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
example_zh: 比赛因为下雨取消了。

example: If you eat too much, you'll become fat.
example_zh: 如果你吃得太多，你会变胖。

example: Sick and tired, she went to bed early.
example_zh: 又病又累，她很早就上床睡觉了。

example: I found myself lying in my bedroom.
example_zh: 我发现自己躺在卧室里。

example: You should pay attention to your well-being.
example_zh: 你应该注意你的健康。

example: The Japanese eat more beef than the British do.
example_zh: 日本人吃的牛肉比英国人多。

zh: 副. 在前；连. 在…之前；介. 在…之前
example: Tell them to call me before they leave.
example_zh: 告诉他们离开前给我打电话。

example: The weather will soon begin to calm down.
example_zh: 天气很快就会开始平静下来。

example: It's dangerous for a beginner to swim here.
example_zh: 对初学者来说，在这里游泳很危险。

example: It's beginning to rain. Please share my umbrella.
example_zh: 开始下雨了，请和我共用我的伞。

zh: 动. 检点(自己的)行为、使表现好、举止端正、行为规矩
example: If you are a student, behave as such.
example_zh: 如果你是学生，就要有学生的样子。

example: Her behaviour isn't normal for a young girl.
example_zh: 她的行为对一个小女孩来说不正常。

zh: 副. 在后地；介. 在…背后
example: He stayed behind in view of possible danger.
example_zh: 考虑到可能有危险，他留在了后面。

example: Whatever you may say, you won't be believed.
example_zh: 无论你说什么，你都不会被相信。

example: The church bell used to ring at three.
example_zh: 教堂的钟过去常在三点敲响。

example: You belong in a better place than this.
example_zh: 你属于比这更好的地方。

zh: 副. 在下面；介. 在下面
example: It's below her to say such a thing.
example_zh: 说这种话有失她的身份。

example: I like the one with a white belt.
example_zh: 我喜欢那个带白色腰带的。

example: The ground lay beneath a blanket of snow.
example_zh: 地面被一层雪覆盖着。

zh: 名. 利益；动. 有益于、受益
example: How can you benefit by being so unpleasant?
example_zh: 你这样让人不愉快，能得到什么好处？

example: The game is over – you’re too late!
example_zh: 比赛结束了——你来晚了！

example: The cat has just passed by beside me.
example_zh: 那只猫刚刚从我旁边经过。

example: Besides being a businessman, he is a musician.
example_zh: 除了是商人，他还是音乐家。

zh: 形. 最好的；副. 最好地
example: That was the best day of my life.
example_zh: 那是我一生中最好的一天。

example: I hope my book becomes a bestseller.
example_zh: 我希望我的书成为畅销书。

zh: 形. 较好的；副. 比较好
example: Now that you are tired, you'd better rest.
example_zh: 既然你累了，你最好休息一下。

example: The church is between my house and yours.
example_zh: 教堂在我家和你家之间。

zh: 介. 超过、在那一边、迟于；副. 在远处
example: The beauty of the sight is beyond description.
example_zh: 这景象美得无法描述。

example: You shall have a bicycle for your birthday.
example_zh: 你过生日时会得到一辆自行车。

example: When we are small, everything seems so big.
example_zh: 我们小的时候，一切看起来都那么大。

example: You're crazy to buy such an expensive bike.
example_zh: 买这么贵的自行车，你真是疯了。

example: Can I have my bill, please?
example_zh: 请给我账单好吗？

zh: 名. (贮存谷物等的)容器、箱子
example: Can you throw the rubbish in the bin?
example_zh: 你能把垃圾扔进垃圾桶吗？

example: He wrote a biography of a famous poet.
example_zh: 他写了一本关于一位著名诗人的传记。

example: He is working in the field of biology.
example_zh: 他在生物学领域工作。

example: I'd rather be a bird than a fish.
example_zh: 我宁愿做鸟也不愿做鱼。

example: This town gave birth to several great men.
example_zh: 这个小镇孕育了几位伟人。

example: It so happens that today is my birthday.
example_zh: 碰巧今天是我的生日。

example: My cat kind of looks like a biscuit.
example_zh: 我的猫有点像一块饼干。

zh: 名. 少量、马嚼子、辅币
example: Let me give you a bit of advice.
example_zh: 让我给你一点建议。

example: I will bite off just a little bit.
example_zh: 我只咬一点点。

zh: 形. 苦的、痛苦的、怀恨的
example: The coffee is too bitter for me to drink.
example_zh: 这咖啡太苦了，我喝不了。

zh: 形. 黑色的；名. 黑色、黑颜料
example: He is the black sheep of the family.
example_zh: 他是家里的害群之马。

example: I found my name written on the blackboard.
example_zh: 我发现我的名字写在黑板上。

example: You have no one but yourself to blame.
example_zh: 你只能怪你自己。

zh: 形. 空白的、空虚的、完全的
example: He asked me point-blank to help him.
example_zh: 他直截了当地请我帮他。

example: Cover up the injured man with this blanket.
example_zh: 用这条毯子盖住那个受伤的人。

zh: 动. 使出血、榨取、流血、悲痛
example: I bleed easily when I am cut.
example_zh: 我被割伤时很容易流血。

zh: 形. 盲目的、瞎的、不加思考的
example: The old man is blind in one eye.
example_zh: 那位老人一只眼睛瞎了。

example: Shall we walk round the block?
example_zh: 我们绕着街区走一圈好吗？

zh: 名. 博客、部落格、网络日志
example: I did the web design for Tom's blog.
example_zh: 我为汤姆的博客做了网页设计。

zh: 名. 写博客的人、博客使用者
example: He's a well-known Algerian blogger.
example_zh: 他是一位著名的阿尔及利亚博主。

example: Her hair is blond and her eyes are blue.
example_zh: 她的头发是金色的，眼睛是蓝色的。

example: It made my blood boil to hear that.
example_zh: 听到那件事让我火冒三丈。

example: Could I have this blouse taken in, please?
example_zh: 请把这件女式衬衫改小一点好吗？

example: It was a great blow to us.
example_zh: 这对我们是一个很大的打击。

zh: 形. 蓝色的、下流的、忧郁的；名. 蓝色
example: The French flag is blue, white and red.
example_zh: 法国国旗是蓝、白、红三色。

example: Dinner will be served on board the plane.
example_zh: 晚餐将在飞机上供应。

zh: 名. 用棋盘玩的游戏
example: We played a board game after dinner.
example_zh: 晚饭后我们玩了一个棋盘游戏。

example: Please have your boarding pass ready. Thank you.
example_zh: 请准备好登机牌。谢谢。

example: You can hire a boat by the hour.
example_zh: 你可以按小时租船。

example: A model must have an attractive body.
example_zh: 模特必须有吸引人的身材。

example: Boil the news down to a hundred words.
example_zh: 把这条新闻压缩到一百个词。

zh: 形. 煮沸的、(非正式)喝醉的、烧滚的
example: I'd like my egg very, very soft boiled.
example_zh: 我想要我的鸡蛋煮得非常非常嫩。

example: I make so bold as to ask you.
example_zh: 我冒昧地问你。

zh: 名. 炸弹；动. 轰炸、投弹于、失败
example: Throw a tear-gas bomb at him.
example_zh: 向他扔一颗催泪弹。

example: I have a bone to pick with you.
example_zh: 我要跟你评评理。

zh: 名. 书、书籍、帐簿；动. 登记、预订
example: You should by all means read the book.
example_zh: 你一定要读这本书。

example: I can't move this bookcase without your help.
example_zh: 没有你的帮助，我搬不动这个书柜。

example: I have a booking for the 19th.
example_zh: 我预订了19号的。

example: Buy your tickets at the booking office.
example_zh: 在售票处买票。

example: Carry these books back to the bookshelf.
example_zh: 把这些书搬回书架。

example: She goes to the bookshop once a week.
example_zh: 她每周去一次书店。

example: He bought an English book at a bookstore.
example_zh: 他在一家书店买了一本英语书。

example: You can bet your boots on that.
example_zh: 那件事你可以打包票。

zh: 形. 无聊的、烦人的、无趣的
example: We got a little bored with each other.
example_zh: 我们彼此有点厌倦了。

zh: 形. 烦人的、无聊的、无趣的
example: The game was slow, and it was also boring.
example_zh: 那场比赛节奏很慢，而且也很无聊。

example: The man was ashamed of being born poor.
example_zh: 那个男人因出身贫穷而感到羞愧。

example: She borrowed a book from the library.
example_zh: 她从图书馆借了一本书。

example: You talk as if you were the boss.
example_zh: 你说起话来好像自己是老板一样。

zh: 形. 专横的、浮雕装饰的
example: I know that Tom is bossy.
example_zh: 我知道汤姆喜欢指挥别人。

example: Both Tom and Bill are playing tennis now.
example_zh: 汤姆和比尔现在都在打网球。

zh: 动. 烦扰、迷惑、烦恼、操心
example: Do not bother to come to my home.
example_zh: 你不必麻烦来我家。

example: There is a little water in the bottle.
example_zh: 瓶子里有一点水。

example: Bottles should be rinsed out before being deposited in the bottle bank.
example_zh: 瓶子放进玻璃瓶回收箱前应该冲洗干净。

example: The bottom has fallen out of the market.
example_zh: 市场已经跌到谷底。

example: The soup in the bowl was very delicious.
example_zh: 碗里的汤非常好喝。

example: I bought a box lunch at the station.
example_zh: 我在车站买了一份盒饭。

example: I like such sports as boxing and hockey.
example_zh: 我喜欢拳击和曲棍球之类的运动。

example: He is a clever boy, to be sure.
example_zh: 他确实是个聪明的男孩。

example: She is going to part from her boyfriend.
example_zh: 她将要和男朋友分手。

example: This bracelet is more expensive than that one.
example_zh: 这条手链比那条贵。

example: The brain is just a complicated machine.
example_zh: 大脑只是一台复杂的机器。

zh: 名. 刹车、阻碍、丛林；动. 刹车
example: He put his foot on the brake suddenly.
example_zh: 他突然把脚踩到刹车上。

example: The large chain store created a new branch.
example_zh: 这家大型连锁店开了一家新分店。

example: I have a brand new pair of socks.
example_zh: 我有一双全新的袜子。

zh: 形. 勇敢的、美好的、华丽的
example: He was brave in the face of danger.
example_zh: 面对危险时他很勇敢。

example: There is enough bread for all of you.
example_zh: 有足够的面包给你们大家吃。

zh: 名. 休息、中断、破裂处、分隔符；动. 打破、弄破、弄坏、破碎
example: A fire broke out in the neighborhood yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天这个街区发生了一场火灾。

example: The car has broken down.
example_zh: 这辆车抛锚了。

example: We need not have eaten breakfast so early.
example_zh: 我们本来不必这么早吃早饭。

zh: 动. 训练、使经使用逐渐合用、闯入
example: My leg was broken in a traffic accident.
example_zh: 我的腿在一次交通事故中骨折了。

example: When does school break up?
example_zh: 学校什么时候放假？

example: The truth knocked the breath out of him.
example_zh: 真相让他惊得喘不过气来。

zh: 动. 呼吸、使喘息、发散、生存
example: Don't breathe a word of it to anyone.
example_zh: 不要把这件事告诉任何人。

zh: 名. 微风、煤屑、轻而易举的事
example: Like a leaf in the autumn breeze.
example_zh: 像秋风中的一片叶子。

example: Every bride is beautiful on her wedding day.
example_zh: 每个新娘在婚礼当天都很美。

example: The Golden Gate Bridge is made of iron.
example_zh: 金门大桥是用铁建成的。

example: In brief, you should have accepted the responsibility.
example_zh: 简而言之，你本应该承担这个责任。

zh: 形. 明亮的、聪明的、鲜明的
example: It was a bright and clear Sunday morning.
example_zh: 那是一个明亮又晴朗的星期天早晨。

zh: 形. 光辉的、灿烂的、有才气的
example: I thought the film was brilliant!
example_zh: 我觉得这部电影非常棒！

zh: 动. 带来、产生、促使、生产
example: Hard work has brought him where he is.
example_zh: 努力工作让他有了今天的成就。

example: She was brought up in London.
example_zh: 她在伦敦长大。

zh: 形. 宽广的、辽阔的、广大的
example: There is a broad street near my house.
example_zh: 我家附近有一条宽阔的街道。

example: I don't like broccoli and Tom doesn't either.
example_zh: 我不喜欢西兰花，汤姆也不喜欢。

example: Do you have a sightseeing brochure for this town?
example_zh: 你有这个城镇的观光手册吗？

zh: 形. 坏掉的、打破的、断掉的
example: I can't walk because of my broken leg.
example_zh: 我的腿断了，所以不能走路。

example: The boy singing a song is my brother.
example_zh: 正在唱歌的那个男孩是我弟弟。

zh: 形. 褐色的；名. 褐色
example: The woman on the bench is Mrs. Brown.
example_zh: 长椅上的那位女士是布朗太太。

zh: 名. 刷子、毛笔、争吵；动. 刷、擦过、掠过
example: This shampoo comes with a nice hair brush.
example_zh: 这款洗发水附赠一把漂亮的发刷。

example: Will you send up a bucket of ice?
example_zh: 你能送一桶冰上来吗？

example: I think I caught a bug over the weekend.
example_zh: 我觉得我周末染上了病毒。

example: The building on the hill is our school.
example_zh: 山上的那栋建筑是我们的学校。

example: Look at that building standing on the hill.
example_zh: 看那座立在山上的建筑物。

example: Who can tell me how a light bulb works?
example_zh: 谁能告诉我灯泡是怎么工作的？

example: A bull with short trousers has escaped.
example_zh: 一头穿着短裤的公牛逃跑了。

example: He threw away a bunch of old letters.
example_zh: 他扔掉了一叠旧信。

example: I ate a burger, then went to bed.
example_zh: 我吃了一个汉堡，然后就去睡觉了。

zh: 动. 烧、烧毁、烧伤、燃烧
example: The house was burned to the ground.
example_zh: 房子被烧成了平地。

zh: 形. 燃烧的、象燃烧一样的
example: There was a light burning in the window.
example_zh: 窗户里有一盏灯亮着。

example: This is a place where animals are buried.
example_zh: 这里是埋葬动物的地方。

example: Hurry up, and you can catch the bus.
example_zh: 快点，这样你就能赶上公共汽车。

example: We found the stolen bag in this bush.
example_zh: 我们在这片灌木丛里找到了被偷的包。

example: You have no business complaining about the matter.
example_zh: 你没有资格抱怨这件事。

zh: 名. 商人、实业家、工商业家
example: As a businessman he is far above me.
example_zh: 作为一名商人，他比我强多了。

zh: 名. 商人、办理实务的人、经商者
example: Skura is a wealthy businesswoman from Algeria.
example_zh: 斯库拉是一位来自阿尔及利亚的富有女商人。

example: The bus station is next to the shopping centre.
example_zh: 公共汽车站就在购物中心旁边。

example: I wait for the bus at the bus stop near my house.
example_zh: 我在我家附近的公交车站等公共汽车。

zh: 形. 忙碌的、热闹的、没空的
example: You are always as busy as a bee.
example_zh: 你总是像蜜蜂一样忙碌。

example: I'd be unhappy, but I wouldn't kill myself.
example_zh: 我会不开心，但我不会自杀。

example: I thought you said Tom was a butcher.
example_zh: 我以为你说过汤姆是个屠夫。

example: Cheese and butter are products made from milk.
example_zh: 奶酪和黄油是用牛奶制成的产品。

example: He happened to catch sight of a rare butterfly.
example_zh: 他碰巧看见了一只稀有的蝴蝶。

example: The button on your coat is coming off.
example_zh: 你外套上的纽扣要掉了。

example: Show me the doll that you bought yesterday.
example_zh: 给我看看你昨天买的那个娃娃。

example: They still haven't found a buyer for that house.
example_zh: 他们还没为那栋房子找到买家。

example: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
example_zh: 你必须在5点之前到达车站。

example: I found your keys by accident in the kitchen.
example_zh: 我在厨房里偶然找到了你的钥匙。

example: I still prefer to write letters by hand.
example_zh: 我还是更喜欢用手写信。

example: I'm afraid I took your umbrella by mistake.
example_zh: 恐怕我错拿了你的伞。

zh: 介. 名叫…、用名字、凭名字
example: Why don't you call the child by name?
example_zh: 你为什么不叫那个孩子的名字？

zh: 叹. interj. 再会、回头见
example: It is high time we said good-bye.
example_zh: 我们该说再见了。

zh: 名. 出租车、出租汽车、出租马车
example: A taxi is the same as a cab.
example_zh: 出租车和计程车是一样的。

example: You like all vegetables except cabbage, don't you?
example_zh: 除了卷心菜，其他蔬菜你都喜欢，对吧？

example: I just bought an extremely expensive cabin boat.
example_zh: 我刚买了一艘非常昂贵的带舱船。

example: The Cabinet conference was all but over then.
example_zh: 那时内阁会议差不多结束了。

zh: 名. 电缆、海底电报、缆
example: We went up the mountain by cable car.
example_zh: 我们坐缆车上山。

example: We had lunch in a small cafe near the river.
example_zh: 我们在河边的一家小咖啡馆吃了午饭。

example: A cafeteria is a self-service style restaurant.
example_zh: 自助餐厅是一种自助式餐厅。

example: You can have any cake on the table.
example_zh: 你可以吃桌子上的任何一块蛋糕。

example: Do you have a calculator I could borrow?
example_zh: 你有计算器可以借给我吗？

example: January is the first month of the calendar.
example_zh: 一月是日历上的第一个月。

zh: 名. 小牛、小牛皮、腓肠
example: A giraffe would never leave her calf behind.
example_zh: 长颈鹿妈妈绝不会丢下自己的幼崽。

zh: 名. 呼叫、访问、打电话；动. 呼叫、召集、打电话、叫喊
example: I’ll call (phone) again later this afternoon.
example_zh: 我今天下午晚些时候会再打电话。

zh: 动. 叫(某人)来、要求、为…叫喊
example: I’ll call for you at 7.
example_zh: 我7点来接你。

example: She called in to see a friend.
example_zh: 她顺路去看了一位朋友。

example: The weather will soon begin to calm down.
example_zh: 天气很快就会开始平静下来。

example: Our journey by camel was quite an experience.
example_zh: 我们骑骆驼的旅程真是一次特别的经历。

zh: 名. 照相机、摄影机、密谈室
example: This is the same camera that he lost.
example_zh: 这就是他丢的那台相机。

zh: 动. 使扎营、露营、扎营
example: I would like to join the summer camp.
example_zh: 我想参加夏令营。

example: Camping is impossible where there is no water.
example_zh: 在没有水的地方不可能露营。

example: We should probably head back to the campsite.
example_zh: 我们也许该回营地了。

zh: 名. 罐头、容器；助. 能、可以
example: I can ride a bike. (ability).
example_zh: 我会骑自行车。（能力）

example: Sami's body was found in the irrigation canal.
example_zh: 萨米的尸体在灌溉渠里被发现。

zh: 动. 取消、删去、抵销、相互抵销
example: Otherwise we will have to cancel this order.
example_zh: 否则我们将不得不取消这个订单。

example: I have a good opinion of the young candidate.
example_zh: 我对这位年轻候选人评价很好。

example: My cooking cannot hold a candle to Mother's.
example_zh: 我的厨艺比不上妈妈的。

example: My son took a candy from the box.
example_zh: 我儿子从盒子里拿了一颗糖。

zh: 名. 水壶、军中俱乐部、临时流动餐馆
example: There is little water left in the canteen.
example_zh: 水壶里剩下的水不多了。

example: I put on my cap to go out.
example_zh: 我戴上帽子出门。

zh: 名. 首都、大写字母、资本
example: What is the capital of the United States?
example_zh: 美国的首都是什么？

zh: 名. 船长、指挥官、海军上校
example: So the captain took care of him.
example_zh: 于是船长照顾了他。

example: You are asking too much for this car.
example_zh: 这辆车你要价太高了。

zh: 名. 卡片、纸牌、节目单
example: Let me tell you your fortune with cards.
example_zh: 让我用牌给你算命。

example: I used cardboard to make this box.
example_zh: 我用硬纸板做了这个盒子。

zh: 名. 小心、照料、忧虑；动. 在意、喜欢、关心、介意
example: She takes good care of her little brother.
example_zh: 她把弟弟照顾得很好。

example: Which comes first, your career or your family?
example_zh: 你的事业和家庭，哪个排在第一位？

example: You cannot be too careful when you drive.
example_zh: 开车时你再小心也不为过。

zh: 形. 粗心的、不关心的、无忧无虑的
example: It was careless of her to forget it.
example_zh: 她忘记这件事真是太粗心了。

example: I last saw him in the car park.
example_zh: 我最后一次见到他是在停车场。

example: This carpet is one of the most beautiful.
example_zh: 这块地毯是最漂亮的地毯之一。

example: The hare stole a carrot from the garden.
example_zh: 野兔从花园里偷了一根胡萝卜。

zh: 动. 携带、运送、支持、被携带
example: You should carry out the plan on schedule.
example_zh: 你应该按期执行这个计划。

zh: 动. 继续开展、行为愚蠢(或越轨)
example: He carried on walking despite the rain.
example_zh: 尽管下着雨，他继续走。

example: She carried out the plan according to.
example_zh: 她按照……执行了计划。

example: I borrowed this cartoon from his older sister.
example_zh: 我从他姐姐那里借了这本漫画。

example: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
example_zh: 吃这个药，以防你生病。

zh: 名. 现金；动. 兑现
example: The bank will cash your fifty dollar check.
example_zh: 银行会给你兑现这张五十美元的支票。

example: I got some money from a cash machine.
example_zh: 我从自动取款机取了一些钱。

zh: 名. 一种电脑化的付现机
example: My credit card was rejected by the cashpoint.
example_zh: 我的信用卡在自动取款机上被拒了。

zh: 名. 城堡、象棋中的车
example: The town is famous for its old castle.
example_zh: 这个镇因它的古老城堡而闻名。

zh: 形. 偶然的、不经意的、便装的
example: I took a casual look at the magazine.
example_zh: 我随意地看了一眼那本杂志。

example: A cat got out from under the car.
example_zh: 一只猫从车底下钻了出来。

zh: 动. 捕捉、赶上、感染、抓住
example: If you hurry, you'll catch up with him.
example_zh: 如果你快点，就会追上他。

example: The cathedral had a religious painting on its ceiling.
example_zh: 大教堂的天花板上有一幅宗教画。

example: Cattle would not eat grass where sheep had eaten.
example_zh: 牛不肯吃羊吃过的草。

example: This is what I found in the cave.
example_zh: 这是我在山洞里发现的东西。

zh: 名. 镭射碟、镭射唱片
example: Which CD do you want to listen to?
example_zh: 你想听哪张CD？

zh: 名. 激光唱机、CD播放器
example: My car is equipped with a CD player.
example_zh: 我的车装有CD播放器。

example: I saw a spider walking on the ceiling.
example_zh: 我看见一只蜘蛛在天花板上爬。

example: It was a party to celebrate her birthday.
example_zh: 那是一个庆祝她生日的聚会。

example: The parents will be invited to the school celebration.
example_zh: 家长将被邀请参加学校的庆祝活动。

example: He is something of a celebrity.
example_zh: 他算是个名人。

example: Please turn off your cell phone in the library.
example_zh: 在图书馆里请关掉你的手机。

example: I don't have a cent, let alone a dollar.
example_zh: 我一分钱都没有，更别说一美元了。

example: The box is thirty centimetres long.
example_zh: 这个盒子长三十厘米。

example: Central Park is near where I work.
example_zh: 中央公园在我工作地点附近。

example: There is no central heating in this house.
example_zh: 这所房子里没有中央供暖。

zh: 名. 中心、中心点、中锋
example: There is a new sports centre in our town.
example_zh: 我们镇上有一个新的体育中心。

example: This church was built in the 12th century.
example_zh: 这座教堂建于12世纪。

zh: 名. 谷类食品、谷类植物
example: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上吃一碗麦片。

example: The opening ceremony took place on schedule.
example_zh: 开幕式按计划举行。

zh: 形. 确定的、某一个的、必然的
example: There is one thing that is certain.
example_zh: 有一件事是确定的。

example: That girl is certainly a hard worker.
example_zh: 那个女孩确实是个很努力的人。

example: If you have a medical certificate, bring it.
example_zh: 如果你有医疗证明，请带上它。

example: She wore a gold chain.
example_zh: 她戴着一条金链子。

zh: 名. 椅子、显要的席位、主席
example: You may sit down in the chair.
example_zh: 你可以坐在椅子上。

zh: 名. 挑战、盘问；动. 向…挑战、要求、怀疑、挑战
example: I don't get enough challenge in this job.
example_zh: 这份工作没有给我足够的挑战。

zh: 形. 挑战的、引起争论的
example: It is challenging and I am learning a lot.
example_zh: 这很有挑战性，我也能学到很多。

zh: 名. 冠军、拥护者、战士
example: He is what is called a champion of justice.
example_zh: 他就是所谓的正义斗士。

zh: 名. 冠军身份、冠军称号、捍卫
example: I found it impossible to win the championship.
example_zh: 我觉得赢得冠军是不可能的。

zh: 名. 机会、意外、可能性
example: You have a good chance to get well.
example_zh: 你很有机会康复。

zh: 动. 改变、更换、兑换；名. 变化、找回的零钱、找头
example: There is a change of room for this course.
example_zh: 这门课程换教室了。

example: I had my purse stolen in the changing room.
example_zh: 我的钱包在更衣室被偷了。

example: The French are our neighbors across the Channel.
example_zh: 法国人是我们在英吉利海峡对岸的邻居。

example: This chapter is the heart of the novel.
example_zh: 这一章是小说的核心。

example: He was my favourite character in the film.
example_zh: 他是我在这部电影里最喜欢的角色。

zh: 名. 指控、费用、冲锋；动. 控诉、加罪于、使充满、冲锋
example: Mr White is in charge of our class.
example_zh: 怀特先生负责我们班。

zh: 名. 慈悲、博爱、慈善团体
example: I don't need any bit of your charity.
example_zh: 我一点也不需要你的施舍。

zh: 形. 迷人的、有吸引力的
example: She is no less charming than her sister.
example_zh: 她不比她姐姐/妹妹逊色。

example: You must come and have a chat with us.
example_zh: 你一定要来和我们聊聊天。

example: She met many boys in the chatroom.
example_zh: 她在聊天室里遇到了很多男孩。

zh: 名. （电视或广播电台的）访谈节目
example: He was a guest on a popular chat show.
example_zh: 他曾是一个热门访谈节目的嘉宾。

zh: 形. 便宜的、不值钱的、可鄙的
example: The necklace is cheap at a hundred dollars.
example_zh: 这条项链卖一百美元算便宜。

example: If you do that, you will be cheating.
example_zh: 如果你那样做，你就是在作弊。

zh: 动. 检查、阻止、核对、逐项相符
example: We should check the spread of the disease.
example_zh: 我们应该控制这种疾病的传播。

example: They checked in to a hotel.
example_zh: 他们入住了一家酒店。

example: Your keys are at the check-in desk.
example_zh: 你的钥匙在前台。

zh: 动. 付帐后离开、检查、符合要求
example: He checked out of the hotel at the end of.
example_zh: 他在……结束时办理了退房。

example: Yanni was waiting in the checkout line.
example_zh: Yanni在结账队伍里等着。

example: The girl kissed her father on the cheek.
example_zh: 女孩亲了亲父亲的脸颊。

zh: 形. 快活的、高兴的、兴高采烈的
example: He is not the cheerful man he was.
example_zh: 他不再是以前那个开朗的人了。

example: Cheers! Here's to a great year.
example_zh: 干杯！为美好的一年干杯。

example: I bought some cheese and a little milk.
example_zh: 我买了一些奶酪和一点牛奶。

example: You never told me Tom was a chef.
example_zh: 你从没告诉过我汤姆是厨师。

zh: 名. 药店、药剂师（英式）
example: The duty chemist is open on Sunday morning.
example_zh: 值班药房星期天上午营业。

example: They carried out a new experiment in chemistry.
example_zh: 他们进行了一项新的化学实验。

example: I'm going to cash in my cheque soon.
example_zh: 我很快要去兑现我的支票。

example: I will teach you how to play chess.
example_zh: 我会教你下国际象棋。

example: Could your scarf be in the chest of drawers?
example_zh: 你的围巾可能在抽屉柜里吗？

example: Roast chicken is one of my favorite dishes.
example_zh: 烤鸡是我最喜欢的菜之一。

zh: 名. 孩子、产物、追随者
example: We searched the woods for the missing child.
example_zh: 我们在树林里搜寻那个失踪的孩子。

example: Yes, we have been friends since our childhood.
example_zh: 是的，我们从小就是朋友。

zh: 动. 冷静点=calm down、冷静下来、别紧张
example: Felix and Amelia chilled out for another five hours.
example_zh: 费利克斯和阿米莉亚又放松了五个小时。

example: I cannot mix chilli with my food.
example_zh: 我不能把辣椒混进我的食物里。

example: What is that funny growth on Mary's chin?
example_zh: 玛丽下巴上那个奇怪的肿块是什么？

example: I love fish and chips.
example_zh: 我喜欢炸鱼薯条。

example: Don't you even think of eating my chocolate!
example_zh: 你想都别想吃我的巧克力！

zh: 名. 选择、精选品、选择权
example: You leave me no choice in the matter.
example_zh: 这件事你让我别无选择。

zh: 动. 选择、宁愿、欲、作出选择
example: You may choose either of the two books.
example_zh: 你可以选这两本书中的任何一本。

example: She went to the cinema the other day.
example_zh: 她前几天去了电影院。

zh: 名. 圆周、社交圈、循环
example: We sat around the fire in a circle.
example_zh: 我们围着火坐成一圈。

zh: 名. 马戏团、马戏、竞技场
example: The clown at the circus pleased my children.
example_zh: 马戏团的小丑让我的孩子们很开心。

example: The station is the middle of the city.
example_zh: 车站在市中心。

zh: 动. 鼓掌、(使)啪地关上
example: Suddenly I heard a loud clap of thunder.
example_zh: 突然，我听到一声响亮的雷声。

example: Not all the students were present in class.
example_zh: 不是所有学生都来上课了。

zh: 形. 古典的、正统派的、经典的
example: Classical music is not my cup of tea.
example_zh: 古典音乐不是我喜欢的类型。

example: On leaving school, she got married to her classmate.
example_zh: 离开学校后，她就和她的同学结婚了。

example: There is a tall man in the classroom.
example_zh: 教室里有一个高个子男人。

zh: 形. 干净的、清白的、简洁的；动. 清理、使干净、出空、被搞干净
example: Mum, why doesn't Dad clean his own study?
example_zh: 妈妈，为什么爸爸不打扫他自己的书房？

zh: 名. 清洁工人、清洁剂、干洗商
example: The river has become much cleaner than before.
example_zh: 这条河比以前干净多了。

zh: 形. 清楚的、明确的、澄清的
example: It’s not clear to me.
example_zh: 我不太清楚。

example: Speak clearly so that everyone may hear you.
example_zh: 说清楚一点，好让大家都能听见你。

example: Both the boy and the girl are clever.
example_zh: 男孩和女孩都很聪明。

zh: 名. 咔哒声、啪嗒声；动. 使发咔哒声、作咔哒声
example: Click here to go to our website.
example_zh: 点击这里进入我们的网站。

example: Another step, and you'll fall over the cliff.
example_zh: 再走一步，你就会从悬崖上掉下去。

zh: 名. 气候、社会趋势、气候区
example: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
example_zh: 一般来说，日本的气候温和。

example: The climate change around this world worried everyone.
example_zh: 世界各地的气候变化让每个人担忧。

example: A monkey is climbing up a tall tree.
example_zh: 一只猴子正在爬一棵高高的树。

example: I don't like my brother climbing the mountains.
example_zh: 我不喜欢我哥哥爬山。

example: They cleaned the trash against the clinic wall.
example_zh: 他们清理了诊所墙边的垃圾。

zh: 名. 时钟、计时器、(袜子上的)绣花边花
example: He took the clock apart just for fun.
example_zh: 他把钟拆开只是为了好玩。

zh: 形. 靠近的、亲近的、亲密的；动. 关、结束、使靠近、关闭
example: Our school is very close to the park.
example_zh: 我们学校离公园很近。

zh: 形. 关闭的、限于少数人的
example: He closed the window for fear of rain.
example_zh: 他因为怕下雨关上了窗户。

example: Maria spends a lot of money on clothes.
example_zh: 玛丽亚花很多钱买衣服。

example: Each person was given enough food and clothing.
example_zh: 每个人都得到了足够的食物和衣服。

example: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
example_zh: 天空中没有一朵云。

zh: 形. 多云的、有愁容的、云的
example: The sky is cloudy and it will rain.
example_zh: 天空多云，要下雨了。

example: Will you dance with me, my little clown?
example_zh: 你愿意和我跳舞吗，我的小丑？

zh: 名. 俱乐部、木棍、球棒
example: I should like to join the cricket club.
example_zh: 我想加入板球俱乐部。

zh: 名. 四轮大马车、教练
example: She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.
example_zh: 她喜欢网球，后来成了网球教练。

example: The island lies a mile off the coast.
example_zh: 这座岛位于离海岸一英里处。

example: The button on your coat is coming off.
example_zh: 你外套上的纽扣要掉了。

example: Sami was eating a slice of coconut cake.
example_zh: 萨米正在吃一块椰子蛋糕。

example: My grandmother had a delicious recipe for cod.
example_zh: 我奶奶有一份美味的鳕鱼食谱。

example: If your coffee is too strong, add some sugar.
example_zh: 如果你的咖啡太浓，就加些糖。

example: Look at this old coin you have here.
example_zh: 看看你这里的这枚旧硬币。

example: This cola has gone flat and doesn't taste good.
example_zh: 这可乐没气了，味道不好。

zh: 形. 寒冷的、冷淡的、冷静的；名. 感冒、寒冷
example: The cold weather has turned the leaves red.
example_zh: 寒冷的天气使树叶变红了。

example: The collar is too tight round my throat.
example_zh: 衣领在我喉咙周围太紧了。

example: A colleague has every advantage over me.
example_zh: 一位同事在各方面都比我占优势。

example: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
example_zh: 开始工作前，先整理一下思路。

zh: 名. 收集、采集、(一批)收藏品
example: The collection is open to the public.
example_zh: 这个收藏向公众开放。

example: Our new English teacher is fresh from college.
example_zh: 我们的新英语老师刚从大学毕业。

zh: 名. 颜色、面色、颜料；动. 把…涂上颜色、粉饰、使脸红、变色
example: I don't like the colour of this house.
example_zh: 我不喜欢这所房子的颜色。

zh: 形. 颜色丰富的、鲜艳的、艳丽的
example: Your jumper is more colourful than mine.
example_zh: 你的毛衣比我的颜色更鲜艳。

example: I need a mirror to comb my hair.
example_zh: 我需要一面镜子来梳头。

example: You ought to have come to our party.
example_zh: 你本应该来参加我们的聚会的。

zh: 名. 喜剧、有趣的事情
example: We went to see a comedy in London.
example_zh: 我们去伦敦看了一部喜剧。

example: Come on or we'll miss the bus.
example_zh: 快点，否则我们会赶不上公交车。

zh: 名. 舒适、安慰、安慰者
example: He tried to comfort her, but she kept crying.
example_zh: 他试图安慰她，但她一直哭。

example: Sit on the sofa and make yourself comfortable.
example_zh: 坐在沙发上，随便一点。

example: I’m going to comment on the blogpost.
example_zh: 我要给这篇博客文章写评论。

zh: 名. 连环漫画、喜剧演员、滑稽的人
example: I gave her a comic book to read.
example_zh: 我给了她一本漫画书看。

example: In another paragraph, he put in a comma.
example_zh: 在另一段里，他加了一个逗号。

example: What changes the world is communication, not information.
example_zh: 改变世界的是沟通，不是信息。

example: You had better not keep company with him.
example_zh: 你最好别和他交往。

zh: 动. 比较、比喻、对照、相比
example: Compare your translation with the one on the blackboard.
example_zh: 把你的翻译和黑板上的翻译比较一下。

example: Family members should not compete against each other.
example_zh: 家庭成员之间不应该互相竞争。

example: Competition is neither good nor evil in itself.
example_zh: 竞争本身既不好也不坏。

example: I know Tom will be a tough competitor.
example_zh: 我知道汤姆会是一个强劲的对手。

example: You have no business complaining about the matter.
example_zh: 你没有资格抱怨这件事。

example: I am writing in relation to your complaint.
example_zh: 我写信是关于你的投诉。

zh: 动. 完成、完工、使圆满
example: Do your best to complete the work.
example_zh: 尽你最大努力完成这项工作。

zh: 副. 完全地、十分地、圆满地
example: My life would be completely empty without you.
example_zh: 没有你，我的生活将完全空虚。

example: That made the problem all the more complicated.
example_zh: 那使问题更加复杂了。

example: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
example_zh: 除了拼写以外，你的作文很好。

zh: 名. 电脑、电子计算机
example: I'd like some information about your new computers.
example_zh: 我想了解一些关于你们新电脑的信息。

example: They're making too much noise. I can't concentrate.
example_zh: 他们太吵了。我无法集中注意力。

zh: 名. 音乐会、和声、一致
example: The excited audience ran into the concert hall.
example_zh: 兴奋的观众跑进了音乐厅。

example: The affair will come to a happy conclusion.
example_zh: 这件事会有一个圆满的结局。

example: You must on no condition open the box.
example_zh: 你无论如何都不可以打开这个盒子。

example: The conference is to be held in Tokyo.
example_zh: 会议将在东京举行。

zh: 形. 有信心的、有把握的
example: I am confident he will keep his promise.
example_zh: 我确信他会遵守诺言。

example: Don't forget to confirm your reservation in advance.
example_zh: 别忘了提前确认你的预订。

example: You must have me confused with someone else.
example_zh: 你一定把我跟别人弄混了。

zh: 形. 令人困惑的、混淆的、混乱的
example: The presentation of this website is sometimes confusing.
example_zh: 这个网站的展示有时让人困惑。

example: Congratulations! You passed the exam.
example_zh: 恭喜！你考试通过了。

example: This telephone is connected to the fax machine.
example_zh: 这部电话和传真机连在一起。

zh: 名. 连接、关系、前后关系
example: Tell me all you know in connection with this.
example_zh: 告诉我你知道的与这件事有关的一切。

example: We considered going, but finally decided against it.
example_zh: 我们考虑过要去，但最后决定不去了。

zh: 动. 组成、存在于、一致
example: Education doesn't consist of learning a lot of facts.
example_zh: 教育并不在于学习大量事实。

example: The next Berber word starts with a consonant.
example_zh: 下一个柏柏尔语单词以辅音开头。

zh: 名. 联系、交际、熟人；动. 使接触、接触、联系
example: At last, we made contact with the police.
example_zh: 最后，我们联系上了警察。

zh: 动. 包含、容纳、控制、自制
example: This room is too small to contain 50 men.
example_zh: 这个房间太小，容纳不下50个人。

example: May I see the contents of the package?
example_zh: 我可以看看包裹里的东西吗？

example: You should take part in that speech contest.
example_zh: 你应该参加那个演讲比赛。

example: Africa was once called the Dark Continent.
example_zh: 非洲曾被称为“黑暗大陆”。

zh: 动. 使继续、使延长、继续、延续
example: I wonder when this program will continue till.
example_zh: 我想知道这个节目会持续到什么时候。

example: After much effort, he ended up with a contract.
example_zh: 经过很多努力，他最终拿到了一份合同。

zh: 名. 控制、管理、克制；动. 控制、操纵、抑制
example: I'm very impressed with your quality control.
example_zh: 我对你们的品质管理印象很深。

example: It's convenient living so close to the station.
example_zh: 住得离车站这么近很方便。

example: I enjoyed the conversation we had this afternoon.
example_zh: 我很喜欢今天下午我们的谈话。

example: You will soon be convinced I am right.
example_zh: 你很快就会相信我是对的。

zh: 名. 厨子、厨师；动. 烹调、煮饭、加热、在煮着
example: The cook served the family for many years.
example_zh: 这位厨师为这家人服务了很多年。

zh: 名. 炊事用具、炉灶、锅
example: Neither Tom nor Mary has a rice cooker.
example_zh: 汤姆和玛丽都没有电饭锅。

example: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her cookery book.
example_zh: 齐里问里玛他能不能借她的烹饪书。

zh: 名. 曲奇饼干、甜饼干
example: These cookies aren't expensive, but they taste good.
example_zh: 这些饼干不贵，但味道很好。

example: When I came home, he was cooking dinner.
example_zh: 我回家时，他正在做晚饭。

zh: 形. 凉爽的、冷淡的、冷静的
example: That’s a cool bike!
example_zh: 那是一辆很酷的自行车！

example: If it is free, please send me a copy.
example_zh: 如果免费，请寄给我一份。

zh: 名. 玉蜀黍、谷类、谷粒
example: I have a corn on my right foot.
example_zh: 我右脚上有个鸡眼。

example: There's a white building just around the corner.
example_zh: 就在拐角处有一栋白色大楼。

example: Your answer to the question is not correct.
example_zh: 你对这个问题的回答不正确。

zh: 名. 订正、改正、改正的地方
example: I've made a correction to the wrong sentence.
example_zh: 我已经更正了那个错误的句子。

zh: 名. 代价、价值、费用；动. 使失去、值、使花费、花费
example: The picture you are looking at costs 100,000 yen.
example_zh: 你正在看的那幅画要十万日元。

example: I forgot my swimming costume.
example_zh: 我忘了带我的泳衣。

example: The room is warm and cosy now.
example_zh: 房间现在温暖又舒适。

example: There stands a cottage close to the forest.
example_zh: 森林附近立着一座小屋。

example: Someday I will buy a cotton candy machine.
example_zh: 有一天我要买一台棉花糖机。

zh: 名. 咳嗽；动. 咳出、咳嗽
example: I have a cough and a little fever.
example_zh: 我咳嗽，还有点发烧。

example: I couldn’t find the information.
example_zh: 我找不到那条信息。

example: We can count on him for financial help.
example_zh: 我们可以指望他提供经济上的帮助。

example: Visiting a foreign country must be expensive.
example_zh: 出国旅行一定很贵。

zh: 名. 乡下地方、乡下居民
example: They lived in the countryside during the war.
example_zh: 战争期间他们住在乡下。

example: The couple have no less than seven children.
example_zh: 这对夫妇有不少于七个孩子。

example: What you need the most now is courage.
example_zh: 你现在最需要的是勇气。

example: She'll do it as a matter of course.
example_zh: 她自然会做这件事。

example: Some were playing tennis on the court.
example_zh: 有些人在球场上打网球。

zh: 名. 堂兄弟姊妹、表兄弟姊妹
example: My cousin is having a baby next month.
example_zh: 我的表亲下个月要生孩子了。

zh: 动. 覆盖、掩饰、保护；名. 盖子、封面、藉口
example: I had to cover my eyes.
example_zh: 我不得不捂住眼睛。

example: You cannot sell the cow and drink the milk.
example_zh: 你不能既卖掉奶牛又喝它的奶。

zh: 名. 哗啦声、猛撞、崩溃；动. 撞碎、破碎、(使)…坠毁
example: The child heard something fall with a crash.
example_zh: 孩子听到有东西砰的一声掉下来。

example: I like strawberries and cream.
example_zh: 我喜欢草莓加奶油。

example: That artist created a lot of beautiful pictures.
example_zh: 那位艺术家创作了很多美丽的画。

zh: 形. 有创造力的、创作的、产生的
example: The place was alive with creative young people.
example_zh: 这个地方充满了有创造力的年轻人。

example: I'm just a creature of habit, I guess.
example_zh: 我想我只是个习惯按老规矩做事的人。

example: The boy is a credit to our school.
example_zh: 这个男孩是我们学校的骄傲。

example: Can I pay by credit card, please?
example_zh: 请问我可以用信用卡付款吗？

zh: 名. 全体人员、一群人、全体队员
example: The crew were all waiting for the news.
example_zh: 全体船员都在等待消息。

example: Tomorrow I have a cricket match. Wish me luck.
example_zh: 明天我有一场板球比赛。祝我好运。

example: It was horrible to hear about the crime.
example_zh: 听到那起犯罪事件，真可怕。

example: The criminal gave himself up to the police.
example_zh: 罪犯向警察自首了。

zh: 名. 农作物、产量、平头
example: The land is out of crop this year.
example_zh: 这块地今年没有收成。

zh: 名. 十字架、十字架形物件、交叉；动. 交叉、横过、越过
example: No idea of danger crossed my mind then.
example_zh: 当时我一点也没想到危险。

zh: 名. 横越、横渡、交叉点
example: Avoid crossing this street when it is raining.
example_zh: 下雨时避免过这条街。

example: Every address on the list was crossed out.
example_zh: 名单上的每个地址都被划掉了。

zh: 名. 十字路口、交叉路口、聚会的中心地点
example: Drive to the next crossroads and turn left.
example_zh: 开车到下一个十字路口，然后左转。

example: The excited crowd poured out of the stadium.
example_zh: 兴奋的人群从体育场涌了出来。

example: The front of the bus was not crowded.
example_zh: 公共汽车的前部不拥挤。

zh: 形. 残酷的、令人极痛苦的
example: You ought not to be cruel to animals.
example_zh: 你不应该对动物残忍。

example: Have you ever been on a cruise ship?
example_zh: 你坐过游轮吗？

zh: 动. 叫喊、大声说、哭出、哭
example: The school is crying out for good teachers.
example_zh: 这所学校急需好老师。

example: The cucumber is bitter? Then throw it away!
example_zh: 黄瓜是苦的吗？那就把它扔了！

zh: 形. 文化的、教养的、修养的
example: Tell us a cultural experience you have experienced.
example_zh: 告诉我们一段你经历过的文化体验。

example: The doctor is a man of culture.
example_zh: 这位医生是个有文化的人。

zh: 名. 杯子、茶杯、优胜杯
example: Waiter, please give me a cup of tea.
example_zh: 服务员，请给我一杯茶。

zh: 名. 食橱、碗柜、餐具柜
example: I'm sure the potatoes are in the cupboard.
example_zh: 我肯定土豆在橱柜里。

zh: 名. 治疗、治愈、治疗法；动. 治疗、治愈、改正、受治疗
example: There is no cure for the common cold.
example_zh: 普通感冒没有治疗方法。

zh: 形. 好奇的、求知的、古怪的
example: Curious to say, I didn't find it anywhere.
example_zh: 说来奇怪，我到处都没找到它。

example: Everyone was looking at Tom curiously.
example_zh: 大家都好奇地看着汤姆。

zh: 形. 拳曲的、卷毛的、弯曲的
example: Mary has curly hair just like her father.
example_zh: 玛丽有卷发，就像她爸爸一样。

example: That custom has little currency in Japan.
example_zh: 那种习俗在日本不流行。

example: What curriculum does Fadil use to teach Arabic?
example_zh: 法迪尔用什么课程来教阿拉伯语？

zh: 名. 咖哩粉、咖哩饭菜
example: The curry rice at this restaurant is delicious.
example_zh: 这家餐厅的咖喱饭很好吃。

example: It happened just when the curtain was falling.
example_zh: 事情就发生在幕布落下的时候。

example: The little dog had his own cushion.
example_zh: 那只小狗有自己的垫子。

example: Such evil customs should be done away with.
example_zh: 这种坏习俗应该被废除。

example: The department store is always packed with customers.
example_zh: 百货商店总是挤满顾客。

example: I work as a customs officer.
example_zh: 我是一名海关官员。

example: You'd better have your hair cut at once.
example_zh: 你最好马上去理发。

zh: 形. 可爱的、聪明的、伶俐的
example: That baby is really not cute at all.
example_zh: 那个婴儿真的一点也不可爱。

example: Their job is to cut up the wood.
example_zh: 他们的工作是把木头切碎。

example: Please send your CV with your application.
example_zh: 请把你的简历和申请一起寄来。

zh: 动. 使循环、使轮转、循环、轮转
example: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.
example_zh: 如果不下雨，你可以去骑自行车。

zh: 名. 骑脚踏车兜风、骑脚踏车消遣
example: I will go cycling even if it rains.
example_zh: 即使下雨，我也要去骑自行车。

example: The cyclist caused the whole peloton to crash.
example_zh: 那名自行车手导致整个主车群撞车。

example: When Dad came home, I was watching TV.
example_zh: 爸爸回家时，我正在看电视。

zh: 形. 每日的、日常的；副. 每日地、日常地
example: I want to learn about American daily life.
example_zh: 我想了解美国人的日常生活。

zh: 名. 损害、伤害；动. 损害
example: If the machine is damaged, you are responsible.
example_zh: 如果机器损坏，你要负责。

example: We're very sorry that your order was damaged.
example_zh: 非常抱歉，您的订单受损了。

zh: 名. 跳舞、舞蹈、舞会；动. 跳舞
example: When did you see her dancing with him?
example_zh: 你什么时候看见她和他跳舞的？

zh: 名. 舞蹈演员、跳舞者
example: Before Mary got married, she was a dancer.
example_zh: 玛丽结婚前是一名舞蹈演员。

example: I think I was dancing in my sleep.
example_zh: 我觉得我睡着的时候在跳舞。

example: When they are in danger, they run away.
example_zh: 他们遇到危险时会逃跑。

example: If it gets dangerous, give me a call.
example_zh: 如果情况变得危险，就给我打电话。

zh: 形. 黑暗的、暗的、深色的
example: You should return home before it gets dark.
example_zh: 你应该在天黑前回家。

example: The data has been fed into the computer.
example_zh: 数据已经被输入电脑。

zh: 名. 日期、约会、枣椰树
example: Let's fix the date for the picnic.
example_zh: 我们把野餐的日期定下来吧。

example: On his return he found her daughter asleep.
example_zh: 他回来时发现她女儿睡着了。

example: You should practice playing the violin every day.
example_zh: 你应该每天练习拉小提琴。

zh: 形. 死的、不活泼的、麻木的
example: Faith which does not doubt is dead faith.
example_zh: 没有怀疑的信仰是死信仰。

example: He turned a deaf ear to my advice.
example_zh: 他对我的建议充耳不闻。

zh: 动. 分配、发牌、给予、处理
example: We should deal with this matter without delay.
example_zh: 我们应该立即处理这件事。

example: I’ve had some problems to deal with.
example_zh: 我有一些问题要处理。

zh: 形. 亲爱的、昂贵的、严重的
example: She held on to it for dear life.
example_zh: 她拼命抓住它。

example: It is a matter of life or death.
example_zh: 这是生死攸关的事。

example: Nobody could decide as to what to do.
example_zh: 没有人能决定该做什么。

example: I don't think that was a wise decision.
example_zh: 我认为那不是个明智的决定。

example: The American government declared a state of emergency.
example_zh: 美国政府宣布进入紧急状态。

example: I like to decorate my room with flowers.
example_zh: 我喜欢用花装饰我的房间。

zh: 名. 减少、减少量；动. 减少
example: Travel by train has been on the decrease.
example_zh: 乘火车旅行一直在减少。

example: I don't know how deep the lake is.
example_zh: 我不知道这个湖有多深。

zh: 名. 败北、失败；动. 击败、使落空
example: Actually, we had prepared ourselves for defeat.
example_zh: 事实上，我们已经做好了失败的准备。

example: Dan claimed that he acted in self-defence.
example_zh: 丹声称他是在自卫。

example: We must defend our freedom at all cost.
example_zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价捍卫我们的自由。

zh: 副. 明确无疑地、清楚地
example: If you don't study harder, you'll definitely fail.
example_zh: 如果你不更努力学习，你肯定会失败。

example: We all suffer from it to some degree.
example_zh: 我们都在某种程度上受它困扰。

zh: 名. 耽搁、迟滞；动. 耽搁、延迟
example: There will be a delay of two hours.
example_zh: 会延误两个小时。

example: The flight is delayed.
example_zh: 航班延误了。

example: Could you tell me how to delete this sentence?
example_zh: 你能告诉我怎样删除这句话吗？

example: I've never eaten anything as delicious as this.
example_zh: 我从来没吃过这么好吃的东西。

example: We were delighted to hear of your success.
example_zh: 听到你成功的消息，我们很高兴。

example: We are able to deliver within a week.
example_zh: 我们可以在一周内送达。

example: The article will be sent cash on delivery.
example_zh: 这件物品将货到付款寄出。

zh: 名. 要求、需求、需要；动. 要求、查询
example: The supply cannot keep up with the demand.
example_zh: 供应跟不上需求。

example: It happened that her husband was a dentist.
example_zh: 碰巧她丈夫是一名牙医。

example: A stranger you arrive, a friend you depart.
example_zh: 你来时是陌生人，离开时是朋友。

example: My mother went shopping at a department store.
example_zh: 我妈妈去百货商店购物了。

example: She bought a new coat at the department store.
example_zh: 她在百货商店买了一件新外套。

example: He decided he would put off his departure.
example_zh: 他决定推迟出发。

example: It depends on what you want to do.
example_zh: 这取决于你想做什么。

zh: 名. 存款、定金、堆积物
example: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.
example_zh: 我在银行存了1,000美元。

example: I can't believe that he is that depressed.
example_zh: 我无法相信他那么沮丧。

example: He's doing in-depth research on ancient history.
example_zh: 他正在对古代历史进行深入研究。

example: Can you describe the situation you were in?
example_zh: 你能描述一下你当时所处的情况吗？

example: The beauty of the sunrise was beyond description.
example_zh: 日出的美无法形容。

zh: 名. 沙漠、应得的赏罚、功劳
example: This is an animal found in that desert.
example_zh: 这是一种在那片沙漠里发现的动物。

zh: 动. 该得到、值得、应得报答
example: The honor is more than I deserve.
example_zh: 这份荣誉超过了我应得的。

example: I can't think about the design any more.
example_zh: 我不能再想这个设计了。

zh: 名. 设计者、谋划者、制图者
example: I didn't quite catch the name of that designer.
example_zh: 我没太听清那个设计师的名字。

zh: 名. 书桌、办公桌、工作台
example: The money on the desk is not mine.
example_zh: 桌子上的钱不是我的。

example: He remained poor despite being a hard worker.
example_zh: 尽管他工作努力，他仍然很穷。

example: I'm trying to save room for dessert.
example_zh: 我正在尽量留出肚子吃甜点。

zh: 名. 目的地、目标、目的
example: After lunch, set out for the next destination.
example_zh: 午饭后，出发去下一个目的地。

example: The building was totally destroyed by the earthquake.
example_zh: 那座建筑被地震完全摧毁了。

example: Please give me the details of the accident.
example_zh: 请告诉我事故的详细情况。

example: The detective surprised the truth from the waitress.
example_zh: 侦探从女服务员那里套出了真相。

zh: 动. 发展、使发达、进步、生长
example: London developed into the general market of Europe.
example_zh: 伦敦发展成了欧洲的综合性市场。

example: I'll focus on the market development for 1999.
example_zh: 我将专注于1999年的市场开发。

example: Let me explain it with a diagram.
example_zh: 让我用图表来解释它。

example: In case of fire, you should dial 119 immediately.
example_zh: 如果发生火灾，你应该立即拨打119。

zh: 动. 以电话线网路来连结其他的电脑系统
example: Could you dial up the operator for me?
example_zh: 你能帮我拨通接线员吗？

example: I read a lot in my diary yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我在日记里读了很多。

example: You should learn how to use your dictionary.
example_zh: 你应该学会如何使用你的词典。

zh: 动. 死、死亡、消逝、平息
example: We die whether we make money or not.
example_zh: 不管我们赚不赚钱，我们都会死。

example: I think you'd better go on a diet.
example_zh: 我觉得你最好节食。

example: The difference is not so great for me.
example_zh: 对我来说，差别没那么大。

example: Your opinion is far different from mine.
example_zh: 你的观点和我的相差很远。

example: Flying against a strong wind is very difficult.
example_zh: 逆着强风飞行非常困难。

example: I had no difficulty in finding his office.
example_zh: 我毫不费力地找到了他的办公室。

zh: 动. 挖、翻土、发掘、挖掘
example: You have to dig down and pay for it.
example_zh: 你得掏钱付账。

zh: 形. 数字显示的、数字的
example: Digital music is becoming more and more popular.
example_zh: 数字音乐正变得越来越流行。

example: We eat dinner together in the dining room.
example_zh: 我们在餐厅一起吃饭。

example: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
example_zh: 你不可能饿。你刚吃过晚饭。

example: Dinosaur eggs? Impossible. These animals are already extinct.
example_zh: 恐龙蛋？不可能。这些动物已经灭绝了。

example: My father died before I got my diploma.
example_zh: 我父亲在我拿到文凭之前去世了。

zh: 形. 直接的、坦白的；动. 指示、指挥、命令、指导
example: Few men have direct access to the president.
example_zh: 很少有人能直接见到总统。

example: I look to him for direction in everything.
example_zh: 我事事都向他寻求指导。

zh: 副. 径直地、直接地、直率地
example: He married directly after he left the university.
example_zh: 他大学毕业后就立刻结婚了。

example: I have a high opinion of the film director.
example_zh: 我对这位电影导演评价很高。

example: Park Street used to be a dirt road.
example_zh: 帕克街过去是一条土路。

example: Don't bring that dirty dog through the kitchen.
example_zh: 不要带那只脏狗穿过厨房。

zh: 形. 残废的、有缺陷的、失效的
example: I fixed the house for the disabled man.
example_zh: 我为那个残疾人修好了房子。

example: His bad health is a great disadvantage to him.
example_zh: 他身体不好，这对他很不利。

example: This is where we absolutely disagree with you.
example_zh: 这就是我们完全不同意你的地方。

example: The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
example_zh: 雾在十点左右开始散去。

example: We were very disappointed to hear the news.
example_zh: 听到这个消息，我们非常失望。

example: They were disappointed that you could not come.
example_zh: 你不能来，他们很失望。

zh: 形. 使失望的、期待落空的、令人沮丧的
example: It's kind of disappointing that Tom isn't here.
example_zh: 汤姆不在，有点令人失望。

example: To our disappointment, our team lost the game.
example_zh: 令我们失望的是，我们队输了比赛。

example: He saved the file to a disc.
example_zh: 他把文件保存到了磁盘上。

zh: 名. 唱片流行音乐节目播音员、唱片骑师
example: The disc jockey played music all night.
example_zh: DJ整晚播放音乐。

zh: 名. 夜总会、迪斯科、的士高
example: She kept dancing at the disco all night.
example_zh: 她整夜在迪斯科舞厅跳舞。

example: We have agreed on the rate of discount.
example_zh: 我们已经同意了折扣率。

example: He was a kind man, as I later discovered.
example_zh: 他是个善良的人，这是我后来发现的。

zh: 名. 发现、被发现的事物
example: We can apply the discovery to various uses.
example_zh: 我们可以把这个发现应用于各种用途。

example: The students discussed the plan for many hours.
example_zh: 学生们讨论这个计划了好几个小时。

example: All we need now is action, not discussion.
example_zh: 我们现在需要的是行动，不是讨论。

example: We should check the spread of the disease.
example_zh: 我们应该控制这种疾病的传播。

example: The TV set into the wall looks disgusting.
example_zh: 嵌在墙里的电视机看起来很恶心。

example: Chicken and chips is my favourite dish.
example_zh: 鸡肉和薯条是我最喜欢的一道菜。

example: Do you want me to run the dishwasher?
example_zh: 你要我开洗碗机吗？

example: Layla had a copy of the program on disk.
example_zh: 莱拉有一份存在磁盘上的程序副本。

example: I dislike living in such a noisy place.
example_zh: 我不喜欢住在这么吵的地方。

zh: 名. 显示、陈列、炫耀；动. 陈列、显示、表现
example: He never made a display of his learning.
example_zh: 他从不炫耀自己的学问。

example: We saw a little light in the distance.
example_zh: 我们看到远处有一点光。

example: This district is known for its beautiful scenery.
example_zh: 这个地区以美丽的风景闻名。

zh: 动. 扰乱、妨碍、使不安
example: I'm sorry to disturb you while you're talking.
example_zh: 抱歉在你讲话的时候打扰你。

zh: 动. 把…突然伸入、跳水、俯冲、猛冲
example: I learnt to dive at the swimming pool.
example_zh: 我在游泳池学会了跳水。

example: I know that Tom is a good diver.
example_zh: 我知道汤姆是个好潜水员。

zh: 动. 分、分开、分裂、分配
example: Let's divide this money between you and me.
example_zh: 我们把这笔钱在你和我之间分了吧。

example: I’ve j oined a diving club.
example_zh: 我加入了一个跳水俱乐部。

zh: 名. 唱片流行音乐节目播音员、唱片骑师
example: The DJ played our favourite song.
example_zh: DJ播放了我们最喜欢的歌。

example: A Japanese would never do such a thing.
example_zh: 一个日本人绝不会做这种事。

example: You should see a doctor about that cough.
example_zh: 你应该就那个咳嗽去看医生。

example: The document was nowhere to be found.
example_zh: 那份文件哪里都找不到。

example: I saw a very interesting documentary yesterday.
example_zh: 我昨天看了一部非常有趣的纪录片。

example: I met a dog on my way home.
example_zh: 我在回家路上遇到一只狗。

zh: 名. 洋娃娃、无头脑的美丽女人
example: The old man gave her a small doll.
example_zh: 那位老人给了她一个小玩偶。

zh: 名. 美元、元(加、澳等国货币单位)
example: The yen is still low against the dollar.
example_zh: 日元对美元仍然很低。

example: The boy considered the dolphin his best friend.
example_zh: 男孩把那只海豚当作他最好的朋友。

zh: 名. 驴子、笨蛋、顽固者
example: That is not a horse, but a donkey.
example_zh: 那不是马，而是一头驴。

example: No wonder you could not open the door.
example_zh: 难怪你打不开门。

example: The remains of human cities dot the Earth.
example_zh: 人类城市的遗迹散布在地球上。

example: Your book is double the size of mine.
example_zh: 你的书是我的书的两倍大。

zh: 名. 怀疑、疑惑；动. 怀疑、不信
example: I doubt that I’ll get the job.
example_zh: 我怀疑我能得到这份工作。

zh: 副. 下、下去、降下；介. 往下、沿着
example: Don't set your failure down to bad luck.
example_zh: 不要把你的失败归因于运气不好。

example: I downloaded the songs from the.
example_zh: 我从那个……下载了这些歌曲。

example: I saw them leave the coffee shop downstairs.
example_zh: 我看见他们离开楼下的咖啡店。

example: We bought the goods at $3 a dozen.
example_zh: 我们以每打3美元的价格买了这些商品。

example: Dr Smith will see you now.
example_zh: 史密斯医生现在要见你。

zh: 动. 拖累、拖拉、沉重缓慢地走
example: I had to drag him out of bed.
example_zh: 我不得不把他从床上拖起来。

example: This drama will be on the air tomorrow.
example_zh: 这部电视剧明天播出。

zh: 动. 拖拉、挨近、领取、拉
example: Some of the students like to draw pictures.
example_zh: 有些学生喜欢画画。

example: I searched the drawer for the key.
example_zh: 我在抽屉里找钥匙。

example: Is this a picture of his own drawing?
example_zh: 这是他自己画的一幅画吗？

zh: 名. 梦、空想、愿望；动. 做梦、想象、梦想
example: Never did I dream of meeting you here.
example_zh: 我做梦也没想到会在这里遇见你。

zh: 名. 服装、覆盖物；动. 给…穿衣、整理、穿着
example: The color ran when the dress was washed.
example_zh: 这条裙子洗的时候掉色了。

zh: 形. 穿好衣服的、打扮好的、去内脏及分割加工好的（特指动物
example: Hurry, you need to get dressed!
example_zh: 快点，你需要穿好衣服！

zh: 名. 饮料、酒；动. 喝、喝酒
example: I went to drink a beer with friends.
example_zh: 我去和朋友们喝了一杯啤酒。

zh: 动. 开车、驱使、推动、猛击
example: I'll teach you how to drive a car.
example_zh: 我会教你怎样开车。

zh: 名. 驾驶员、驱动器、驱动程序
example: The driver turned the wheel to the right.
example_zh: 司机把方向盘向右转。

example: You need a driver's licence to drive a car.
example_zh: 你需要驾照才能开车。

example: She's too young to get a driving licence.
example_zh: 她太年轻了，还不能拿到驾照。

zh: 动. 使滴下、放下、丢失、掉下
example: My old friend dropped in at my house.
example_zh: 我的老朋友顺道来我家做客。

example: There used to be a drugstore on that corner.
example_zh: 那个街角以前有一家药店。

example: They usually drum their fingers at red lights.
example_zh: 他们通常在红灯时用手指敲来敲去。

zh: 形. 干的、无酒的、枯燥无味的；动. 把…弄干、变干
example: The dry season there will set in soon.
example_zh: 那里的旱季很快就要开始了。

example: Have you ever walked like a duck?
example_zh: 你曾经像鸭子一样走路吗？

zh: 形. 到期的、应得的、应付的
example: The next bus is due in five minutes.
example_zh: 下一班公交车预计五分钟后到。

example: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
example_zh: 我们因为准备不足而失败了。

zh: 形. 钝的、无趣的、呆滞的
example: The point of the pencil has become dull.
example_zh: 铅笔尖变钝了。

example: He was very happy during his school days.
example_zh: 他学生时代很快乐。

example: You must keep this machine free from dust.
example_zh: 你必须保持这台机器没有灰尘。

example: Just put it in the dustbin and forget it.
example_zh: 把它放进垃圾桶，别再想它了。

zh: 形. 灰尘多的、无聊的、含糊的
example: The hard candy in this bowl is dusty.
example_zh: 这个碗里的硬糖沾了灰尘。

example: You had better not smoke while on duty.
example_zh: 你值班时最好不要吸烟。

example: We bought perfume at the duty-free shop.
example_zh: 我们在免税店买了香水。

example: The smell was there before you washed the duvet.
example_zh: 你洗被子之前，那股气味就已经在那里了。

zh: abbr. 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）
example: We watch movies on the DVD every Saturday night.
example_zh: 我们每周六晚上用DVD看电影。

example: Never touch the DVD player with wet hands.
example_zh: 千万不要用湿手碰DVD播放机。

example: Each of the students has his own shoes.
example_zh: 每个学生都有自己的鞋。

example: Tell me your story. I am all ears.
example_zh: 告诉我你的故事吧，我洗耳恭听。

example: I don't understand you. I have an earache.
example_zh: 我不明白你的意思。我耳朵疼。

zh: 形. 早的、早熟的；副. 很早、初
example: You should start as early as you can.
example_zh: 你应该尽可能早点开始。

example: The more you earn, the more you spend.
example_zh: 你赚得越多，花得越多。

example: I found the earring that you lost.
example_zh: 我找到了你丢的那只耳环。

example: Seen from a spaceship, the Earth looks blue.
example_zh: 从宇宙飞船上看，地球看起来是蓝色的。

zh: 名. 东方、东；形. 东方的、向东的；副. 向东方、朝东方
example: My uncle lives in the east of Spain.
example_zh: 我叔叔住在西班牙东部。

zh: 形. 东方的、向东的、自东的
example: They lost the war on the eastern front.
example_zh: 他们在东线输掉了战争。

zh: 副. 容易地、轻易地、流利地
example: Begin with such books as you can easily understand.
example_zh: 从你能轻松读懂的书开始。

zh: 形. 容易的、缓缓的、舒适的
example: It is easy for you to solve this problem.
example_zh: 对你来说，解决这个问题很容易。

zh: 形. 脾气随和的、逍遥自在的、悠闲的
example: I didn't think Tom would be so easygoing.
example_zh: 我没想到汤姆会这么随和。

example: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
example_zh: 你本不该吃那么多冰淇淋。

example: I ordered five books on economics from London.
example_zh: 我从伦敦订了五本经济学书。

example: He stood on the edge of the cliff.
example_zh: 他站在悬崖边上。

zh: 名. 教育、训练、教育学
example: My education has made me what I am.
example_zh: 我所受的教育造就了现在的我。

example: The medicine had a wonderful effect on him.
example_zh: 这种药对他有非常好的效果。

zh: 形. 有效率的、能干的
example: The new secretary doesn't strike me as efficient.
example_zh: 新秘书给我的感觉是效率不高。

example: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
example_zh: 你应该努力戒烟。

example: It is about the size of an egg.
example_zh: 它大约有一个鸡蛋那么大。

example: You may choose either of the two books.
example_zh: 你可以选这两本书中的任何一本。

example: I found at my elbow a pretty girl.
example_zh: 我发现自己身边有一个漂亮女孩。

example: My elder brother is really tall, about 1.8m.
example_zh: 我哥哥真的很高，大约1.8米。

zh: 形. 过了中年的、稍老的
example: The bus was empty except for one elderly woman.
example_zh: 公交车上除了一个老妇人，没有别人。

zh: 名. 选举、当选、选择权
example: Who did you vote for in the election?
example_zh: 选举中你投了谁的票？

zh: 形. 电的、导电的、电动的
example: The river furnishes electric power to the town.
example_zh: 这条河为小镇提供电力。

example: There is a fault in the electrical system.
example_zh: 电气系统出了故障。

example: What would our lives be like without electricity?
example_zh: 如果没有电，我们的生活会是什么样？

example: The first electronic computers went into operation in 1945.
example_zh: 第一批电子计算机于1945年开始运行。

example: There used to be an elementary school here.
example_zh: 这里曾经有一所小学。

example: This is how they catch an elephant alive.
example_zh: 这就是他们活捉大象的方法。

example: The elevator seems to be out of order.
example_zh: 电梯好像坏了。

example: You seem to be thinking of something else.
example_zh: 你好像在想别的事情。

example: I just wanted to check my email.
example_zh: 我只是想查看一下我的电子邮件。

example: I was embarrassed when he talked to me.
example_zh: 他和我说话时，我很尴尬。

zh: 形. 令人为难的、麻烦的
example: This is the most embarrassing moment of my life.
example_zh: 这是我一生中最尴尬的时刻。

zh: 名. 大使馆、大使馆全体人员
example: He has access to the American Embassy.
example_zh: 他能进入美国大使馆。

zh: 名. 紧急状况、紧急事件、紧急需要
example: In case of an emergency, call the police.
example_zh: 遇到紧急情况，打电话报警。

zh: 动. 雇用、使用、使从事于
example: I will employ somebody who can speak English.
example_zh: 我会雇用会说英语的人。

zh: 名. 职员、员工、受雇人员
example: Every boss has his or her favorite employee.
example_zh: 每个老板都有自己最喜欢的员工。

example: The employer must provide a safe working environment.
example_zh: 雇主必须提供安全的工作环境。

example: He has been without employment for a month.
example_zh: 他已经一个月没有工作了。

zh: 形. 空的、空虚的、空腹的
example: My life would be completely empty without you.
example_zh: 没有你，我的生活将完全空虚。

example: You must encourage him to try again.
example_zh: 你必须鼓励他再试一次。

zh: 动. 结束、终结、终止；名. 结束、终点、目标
example: The meeting ended at three in the afternoon.
example_zh: 会议在下午三点结束。

example: Is there a happy ending to this story?
example_zh: 这个故事有一个快乐的结局吗？

example: He plans to end up working in Australia.
example_zh: 他打算最终在澳大利亚工作。

example: The army abandoned the town to the enemy.
example_zh: 军队把这座城镇放弃给了敌人。

example: Team sports take a lot of time and.
example_zh: 团队运动要花很多时间和……

zh: 名. 引擎、发动机、机车
example: There must be something wrong with the engine.
example_zh: 发动机一定出问题了。

example: What made Bill decide to be an engineer?
example_zh: 是什么让比尔决定当工程师的？

zh: 名. 工程学、工程、操纵
example: I plan to take up engineering at college.
example_zh: 我打算在大学里学工程学。

example: We have enjoyed peace for more than 40 years.
example_zh: 我们享受和平已经四十多年了。

zh: 形. 可从中得到乐趣的、令人愉快的
example: I had an enjoyable two weeks in London.
example_zh: 我在伦敦度过了愉快的两周。

example: He left his wife an enormous fortune.
example_zh: 他给妻子留下了一大笔财产。

example: You are now old enough to support yourself.
example_zh: 你现在已经够大了，可以自己养活自己了。

example: Why don't you telephone the theatre and enquire about tickets?
example_zh: 你为什么不打电话给剧院问问票的事？

example: I appreciate your answering my enquiry so promptly.
example_zh: 我很感谢你这么快答复我的询问。

zh: 动. 进入、参加、开始、进去
example: Are you going to enter the poster competition?
example_zh: 你打算参加海报比赛吗？

zh: 动. 娱乐、招待、怀抱、款待
example: My cat is very anxious to entertain me.
example_zh: 我的猫非常想逗我开心。

zh: 名. 娱乐、款待、娱乐表演
example: There's no entertainment for young people around here.
example_zh: 这附近没有供年轻人娱乐的活动。

zh: 名. 入口、进入点、入场
example: To her joy, she passed the entrance examination.
example_zh: 令她高兴的是，她通过了入学考试。

example: The police found no sign of forced entry.
example_zh: 警方没有发现强行进入的迹象。

example: Write your name and address on this envelope.
example_zh: 在这个信封上写下你的姓名和地址。

example: Our school is surrounded by a healthy environment.
example_zh: 我们学校周围的环境很健康。

example: Many European people are aware of environmental problems.
example_zh: 许多欧洲人意识到环境问题。

zh: 名. 插曲、插话、有趣的事件
example: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
example_zh: 不过说真的，第21集让我笑得差点哭出来。

zh: 形. 相等的、平等的、胜任的
example: It is believed that all men are equal.
example_zh: 人们认为所有人都是平等的。

example: You need special equipment to go diving.
example_zh: 潜水需要专门的装备。

example: There is an eraser in your pencil case.
example_zh: 你的铅笔盒里有一块橡皮。

zh: 动. 逃避、避免、被…忘掉、逃脱
example: I barely escaped being hit by the truck.
example_zh: 我差点被卡车撞到。

example: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
example_zh: 你尤其不应该空腹喝酒。

example: This essay is about a piece of luggage.
example_zh: 这篇文章是关于一件行李的。

zh: 形. 必要的、重要的、本质的
example: It is essential to reserve your seat in advance.
example_zh: 提前预订座位是必要的。

zh: 名. 欧元（欧盟的统一货币单位）
example: One euro is one-point-five dollars.
example_zh: 一欧元是一点五美元。

zh: 副. 甚至、实际上、完全
example: I usually take a shower in the evening.
example_zh: 我通常在晚上洗澡。

example: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
example_zh: 国王明晚将亲自露面。

zh: 名. 事件、结果、事情的进程
example: The Olympic games is a great event.
example_zh: 奥运会是一项盛大的赛事。

example: Even though they were poor, they were happy.
example_zh: 尽管他们很穷，他们很快乐。

example: Did you ever hear the like of it?
example_zh: 你听说过这样的事吗？

example: Every student has free access to the library.
example_zh: 每个学生都可以免费使用图书馆。

example: Everybody was anxious to know what had happened.
example_zh: 大家都急于知道发生了什么。

example: You have as much right as everyone else.
example_zh: 你和其他人一样有同样的权利。

zh: 代. 每件事物、所有事物
example: People who love doubt nothing, or doubt everything.
example_zh: 恋爱中的人要么什么都不怀疑，要么怀疑一切。

example: Everywhere we went, we enjoyed ourselves a lot.
example_zh: 我们所到之处，都玩得很开心。

zh: 形. 精确的、准确的、精密的
example: I know the exact time when that happened.
example_zh: 我知道那件事发生的确切时间。

zh: 副. 确切地、精确地、恰好
example: That is exactly what I wanted to buy.
example_zh: 那正是我想买的东西。

example: I have a maths examination next Monday.
example_zh: 下周一我有一场数学考试。

zh: 名. 检查人、审查人、主考者
example: Sami is a medical examiner.
example_zh: 萨米是一名法医。

example: Look at the example first.
example_zh: 先看例子。

zh: 形. 优良的、杰出的、出色的
example: Your report is pretty good, if not excellent.
example_zh: 你的报告相当不错，即使算不上优秀。

zh: 连. 只是；介. 除了…之外、若不是、除非
