example: Except for Bill, they were all in time.
example_zh: 除了比尔，他们都准时到了。

zh: 名. 交换、(电话)交换局、交换机
example: What is the exchange rate for dollars now?
example_zh: 现在美元的汇率是多少？

example: The exchange rate isn't great at the moment.
example_zh: 目前的汇率不太好。

zh: 形. 兴奋的、已励磁的、已激发的
example: That was an exciting game. Everybody was excited.
example_zh: 那是一场激动人心的比赛。每个人都很兴奋。

example: In my excitement, I wasn't aware of time.
example_zh: 我太兴奋了，没有注意到时间。

zh: 形. 令人兴奋的、刺激的
example: It is an exciting time of the year.
example_zh: 这是一年中令人兴奋的时期。

zh: 动. 原谅、申辩、做为…的托辞
example: Excuse me for opening your letter by mistake.
example_zh: 请原谅我误开了你的信。

zh: 名. 行使、执行、运动；动. 运用、练习、运动、锻炼
example: He should do more exercise to get fit.
example_zh: 他应该多锻炼来变得健康。

example: I felt exhausted when the game was over.
example_zh: 比赛结束时，我感到筋疲力尽。

zh: 名. 表现、展览会、展览品
example: The exhibition will be open for another month.
example_zh: 展览还将开放一个月。

example: This kind of dog exists only in Japan.
example_zh: 这种狗只存在于日本。

example: In case of fire, please use this exit.
example_zh: 如遇火灾，请使用这个出口。

example: I didn't expect you to turn up here.
example_zh: 我没想到你会在这里出现。

zh: 名. 远征、探险队、迅速
example: I watched the expedition as it set off.
example_zh: 我看着探险队出发。

zh: 形. 贵的、奢华的、费用浩大的
example: The shoes you are wearing look rather expensive.
example_zh: 你穿的鞋看起来相当贵。

example: It was a very good experience for him.
example_zh: 这对他来说是一次非常好的经历。

zh: 形. 富有经验的、老练的、熟练的
example: The British experienced many problems fighting the war.
example_zh: 英国人在打仗时遇到了很多问题。

zh: 名. 实验、试验、实验仪器
example: The science experiment was fun.
example_zh: 那个科学实验很有趣。

example: Even an expert driver can make a mistake.
example_zh: 即使是专业司机也会犯错。

example: I explained to her what the matter was.
example_zh: 我向她解释了是怎么回事。

example: I couldn't think up such a brief explanation.
example_zh: 我想不出这么简短的解释。

zh: 动. 使爆炸、爆炸、爆发、激增
example: The news caused him to explode with anger.
example_zh: 这个消息让他勃然大怒。

example: I would really like to explore this cave.
example_zh: 我真的很想探索这个洞穴。

zh: 名. 探险家、探测者、勘探器
example: This book’s about famous explorers.
example_zh: 这本书讲的是著名探险家。

example: Will there be an extra charge for that?
example_zh: 那个要额外收费吗？

zh: 形. 非常的、特别的、非凡的
example: It was extraordinary that he did not agree.
example_zh: 他竟然不同意，这很不寻常。

example: I was extremely surprised when I saw this.
example_zh: 我看到这个时非常惊讶。

example: What's an extreme sport that you'd like to try?
example_zh: 你想尝试哪项极限运动？

example: A person with weak eyes can't see far.
example_zh: 视力弱的人看不远。

example: He remains calm in the face of danger.
example_zh: 面对危险，他保持冷静。

example: The teacher and I sat face to face.
example_zh: 我和老师面对面坐着。

example: We had a face-to-face meeting last week.
example_zh: 我们上周开了一次面对面的会议。

example: The hotel has excellent facilities.
example_zh: 这家酒店有极好的设施。

zh: 名. 事实、真实性、真相
example: You need not take account of the fact.
example_zh: 你不必考虑这个事实。

zh: 名. 工厂、产生地、代理店
example: It is the factory my brother works in.
example_zh: 这就是我哥哥工作的那家工厂。

zh: 动. 忘记、使…失望、缺乏、失败
example: You worked hard, or you would have failed.
example_zh: 你当时很努力，否则就会失败。

zh: 形. 公平的、按规则进行的、不好不坏的
example: She has fair hair.
example_zh: 她有一头浅色的头发。

zh: 副. 美观地、公平地、相当地
example: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
example_zh: 这个物体的表面相当粗糙。

zh: 名. 落下、瀑布、采伐量；动. 倒下、落下、来临
example: The leaves turn brown in the fall.
example_zh: 秋天树叶会变成褐色。

zh: 形. 错误的、虚伪的、假的
example: What he said turned out to be false.
example_zh: 他说的话结果是假的。

zh: 形. 熟悉的、常见的、亲密的
example: I am familiar with this part of town.
example_zh: 我熟悉镇上的这一带。

example: The whole family set off on the trip.
example_zh: 全家人出发去旅行了。

example: The two sisters became more and more famous.
example_zh: 两姐妹越来越出名了。

example: She’s a football fan.
example_zh: 她是个足球迷。

zh: 动. 想象、设想、相信、幻想
example: Do you fancy going out tonight?
example_zh: 你今晚想出去吗？

zh: 副. 甚远地、很、到很深的程度
example: How far is the next garage?
example_zh: 下一个加油站有多远？

example: The return fare is £26.
example_zh: 往返车费是26英镑。

example: The old farmer did not pay him much money.
example_zh: 那个老农夫没有给他多少钱。

example: I don't think Tom knows anything about farming.
example_zh: 我觉得汤姆对农业一无所知。

example: Here where these houses are used to be farmland.
example_zh: 这些房子所在的地方以前是农田。

example: I can play the piano after a fashion.
example_zh: 我钢琴弹得马马虎虎。

zh: 形. 时髦的、上流社会的、流行的
example: That kind of dress has become quite fashionable.
example_zh: 那种裙子已经很时髦了。

zh: 形. 快速的、紧的；副. 很快地、紧紧地、彻底地
example: Walk fast so as to be in time.
example_zh: 走快点，以便准时到达。

zh: 动. 拴紧、使固定、系、扣紧
example: She advised him to fasten his seat belt.
example_zh: 她建议他系好安全带。

example: Fast food is cheap but not very healthy.
example_zh: 快餐便宜，但不太健康。

zh: 形. 肥的、胖的、油腻的
example: Do more exercise, or you'll get too fat.
example_zh: 多做运动，否则你会变得太胖。

example: The doctor advised my father to stop smoking.
example_zh: 医生建议我爸爸戒烟。

example: It's his greatest fault to be too generous.
example_zh: 他最大的缺点就是太慷慨。

example: When in doubt, in favour of the accused.
example_zh: 有疑问时，要有利于被告。

example: Her favourite food as a child was pizza.
example_zh: 她小时候最喜欢的食物是披萨。

zh: 动. 发传真；名. 传真
example: Fax this to this number in Tokyo, please.
example_zh: 请把这个传真到东京的这个号码。

example: Your words make me fear for my life.
example_zh: 你的话让我担心自己的生命安全。

example: Each member has to pay a membership fee.
example_zh: 每个会员都要交会费。

zh: 动. 喂、饲养、放牧、吃东西
example: We feed our dog three times a day.
example_zh: 我们一天喂狗三次。

zh: 动. 感觉、觉得、触摸、有知觉
example: Not feeling well, I stayed home all day.
example_zh: 我感觉不舒服，就在家待了一整天。

example: Not feeling well, I stayed home all day.
example_zh: 我感觉不舒服，就在家待了一整天。

zh: 动. 摸起来像是…、有…的感觉、想要…
example: I feel like having a cup of tea.
example_zh: 我想喝杯茶。

zh: 形. 女性的、女子的；名. 女性、女人、雌性动物
example: Do you prefer a male or female doctor?
example_zh: 你更喜欢男医生还是女医生？

example: They run a ferry service across the river.
example_zh: 他们经营过河的轮渡服务。

example: The university was alive with a festival.
example_zh: 节日让大学里热闹起来。

zh: 动. 接来、取来、售得、取物
example: Fetch it and put it on the fire.
example_zh: 去把它拿来，放在火上。

example: I think I've got a touch of fever.
example_zh: 我觉得我有点发烧。

zh: 形. 很少的、不多的、少数的
example: You must keep quiet for a few days.
example_zh: 你必须保持安静几天。

example: A new school of fiction has grown up.
example_zh: 一种新的小说流派已经兴起。

example: Many scientists are working in this field.
example_zh: 许多科学家在这个领域工作。

zh: 名. 打架、争吵、斗志；动. 对抗、打架
example: Unless you stop fighting, I'll call the police.
example_zh: 除非你们停止打架，否则我就叫警察。

example: I can't figure out why she didn't come.
example_zh: 我想不明白她为什么没来。

zh: 名. 档案、公文箱、文件夹
example: In which folder did you save the file?
example_zh: 你把文件保存在哪个文件夹里了？

zh: 动. 装满、填充、弥漫、充满
example: I'll find someone to fill in for you.
example_zh: 我会找个人代替你。

example: I filled in my name on the paper.
example_zh: 我在纸上填写了我的名字。

zh: 动. 填补、装满、装满油
example: He filled up the car with petrol.
example_zh: 他给汽车加满了汽油。

zh: 名. 软片、薄膜、胶卷；动. 覆以薄膜、拍摄、生薄膜、拍电影
example: We saw the film and had dinner together.
example_zh: 我们看了那部电影，还一起吃了晚饭。

zh: 名. 电影摄制者，电影导演，电影制作人
example: She is a young film maker from Spain.
example_zh: 她是一位来自西班牙的年轻电影制作人。

example: The girls are wild about the film star.
example_zh: 女孩们对那位电影明星非常着迷。

zh: 形. 最后的、终极的、决定性的
example: The final score of the game was 3 to 1.
example_zh: 比赛的最终比分是3比1。

example: We considered going, but finally decided against it.
example_zh: 我们考虑过要去，但最后决定不去了。

example: You can't count on him for financial help.
example_zh: 你不能指望他提供经济上的帮助。

zh: 动. 发现、感到、找到、裁决
example: I found my keys under the sofa.
example_zh: 我在沙发下面找到了我的钥匙。

example: I want to find out more about this school.
example_zh: 我想了解更多关于这所学校的情况。

zh: 形. 好的、晴朗的、健康的
example: It will be fine weather tomorrow, perhaps.
example_zh: 明天也许会是好天气。

zh: 名. 手指、指状物、(手套的)手指部分
example: He stood with his finger in his mouth.
example_zh: 他站着，把手指放在嘴里。

example: I will have finished my homework by Tuesday.
example_zh: 到星期二我就会完成作业了。

example: There was a big fire in my neighborhood.
example_zh: 我家附近发生了一场大火。

example: My dream is to be a firefighter.
example_zh: 我的梦想是成为一名消防员。

zh: 名. 烟火具、烟火、烟火信号弹
example: The children were excited by the fireworks display.
example_zh: 孩子们对烟花表演感到很兴奋。

example: He works for a small firm in London.
example_zh: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。

zh: 副. 首先、第一、优先；形. 第一的
example: I'll speak to him at the first opportunity.
example_zh: 我一有机会就会和他谈。

example: My first name is Anna and my family name is Smith.
example_zh: 我的名字叫安娜，姓史密斯。

zh: 名. 鱼、鱼肉、鱼类；动. 钓、钓鱼、查出、捕鱼
example: How is it going in the fish market?
example_zh: 鱼市场里情况怎么样？

example: Not really. I like hiking better than fishing.
example_zh: 不太喜欢。比起钓鱼，我更喜欢徒步。

zh: 形. 适宜的、对的、准备好的
example: I joined a gym to get fit.
example_zh: 我加入了一家健身房来健身。

example: Many fitness classes are available at the gym.
example_zh: 这家健身房提供许多健身课程。

zh: 动. 使固定、修理、准备、固定
example: Let's get you fixed up with a drink.
example_zh: 我们来给你弄杯饮料吧。

example: The French flag is blue, white and red.
example_zh: 法国国旗是蓝、白、红三色。

zh: 名. 扁平物、平面、平地
example: Please drink the beer before it goes flat.
example_zh: 请在啤酒没气之前把它喝掉。

zh: 名. 味、调味香料、滋味
example: My mother's cake always has a great flavour.
example_zh: 我妈妈做的蛋糕总是味道很好。

example: I was just in time for the flight.
example_zh: 我刚好赶上航班。

zh: 动. 使漂浮、容纳、淹没、浮动
example: He was the first man to float in space.
example_zh: 他是第一个在太空漂浮的人。

zh: 名. 洪水、大量之水、涨潮；动. 淹没、使泛滥、注满、被淹
example: The bridge was carried away by the flood.
example_zh: 那座桥被洪水冲走了。

zh: 名. 地板、楼层、底部、地面
example: The bedrooms are on the first floor.
example_zh: 卧室在二楼。

example: He bought a lot of flour and oil.
example_zh: 他买了很多面粉和油。

zh: 动. 使流动、淹没、流出、流动
example: The river flows into the Sea of Japan.
example_zh: 这条河流入日本海。

zh: 名. 花、开花植物、精华
example: There is a flower shop near by.
example_zh: 附近有一家花店。

zh: 名. 流感、流行性感冒
example: There's a lot of flu going around now.
example_zh: 现在流感很流行。

example: Now, I'm going mad to play the flute.
example_zh: 现在，我疯狂地想吹长笛。

zh: 动. 飞、飞越、使飘扬、飞翔
example: We flew to Paris, where we stayed a week.
example_zh: 我们飞往巴黎，在那里待了一周。

zh: 动. 栈底、标准二进制、减
example: Let's focus on the main problem.
example_zh: 让我们把注意力集中在主要问题上。

zh: 名. 雾、迷惑、(割后的)最生草
example: London is no longer a city of fog.
example_zh: 伦敦不再是雾都了。

example: It's too foggy. I can't see a thing.
example_zh: 雾太大了。我什么也看不见。

zh: 动. 折叠、包、合拢、折叠起来
example: Her fingers were too weak to fold it.
example_zh: 她的手指太没力气，无法把它折起来。

zh: 名. 文件夹、折纸机、折叠式书本
example: I will give you a large folder.
example_zh: 我会给你一个大文件夹。

zh: 形. 民间的；名. 人们、家人、亲属
example: I don't like all of these folk songs.
example_zh: 这些民歌我并不全都喜欢。

zh: 动. 跟随、沿行、遵循、接着
example: You may as well follow your father's advice.
example_zh: 你不妨听你爸爸的建议。

example: I'd like to discuss the following at the meeting.
example_zh: 我想在会议上讨论以下内容。

zh: 形. 喜欢的、宠爱的、温柔的
example: She is very fond of her old bike.
example_zh: 她很喜欢她那辆旧自行车。

example: We went into a shop to get some food.
example_zh: 我们进了一家商店买些食物。

zh: 名. 愚人、受骗者、奶油拌水果
example: What a fool he is to leave school.
example_zh: 他离开学校真是太傻了。

example: The boy stepped on my foot on purpose.
example_zh: 那个男孩故意踩了我的脚。

example: The football game is now on the air.
example_zh: 足球比赛现在正在播出。

zh: 名. 足球员、足球选手
example: Tom will be a good footballer one day.
example_zh: 汤姆总有一天会成为一名优秀的足球运动员。

example: My cousin wants to be a football player.
example_zh: 我的表兄弟想当一名足球运动员。

example: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
example_zh: 不知为什么，我在晚上感觉更有活力。

zh: 形. 被禁止的、严禁的
example: I am forbidden to stay out after 10 o'clock.
example_zh: 我被禁止在10点以后待在外面。

example: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.
example_zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。

zh: 形. 外国的、外交的、外省的
example: To speak a foreign language well takes time.
example_zh: 要讲好一门外语需要时间。

example: The foreigner soon got used to Japanese food.
example_zh: 那个外国人很快就习惯了日本食物。

example: The boy lost his way in the forest.
example_zh: 那个男孩在森林里迷路了。

example: I will keep this experience in mind forever.
example_zh: 我会永远记住这次经历。

example: He will probably forget to return my book.
example_zh: 他可能会忘记还我的书。

example: Please forgive me for not having written sooner.
example_zh: 请原谅我没有早点写信。

zh: 名. 叉子、叉状物、分岔
example: I took the right fork of the road.
example_zh: 我走了右边的那条岔路。

zh: 名. 形状、形体、类型、表单
example: We came together to form a group.
example_zh: 我们聚在一起组成了一个小组。

example: I shook hands with the former student.
example_zh: 我和那位以前的学生握了手。

example: There is a bike for sale in the shop window.
example_zh: 商店橱窗里有一辆自行车出售。

example: We can be there in about a fortnight.
example_zh: 我们大约两星期后能到那里。

example: Fortunately, there is an elevator in our hotel.
example_zh: 幸运的是，我们酒店里有电梯。

example: He took a step forward.
example_zh: 他向前迈了一步。

example: My father gave me a new fountain pen.
example_zh: 我父亲给了我一支新钢笔。

example: The frame of the building is now complete.
example_zh: 这座大楼的框架现在完工了。

zh: 形. 自由的、享受政治权力的、允许的；副. 自由地、免费
example: I got a free ticket to the match.
example_zh: 我得到了一张比赛的免费票。

zh: 动. 使结冰、使冻住、使呆住、冻结
example: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
example_zh: 气温已经连续几天在零度以下。

zh: 名. 冰库、冰箱、冷冻库
example: The new employee locked herself in the freezer.
example_zh: 那名新员工把自己锁在冷冻室里了。

zh: 形. 冰冻的、冷冻用的、严寒的
example: Thousands of people sleep rough in the freezing cold.
example_zh: 成千上万的人在严寒中露宿街头。

example: I'm going to order some more french fries.
example_zh: 我要再点一些炸薯条。

zh: 形. 时常发生的、频繁的、快速的
example: I came into frequent contact with foreign students.
example_zh: 我经常和外国学生接触。

example: He makes careless mistakes, and does so frequently.
example_zh: 他会犯粗心的错误，而且经常这样。

zh: 形. 新鲜的、新奇的、另外的
example: The river was alive with fresh water fish.
example_zh: 这条河里满是淡水鱼。

example: There is no meat left in the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱里没有剩下的肉了。

example: After that English exam, my brain is fried.
example_zh: 那场英语考试之后，我的脑子累坏了。

zh: 名. 朋友、支持者、赞助者
example: It’s easy for her make friends.
example_zh: 她交朋友很容易。

zh: 形. 友好的、亲切的、互助的
example: The girl was friendly with a bright smile.
example_zh: 那个女孩待人友好，笑容灿烂。

example: Finally, their friendship ended and their close relationship disappeared.
example_zh: 最后，他们的友谊结束了，他们亲密的关系也消失了。

example: It wasn't until then that I felt really frightened.
example_zh: 直到那时我才真正感到害怕。

zh: 形. 受惊吓的、受惊的、(非正式)害怕…的
example: She was frightened to see the black cat.
example_zh: 她看到那只黑猫很害怕。

zh: 形. 令人恐惧的、引起突然惊恐的
example: I've never heard of such a frightening story before.
example_zh: 我以前从未听说过这么可怕的故事。

example: The boy threw a stone at the frog.
example_zh: 男孩朝青蛙扔了一块石头。

example: Why did you absent yourself from class yesterday?
example_zh: 你昨天为什么缺课？

example: The number of the front desk is No 1.
example_zh: 前台的编号是1号。

zh: 形. 冻结的、冰冷的、严寒的
example: How long can we keep this frozen food?
example_zh: 这种冷冻食品我们能保存多久？

example: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
example_zh: 西红柿是蔬菜，不是水果。

example: After that English exam, my brain is fried.
example_zh: 那场英语考试之后，我的脑子累坏了。

zh: 名. 煎锅、长柄平底锅
example: Out of the frying pan, into the fire.
example_zh: 刚出煎锅，又入火坑。

example: We're running short of fuel for the winter.
example_zh: 我们过冬的燃料快不够了。

zh: 形. 充满的、完全的、丰富的
example: It has been raining a full five days.
example_zh: 雨已经下了整整五天。

example: All of these sentences need a full stop.
example_zh: 所有这些句子都需要一个句号。

zh: 副. 专职、全部工作时间的、全日制
example: I had a full time job with him.
example_zh: 我曾和他一起做一份全职工作。

zh: 形. 全部时间的、专任的
example: She works full-time at the hospital.
example_zh: 她在医院做全职工作。

zh: 副. 十分地、完全地、充分地
example: I am fully satisfied with my new house.
example_zh: 我对我的新房子完全满意。

zh: 形. 供娱乐用的；名. 乐趣、玩笑、娱乐
example: It's easier to have fun than to work.
example_zh: 玩比干活容易。

zh: 形. 好笑的、有趣的、滑稽的
example: The movie was less funny than the book.
example_zh: 这部电影没有那本书那么好笑。

example: She had to part with her fur coat.
example_zh: 她不得不舍弃她的毛皮大衣。

example: There is too much furniture in the house.
example_zh: 房子里家具太多了。

zh: 形. 更远的、此外的、更多的
example: Do you have any further questions to ask?
example_zh: 你还有什么问题要问吗？

zh: 形. 最远的、最遥远的
example: He's the furthest thing from my mind.
example_zh: 我根本没在想他。

example: Tell me about your program for the future.
example_zh: 告诉我你未来的计划。

zh: 动. 得到、增进、赚到、获利
example: I don't think you can gain his ear.
example_zh: 我觉得你没法让他听你说话。

zh: 名. 狂风、大风、定期租金
example: The roof was torn off by the gale.
example_zh: 屋顶被狂风吹掉了。

zh: 名. 走廊、最高楼座、画廊
example: Better drop by his gallery if you have time.
example_zh: 如果有时间，最好顺便去他的画廊看看。

example: I'm glad that your team won the game.
example_zh: 我很高兴你们队赢了比赛。

example: The age gap between them is rather large.
example_zh: 他们之间的年龄差距相当大。

zh: 名. 车库、汽车修理厂、机库
example: The car is in front of the garage.
example_zh: 车在车库前面。

example: You've been properly led up the garden path.
example_zh: 你被彻底骗了。

example: Garlic is used to improve the taste of food.
example_zh: 大蒜用来给食物提味。

example: This gas gives off a bad smell.
example_zh: 这种气体散发出难闻的气味。

example: My brother is working at a gas station.
example_zh: 我哥哥在一家加油站工作。

example: A taxi drew up at the main gate.
example_zh: 一辆出租车在大门口停了下来。

zh: 形. 全面的、大体的、总的
example: People in general are against the new law.
example_zh: 人们普遍反对这项新法律。

zh: 副. 通常、逐渐地、普遍地
example: I generally get home about 7.00.
example_zh: 我通常大约7点到家。

zh: 形. 慷慨的、有雅量的、大量的
example: You should not play on his generous nature.
example_zh: 你不应该利用他的慷慨。

example: This child is as gentle as a lamb today.
example_zh: 这个孩子今天像小羊一样温顺。

example: The geography book he put under the pillow.
example_zh: 他把那本地理书放在枕头下面。

zh: 动. 得到、获得、变成、到达
example: You ought to get to work on time.
example_zh: 你应该准时上班。

example: How do you get along with Harry?
example_zh: 你和哈里相处得怎么样？

example: Get down at once!
example_zh: 立刻下来！

zh: 动. 健身、把身体练好
example: He runs every day to get fit.
example_zh: 他每天跑步来保持健康。

example: Can you get in through the window?
example_zh: 你能从窗户进去吗？

zh: 动. 生活、融洽相处、进展
example: I get on well with my classmates.
example_zh: 我和同学们相处得很好。

example: Have you got rid of those old.
example_zh: 你已经把那些旧的丢掉了吗？

zh: 动. (使)起床、(使)起立、(使)爬上
example: I get up at seven every morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上七点起床。

example: The giant was not loved by anybody.
example_zh: 没有人爱那个巨人。

example: That child was happy to get the gift.
example_zh: 那个孩子收到礼物很高兴。

example: What do we really know about giraffes?
example_zh: 我们对长颈鹿到底了解多少？

example: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
example_zh: 你本应该向那个女孩介绍你自己。

example: To tell the truth, she is my girlfriend.
example_zh: 说实话，她是我的女朋友。

zh: 动. 给、授予、供给、捐赠
example: If you are free, give me a hand.
example_zh: 如果你有空，帮我一把。

example: I’ll give them back to you tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天会把它们还给你。

example: Have you given in your homework yet?
example_zh: 你已经交作业了吗？

example: Will you give out these papers for me,.
example_zh: 你能帮我发这些试卷吗？

example: Has David given up playing tennis?
example_zh: 大卫已经放弃打网球了吗？

zh: 形. 高兴的、喜欢的、情愿的
example: I was glad to hear of your success.
example_zh: 听到你成功的消息，我很高兴。

zh: 动. 扫视、反射、使掠过、闪光
example: At a glance I knew that he was tired.
example_zh: 我一眼就看出他累了。

zh: 名. 玻璃、玻璃杯、透镜
example: I'd like to have a glass of wine.
example_zh: 我想要一杯葡萄酒。

zh: 名. 眼镜、双筒望远镜、玻璃
example: I don't have to wear glasses any more.
example_zh: 我不再需要戴眼镜了。

example: I'm worried about the global warming trend.
example_zh: 我担心全球变暖的趋势。

example: A pair of gloves is a nice gift.
example_zh: 一副手套是件不错的礼物。

zh: 动. 以…打赌、对付、忍受、去
example: I wonder how long it's going to take.
example_zh: 我想知道这要花多长时间。

example: For today's match, Tom is the goalkeeper.
example_zh: 今天的比赛，汤姆是守门员。

zh: 名. 山羊、替罪羊、色鬼
example: It's a goat and it is absolutely normal.
example_zh: 这是一只山羊，它完全正常。

zh: 动. 去找、努力获取、被认为
example: He went for the job.
example_zh: 他去申请那份工作了。

zh: 形. 金的、含金的、金色的
example: He received a golden watch as a prize.
example_zh: 他得到了一块金色手表作为奖品。

example: I'd like to play a game of golf.
example_zh: 我想打一场高尔夫球。

zh: 形. 好的、优良的、上等的
example: You have a good chance to get well.
example_zh: 你很有机会康复。

example: Good afternoon, how can I help you?
example_zh: 下午好，我能帮您什么？

example: He left without so much as saying goodbye.
example_zh: 他连再见都没说就走了。

example: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the show.
example_zh: 大家晚上好，欢迎来到演出。

zh: 形. 相貌好看的、吸引人的
example: Her brother is tall and good-looking.
example_zh: 她哥哥又高又帅。

example: Good morning, Mrs Brown. How are you today?
example_zh: 早上好，布朗太太。您今天怎么样？

example: Good night, sleep well.
example_zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

example: The goods will be sold on the spot.
example_zh: 这些货物将当场出售。

example: They went off to Australia.
example_zh: 他们动身去了澳大利亚。

zh: 动. 继续下去、过去、发生
example: The meeting went on until six o'clock.
example_zh: 会议一直开到六点。

example: Are you going out this evening?
example_zh: 你今晚要出去吗？

example: She must have been gorgeous in her youth.
example_zh: 她年轻时一定很漂亮。

example: This government is really putting the clock back.
example_zh: 这个政府真的在开倒车。

zh: 动. 以…打赌、对付、忍受、去
example: I wonder how long it's going to take.
example_zh: 我想知道这要花多长时间。

zh: 名. 毕业生、量杯；动. 准予…毕业、授予…学位、分等级、毕业
example: I hope to graduate from university next spring.
example_zh: 我希望明年春天大学毕业。

zh: 名. 毕业、得学位、分划
example: Father gave me a book for graduation.
example_zh: 父亲送给我一本书作为毕业礼物。

example: Add two hundred grams of sugar to the cake.
example_zh: 往蛋糕里加两百克糖。

example: He teaches English grammar at a high school.
example_zh: 他在一所高中教英语语法。

example: The child of a child is a grandchild.
example_zh: 孩子的孩子就是孙子或孙女。

example: My grandad tells very funny stories.
example_zh: 我爷爷讲非常有趣的故事。

example: Along comes the grandmother and sees her granddaughter.
example_zh: 奶奶走过来，看见了她的孙女。

example: My grandfather is a bit hard of hearing.
example_zh: 我爷爷听力有点不好。

example: My grandma injured her leg in a fall.
example_zh: 我奶奶摔了一跤，把腿弄伤了。

example: My grandmother gave me more than I wanted.
example_zh: 我奶奶给我的比我想要的多。

zh: 名. 爷爷、老太爷、外公
example: How are Grandma and Grandpa cooking the fish?
example_zh: 爷爷奶奶正在怎么做鱼？

example: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
example_zh: 我和妈妈、兄弟还有爷爷奶奶一起住。

example: Being with her grandson always makes her happy.
example_zh: 和孙子在一起总是让她很开心。

zh: 名. 奶奶、老奶奶、老婆婆
example: Granny, could you tell me one more story?
example_zh: 奶奶，你能再给我讲一个故事吗？

zh: 名. 授予、授予物、允许
example: He was given a grant to study in.
example_zh: 他获得了一笔用于学习的助学金。

example: Mother sent us grapes packed in a box.
example_zh: 妈妈给我们寄来了装在盒子里的葡萄。

zh: 名. 制图法、制图学、图解算法
example: Last night, my graphics card kicked the bucket.
example_zh: 昨晚，我的显卡坏了。

example: We laid the injured man on the grass.
example_zh: 我们把受伤的男子平放在草地上。

zh: 形. 感谢的、感激的、令人快意的
example: I am grateful to you for your help.
example_zh: 我非常感谢你的帮助。

zh: 形. 大的、非常的、主要的
example: You are the great love of my life.
example_zh: 你是我一生中最爱的人。

zh: 形. 绿色的、未成熟的、新鲜的
example: The house whose roof is green is mine.
example_zh: 屋顶是绿色的那座房子是我的。

example: He rose to his feet to greet me.
example_zh: 他站起来迎接我。

example: Every year we receive greeting cards painted by mouth.
example_zh: 每年我们都会收到用嘴画的贺卡。

zh: 形. 灰色的；名. 灰色
example: The grey cat can't climb off the tree.
example_zh: 那只灰猫没法从树上爬下来。

zh: 名. 烤架、铁格子、烤肉；动. 烧、烤、严加盘问
example: When was the last time you grilled meat?
example_zh: 你上次烤肉是什么时候？

zh: 形. 烤的、炙过的、有格子的
example: When was the last time you grilled meat?
example_zh: 你上次烤肉是什么时候？

example: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
example_zh: 请告诉我们哪里有杂货店。

example: The bride and groom kissed when the ceremony ended.
example_zh: 仪式结束时，新娘和新郎亲吻了。

example: The old man fell down on the ground.
example_zh: 那位老人摔倒在地上。

example: The group is made up of six members.
example_zh: 这个小组由六名成员组成。

zh: 动. 种植、使长满、生长、变成
example: You must not smoke till you grow up.
example_zh: 你长大以前不可以吸烟。

example: What do you want to be when you grow up?
example_zh: 你长大后想做什么？

zh: 名. 守卫者、警戒、护卫队
example: Be on your guard against running into debt.
example_zh: 要小心，别欠债。

example: I guess there was some talk of that.
example_zh: 我猜有人谈论过那件事。

example: There are five other guests at the hotel.
example_zh: 酒店里还有另外五位客人。

zh: 名. 高级寄宿舍、宾馆、招待所
example: We stayed in a small guest-house by the sea.
example_zh: 我们住在海边的一家小旅馆里。

zh: 名. 引导者、导游、指南
example: The guide told the kids not to take pictures.
example_zh: 导游告诉孩子们不要拍照。

zh: 形. 有指导的、有向导的
example: I am going on a guided tour.
example_zh: 我要去参加有导游的游览。

example: This guidebook might be useful on your trip.
example_zh: 这本旅行指南可能对你的旅行有用。

zh: 形. 犯罪的、有过失的、自觉有错的
example: I'm sure he is guilty of the murder.
example_zh: 我确信他犯了谋杀罪。

example: The boy playing the guitar is my brother.
example_zh: 那个弹吉他的男孩是我兄弟。

example: The guitarist in Tom's band isn't too bad.
example_zh: 汤姆乐队里的吉他手还不错。

zh: 名. 树胶、橡皮、橡皮糖
example: Gum got stuck to the bottom of my shoe.
example_zh: 口香糖粘在我鞋底上了。

example: The man shot three birds with a gun.
example_zh: 那个男人用枪射了三只鸟。

example: He’s a really nice guy.
example_zh: 他人真的很好。

zh: 名. +体育馆、体育训练、体育课
example: This hotel has a gym and a swimming pool.
example_zh: 这家酒店有健身房和游泳池。

example: Ziri wanted to be really good at gymnastics.
example_zh: 齐里想把体操练得非常好。

example: You must get rid of that bad habit.
example_zh: 你必须改掉那个坏习惯。

example: Young people wear their hair long these days.
example_zh: 现在年轻人留长发。

zh: 名. 理发、(男子的)发式
example: You need not have a haircut this week.
example_zh: 你这周不必理发。

example: Once a month, I go to the hairdresser.
example_zh: 我每个月去一次理发店。

example: Layla sat underneath the hairdryer for an hour.
example_zh: 莱拉在美发吹风机下坐了一个小时。

zh: 名. 一半、半场、不完全
example: We sat up half the night just talking.
example_zh: 我们熬了半夜，只是在聊天。

example: These shoes are half-price this week.
example_zh: 这双鞋这周半价。

example: There was a large crowd in the hall.
example_zh: 大厅里有一大群人。

example: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?
example_zh: 你还没洗手，对吧？

example: This is the handbag I bought in Italy.
example_zh: 这是我在意大利买的手提包。

zh: 形. 手提式的、便携式的、掌上型的
example: The game works on a hand-held device.
example_zh: 这个游戏在手持设备上运行。

example: No one but Tom handed in the report.
example_zh: 除了汤姆，没人交报告。

example: He picked up a handkerchief from the floor.
example_zh: 他从地板上捡起一块手帕。

zh: 动. 触摸、运用、买卖、搬运
example: It all depends how you handle it.
example_zh: 这完全取决于你如何处理它。

zh: 名. （自行车等的）把手、手把、八字胡
example: The handlebars on your bike are too low.
example_zh: 你自行车的车把太低了。

zh: 动. 把…拿出来、分发、施舍
example: Don't stick your hand out of the window.
example_zh: 不要把手伸出窗外。

zh: 形. 英俊的、大方的、慷慨的
example: His new job brought him a handsome income.
example_zh: 他的新工作给他带来了可观的收入。

example: There is need for improvement in your handwriting.
example_zh: 你的书写需要改进。

zh: 动. 悬挂、附着、装饰、悬着
example: There was a lamp hanging above the table.
example_zh: 桌子上方挂着一盏灯。

example: I don't want you hanging out with Tom.
example_zh: 我不想让你和汤姆一起出去玩。

zh: 动. 挂断、拖延、把…挂起来
example: She hung up at the end of the phone.
example_zh: 她在通话结束时挂了电话。

example: I'll always love you, no matter what happens.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都会永远爱你。

zh: 形. 快乐的、幸福的、愉快的
example: Though she is rich, she is not happy.
example_zh: 虽然她很有钱，但她不快乐。

zh: 副. 幸福地、快乐地、幸好
example: We must keep the law to live happily.
example_zh: 我们必须遵守法律才能幸福地生活。

example: I wish you great happiness in your marriage.
example_zh: 祝你婚姻幸福美满。

example: The tram goes from the station to the harbour.
example_zh: 电车从车站开往港口。

zh: 形. 坚硬的、硬的、难的；副. 坚硬地、努力地、辛苦地
example: You must study hard and learn many things.
example_zh: 你必须努力学习，学很多东西。

zh: 副. 刚刚、几乎不、勉强是
example: Hardly ever have we seen such a night!
example_zh: 我们几乎从未见过这样的夜晚！

zh: 名. 硬件、五金器具、零件
example: You will find this in a hardware store.
example_zh: 你会在五金店找到这个。

example: It is too small a hat for you.
example_zh: 这顶帽子对你来说太小了。

example: I would hate to become just a housewife.
example_zh: 我不想只成为一个家庭主妇。

zh: 助. 已经；动. 有、怀有、拿
example: I don't know if I have the time.
example_zh: 我不知道我有没有时间。

zh: 助. 必须、不得不、非得
example: I have got to go home now.
example_zh: 我现在得回家了。

zh: 助. 不得不、只好、只得
example: You have to wear a uniform at my school.
example_zh: 在我学校，你必须穿校服。

example: He told me the story of his life.
example_zh: 他给我讲了他一生的故事。

example: In a crisis you must keep your head.
example_zh: 在危机中你必须保持冷静。

zh: 名. 头痛、令人头痛之事
example: The patient is always complaining of a headache.
example_zh: 这个病人总是抱怨头痛。

zh: 名. 大标题、新闻摘要
example: The headline caught my eye this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，那个标题吸引了我的注意。

zh: 名. 听筒、耳机、头戴式受话器
example: When I'm using headphones I can't hear anything.
example_zh: 我用耳机时什么也听不见。

example: Tell that to the headteacher, or the acting headteacher.
example_zh: 把这件事告诉校长，或者代理校长。

example: You had better give up smoking for your health.
example_zh: 为了健康，你最好戒烟。

zh: 形. 健康的、有益健康的、卫生的
example: This boy has a strong and healthy body.
example_zh: 这个男孩身体强壮又健康。

zh: 动. 听到、倾听、听说、听见
example: I am glad to hear of your success.
example_zh: 听到你成功的消息，我很高兴。

example: I can bear this broken heart no longer.
example_zh: 我再也承受不了这颗破碎的心了。

example: The iron broke down due to over-heating.
example_zh: 熨斗因为过热而坏了。

zh: 名. 加热器、灯丝、加热工
example: This heater won't heat up that large room.
example_zh: 这个取暖器没法让那个大房间变暖。

zh: 名. 加热、供热、暖气设备
example: Can you turn the heating on?
example_zh: 你能把暖气打开吗？

zh: 形. 重的、巨大的、沉重的
example: The heavy snow kept us from going out.
example_zh: 大雪使我们无法外出。

example: I can’t walk in high heels.
example_zh: 我不能穿高跟鞋走路。

example: The new houses are of a uniform height.
example_zh: 这些新房子都一样高。

example: The president is flying into town by helicopter.
example_zh: 总统正乘直升机飞抵城里。

example: Please say hello to your wife for me.
example_zh: 请代我向你妻子问好。

example: You had better put on your crash helmet.
example_zh: 你最好戴上你的防撞头盔。

zh: 动. 帮助、帮忙、接济、有用；名. 帮忙、帮助者、补救办法
example: Call me if you need any help.
example_zh: 如果你需要任何帮助，就打电话给我。

example: You are to apologize to her for it.
example_zh: 你必须为此向她道歉。

example: Does Tom still have an herb garden?
example_zh: 汤姆还有香草园吗？

zh: 副. 在这里、此时、这里
example: You had better stay here a little longer.
example_zh: 你最好在这里多待一会儿。

zh: 名. 英雄、超越常人者、男主角
example: I don't like a novel without a hero.
example_zh: 我不喜欢没有主人公的小说。

zh: 名. 巾帼英雄、烈妇、女主角
example: The heroine of this story is a young.
example_zh: 这个故事的女主角很年轻。

example: His story is much more interesting than hers.
example_zh: 他的故事比她的有趣得多。

example: She looks as if she's laughing to herself.
example_zh: 她看起来好像在暗自笑。

example: Hey, come on. Don't make a face.
example_zh: 嘿，来吧。别做鬼脸。

example: I won't lower myself to his level.
example_zh: 我不会把自己降到他的水平。

example: Now the mountain is hidden by the clouds.
example_zh: 现在山被云遮住了。

zh: 动. 藏、隐瞒、遮避、躲藏
example: The child was hiding behind a big tree.
example_zh: 那个孩子正躲在一棵大树后面。

zh: 形. 高的、高级的、主要的
example: It is high time you started a new business.
example_zh: 你该开始做新生意了。

example: The high jump will be the last event.
example_zh: 跳高将是最后一个项目。

zh: 动. 使高涨、拉起、步行、徒步旅行
example: Not really. I like hiking better than fishing.
example_zh: 不太喜欢。比起钓鱼，我更喜欢徒步。

zh: 名. 小山、丘陵、小土堆
example: That church on the hill is very old.
example_zh: 山上的那座教堂很古老。

example: I think you had better call on him.
example_zh: 我觉得你最好去拜访他。

example: He has said so himself to my knowledge.
example_zh: 据我所知，他自己这么说过。

example: My brother loves hip hop music.
example_zh: 我哥哥喜欢嘻哈音乐。

zh: 动. 雇请、出租、受雇；名. 租金、租用、雇用
example: If you are honest, I will hire you.
example_zh: 如果你诚实，我就雇用你。

example: While eating a pizza he was annoying his sister.
example_zh: 他一边吃披萨，一边惹他姐姐生气。

zh: 形. 历史上著名的、有历史性的
example: A large number of people visit the historic site.
example_zh: 很多人参观这个历史遗址。

zh: 形. 历史的、史实的、历史上的
example: He will be reading a historical novel.
example_zh: 他将会在读一本历史小说。

example: We are very interested in the history.
example_zh: 我们对历史很感兴趣。

zh: 动. 打、打击、碰撞、打中
example: We hit the right road in the dark.
example_zh: 我们在黑暗中走对了路。

zh: 动. 要求(搭便车)、搭便车
example: I'm planning to hitchhike to Boston.
example_zh: 我打算搭便车去波士顿。

example: Do you have a hobby - for example, painting?
example_zh: 你有爱好吗——比如画画？

example: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
example_zh: 曲棍球在中国不太受欢迎。

zh: 动. 保存、握住、拿住、支持
example: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
example_zh: 你得学会管住自己的嘴。

zh: 动. 举起、支撑、继续下去
example: He was held up in the heavy traffic for.
example_zh: 他因交通拥堵而被耽搁了。

example: Look out! There's a hole in the road.
example_zh: 小心！路上有个洞。

example: You are in need of a holiday.
example_zh: 你需要一个假期。

zh: 名. 家、避难所、故乡；副. 在家、在本国、打中目标地
example: You'd better go home as soon as possible.
example_zh: 你最好尽快回家。

example: Your website's homepage is very beautiful.
example_zh: 你网站的首页非常漂亮。

zh: 名. 家庭作业、家里做的工作
example: I have a lot of homework to do.
example_zh: 我有很多作业要做。

zh: 形. 诚实的、坦直的、可靠的
example: It's not easy being honest all the time.
example_zh: 一直诚实并不容易。

example: I honestly don’t know where she is.
example_zh: 说实话，我真的不知道她在哪里。

example: Sorry honey, I'm still stuck at the office.
example_zh: 对不起，亲爱的，我还在办公室脱不开身。

example: Mr. and Mrs. West are on their honeymoon.
example_zh: 韦斯特夫妇正在度蜜月。

example: Yanni wore a dark hoodie covering his head.
example_zh: 雅尼穿着一件深色连帽衫，帽子遮住了他的头。

example: I hope that you will get well soon.
example_zh: 我希望你早日康复。

zh: 形. 有希望的、怀抱希望的、保持乐观的
example: A hopeful wish comes through in a dream.
example_zh: 一个满怀希望的愿望在梦中实现了。

zh: 副. 有希望地、如果希望能实现的话
example: Hopefully the journey won’t take long.
example_zh: 希望这段旅程不会花很长时间。

zh: 形. 无希望的、绝望的、不可救药的
example: By the way, my English is absolutely hopeless.
example_zh: 顺便说一下，我的英语糟透了。

zh: 形. 可怕的、遭透的、极讨厌的
example: It was horrible to hear about the crime.
example_zh: 听到那起犯罪事件，真可怕。

example: She drew back in horror at the sight.
example_zh: 看到那景象，她惊恐地往后退。

example: London was a city built for the horse.
example_zh: 伦敦曾是一座为马而建的城市。

example: Horse-riding is her favourite hobby.
example_zh: 骑马是她最喜欢的爱好。

example: I was in the hospital for a week.
example_zh: 我在医院住了一周。

zh: 名. 青年招待所、宿舍、旅店
example: We can spend the night in that hostel.
example_zh: 我们可以在那家旅舍过夜。

zh: 形. 热的、热心的、辣的
example: I understand it's going to get hot again.
example_zh: 我知道天气又要变热了。

example: We stayed at a hotel by the lake.
example_zh: 我们住在湖边的一家旅馆。

example: How many hours of sleep do you need?
example_zh: 你需要睡几个小时？

example: I wish I could live near your house.
example_zh: 我希望我能住在你家附近。

example: I'm a housewife and a mother of three.
example_zh: 我是家庭主妇，也是三个孩子的母亲。

example: I need someone to help me with housework.
example_zh: 我需要有人帮我做家务。

example: What... you still don't know how to drive?
example_zh: 什么……你还不会开车？

zh: 副. 然而、无论如何、究竟怎样
example: However tired I may be, I must work.
example_zh: 不管我多累，我都必须工作。

zh: 副. 多少、什么价钱、到什么程度
example: I have no idea how much it costs.
example_zh: 我不知道它要多少钱。

zh: 名. 紧抱、拥抱；动. 紧抱、坚持、使沾沾自喜
example: A hug from you would make me happy.
example_zh: 你拥抱我一下会让我很开心。

zh: 形. 极大的、巨大的、无限的
example: The huge building seemed to touch the sky.
example_zh: 那座巨大的建筑似乎碰到了天空。

zh: 形. 人类的、似人类的、人性的；名. 人、人类
example: Language as we know is a human invention.
example_zh: 我们所知的语言是人类的发明。

zh: 形. 潮湿的、湿润的、多湿气的
example: It gets very humid here in the summer.
example_zh: 这里夏天会变得很潮湿。

example: I like his sense of humour.
example_zh: 我喜欢他的幽默感。

example: Some people in the world suffer from hunger.
example_zh: 世界上有些人在挨饿。

zh: 形. 饥饿的、荒年的、渴望的
example: You must be hungry after school is over.
example_zh: 放学后你一定饿了。

zh: 动. 狩猎、打猎、搜索、猎食
example: He was looking for it like a hunting dog.
example_zh: 他像猎狗一样寻找它。

zh: 动. 急派、催促、匆忙、赶快
example: I think we'll make it if we hurry.
example_zh: 我想如果我们快点，就能赶到。

zh: 动. 伤害、(使)伤心、危害
example: Have I said something to hurt your feelings?
example_zh: 我是不是说了什么让你难过的话？

zh: 名. 丈夫、管理人、节俭的人
example: I have yet to find a perfect husband.
example_zh: 我还没有找到完美的丈夫。

zh: 名. 小屋、茅舍、临时军营
example: There used to be a hut about here.
example_zh: 这附近过去有一座小屋。

example: I just don't know what to say.
example_zh: 我只是不知道该说什么。

example: There is nothing like summer and ice cream.
example_zh: 没有什么比夏天和冰淇淋更好的了。

example: I would like a chocolate ice cream, please.
example_zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。

zh: 名. na. 冰球、冰上曲棍球
example: My nephew is an ice hockey player.
example_zh: 我侄子是一名冰球运动员。

example: Do you own a pair of ice skates?
example_zh: 你有一双溜冰鞋吗？

example: We go ice skating every winter.
example_zh: 我们每年冬天都去滑冰。

zh: 形. 冰的、冰冷的、冷淡的
example: Driving on an icy street is a dangerous business.
example_zh: 在结冰的街道上开车是件危险的事。

zh: 名. 遗传素质、本能冲动
example: I'm going to need to see some ID.
example_zh: 我需要看一下身份证件。

example: Please show your ID card at the door.
example_zh: 请在门口出示你的身份证。

example: Your idea seems to be similar to mine.
example_zh: 你的想法似乎和我的相似。

zh: 名. 识别、身份证明、认同
example: The driver’s license can serve as photo identification.
example_zh: 驾照可以作为带照片的身份证明。

zh: 动. 识别、认为…等同于、确定、一致
example: Babies can identify their mothers.
example_zh: 婴儿能认出自己的母亲。

example: Please show your identity card at reception.
example_zh: 请在接待处出示你的身份证。

zh: 连. 如果、是否、无论何时
example: I don't know if I still have it.
example_zh: 我不知道我是否还留着它。

zh: 动. 不理睬、忽视、驳回
example: Sports can be dangerous if safety is ignored.
example_zh: 如果忽视安全，运动可能会很危险。

zh: 形. 生病的、邪恶的、不吉利的
example: Don't speak ill of others behind their back.
example_zh: 不要在背后说别人的坏话。

example: The patient will soon recover from his illness.
example_zh: 这位病人很快就会康复。

zh: 名. 想像、听觉、想像力
example: The exhibition was a product of his imagination.
example_zh: 这个展览是他想象力的产物。

zh: 动. 想像、设想、猜测、想像起来
example: I can't imagine your not knowing her address.
example_zh: 我无法想象你不知道她的地址。

zh: 副. 直接地、立刻、立即
example: She promised to look into the matter immediately.
example_zh: 她答应立即调查这件事。

example: The wait at immigration is at least 30 minutes.
example_zh: 在入境处至少要等30分钟。

zh: 名. 重要、重要性、重要地位
example: The matter is of great importance to me.
example_zh: 这件事对我来说非常重要。

zh: 形. 重要的、有地位的、大量的
example: It's important for us to win the game.
example_zh: 对我们来说，赢得比赛很重要。

zh: 形. 不可能的、难以置信的、令人无法忍受的
example: It is impossible for you to do so.
example_zh: 你不可能这样做。

zh: 形. 外加的、印象深刻的、了不起的
example: I was impressed by her singing.
example_zh: 她的歌声让我印象深刻。

zh: 动. 改良、提高…的价值、改善、变得更好
example: You can improve your English if you try.
example_zh: 如果你努力，你的英语可以提高。

example: There's a lot of room left for improvement.
example_zh: 还有很多改进的空间。

zh: 副. 进入、朝里、在里面；介. 在…期间、在…之内、处于…之中
example: You're in better shape than I am.
example_zh: 你的身体状态比我好。

example: The plan has been agreed to in advance.
example_zh: 这个计划已经事先得到同意。

example: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
example_zh: 吃这个药，以防生病。

example: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
example_zh: 给他一英寸，他就会要一码。

zh: 动. 包括、把…算入、包住
example: The price does not include the case.
example_zh: 价格不包括盒子。

example: I read several books last week, including yours.
example_zh: 我上周读了几本书，包括你的。

example: Either your user name or password is incorrect.
example_zh: 你的用户名或密码不正确。

example: The population of Sweden is on the increase.
example_zh: 瑞典的人口正在增长。

example: That story is too incredible to be true.
example_zh: 那个故事太离奇了，不可能是真的。

example: It's incredibly easy to cheat the system.
example_zh: 欺骗这个系统极其容易。

zh: 副. 的确、实在、真正地
example: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
example_zh: 患难朋友才是真朋友。

zh: 形. 独立的、有主见的、不须依赖的
example: Those young men are independent of their parents.
example_zh: 那些年轻人不依赖父母。

zh: 形. 个别的、个人的、独特的
example: Each child has an individual way of thinking.
example_zh: 每个孩子都有自己独特的思维方式。

example: Don't stay indoors because it is cold outside.
example_zh: 不要因为外面冷就待在室内。

example: It was raining hard, so we played indoors.
example_zh: 雨下得很大，所以我们在室内玩。

example: Competition is very keen in the car industry.
example_zh: 汽车行业的竞争非常激烈。

zh: 形. 便宜的、不贵重的
example: In Paris, I stayed at an inexpensive hotel.
example_zh: 在巴黎，我住在一家便宜的旅馆。

example: In fact I don't know anything about it.
example_zh: 事实上，我对此什么都不知道。

zh: 名. 影响力、权力、势力；动. 影响、改变
example: The influence of TV on society is great.
example_zh: 电视对社会的影响很大。

zh: 动. 通知、使了解、使充满、提供资料
example: I wrote to inform him of my decision.
example_zh: 我写信告诉他我的决定。

example: Information is given in English at every airport.
example_zh: 每个机场都用英语提供信息。

example: The bus stops in front of the school.
example_zh: 公交车停在学校前面。

example: This ingredient is used in traditional Chinese medicine.
example_zh: 这种成分用于中药。

example: I can do it in half the time.
example_zh: 我用一半的时间就能做完它。

example: Write your homework in ink, not in pencil.
example_zh: 作业要用墨水写，不要用铅笔写。

example: His initials are J.B.H.
example_zh: 他姓名的首字母是 J.B.H。

zh: 动. 伤害、损害、使受冤屈
example: Cover up the injured man with this blanket.
example_zh: 用这条毯子盖住那个受伤的人。

example: I always write letters with pen and ink.
example_zh: 我总是用钢笔和墨水写信。

example: The man fell in love at first sight.
example_zh: 那个男人一见钟情。

example: Don't sign the contract in pencil.
example_zh: 不要用铅笔签合同。

zh: 介. 整齐、状况良好、适宜
example: Hurry up in order to catch the train.
example_zh: 快点，好赶上火车。

example: Go early in order to get a good seat.
example_zh: 早点去，好找到一个好座位。

example: He gave an expeditious answer to an inquiry.
example_zh: 他对一项询问作出了迅速的回答。

example: What do you call this insect in English?
example_zh: 这种昆虫用英语怎么说？

zh: 副. 在里面；介. 在…之内
example: I looked round the inside of the house.
example_zh: 我在房子里面四处看了看。

zh: 动. 坚持、坚决主张、强调
example: I will borrow it then, if you insist.
example_zh: 既然你坚持，那我就借吧。

zh: 动. 使感动、激发、启示、吸入
example: She inspired him to become an actor.
example_zh: 她激励他成为一名演员。

zh: 动. 安装、安置、使就职
example: I'd like you to help me install this software.
example_zh: 我想请你帮我安装这个软件。

example: This is an instance of modern British life.
example_zh: 这是现代英国生活的一个实例。

example: Let's go by train instead of by bus.
example_zh: 我们坐火车去，不坐公共汽车。

example: I will do it according to your instructions.
example_zh: 我会按照你的指示做。

example: The instructor advised me to exercise every day.
example_zh: 教练建议我每天锻炼。

example: You can play a musical instrument, can't you?
example_zh: 你会演奏乐器，对吧？

zh: 形. 聪明的、智能的、了解的
example: Young as he is, he is quite intelligent.
example_zh: 虽然他年轻，但他很聪明。

zh: 动. 计划、打算、意思是
example: We intend to leave early tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们打算明天早点出发。

zh: 名. 兴趣、嗜好、利息；动. 使感兴趣、与…有关系
example: The press is interested in his private life.
example_zh: 媒体对他的私生活感兴趣。

example: The press is interested in his private life.
example_zh: 媒体对他的私生活感兴趣。

example: The movie was interesting, as I had expected.
example_zh: 这部电影很有趣，正如我所料。

example: This level is intermediate. It isn't hard.
example_zh: 这个级别是中级。它不难。

example: The problem began to assume an international character.
example_zh: 这个问题开始具有国际性。

zh: 名. 因特网、国际互连网、网际网络
example: Our company makes use of the Internet.
example_zh: 我们公司使用互联网。

zh: 动. 中断、妨碍、插嘴、打断
example: Don't interrupt me but hear me out, please.
example_zh: 请不要打断我，听我把话说完。

example: There was a short interval between the two classes.
example_zh: 两节课之间有短暂的休息。

zh: 名. 面谈、访问、接见；动. 接见、对…进行面谈(试)
example: In addition, I have to interview a professor.
example_zh: 此外，我还得采访一位教授。

zh: 名. 会见者、面谈者、进行面试者
example: The interviewer asked William a series of tough questions.
example_zh: 面试官问了威廉一系列难题。

example: We came to an agreement in the end.
example_zh: 最后我们达成了协议。

example: I got there in time for the train.
example_zh: 我及时到达那里，赶上了火车。

zh: 介. 进入…之内、朝…、深入…之中
example: You must take his age into account.
example_zh: 你必须考虑到他的年龄。

example: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
example_zh: 你本应该向那个女孩介绍你自己。

example: I came to work here though his introduction.
example_zh: 我是经他介绍来这里工作的。

zh: 介. 分为两部分、一分为二
example: The sale will be over in two days.
example_zh: 这次促销两天后结束。

example: Children were apt to invent their own games.
example_zh: 孩子们常常自己编游戏。

example: The inventor is known all over the world.
example_zh: 这位发明家闻名全世界。

zh: 名. 发明、创作能力、虚构的故事
example: We have a good opinion of your invention.
example_zh: 我们对你的发明评价很高。

example: You have a standing invitation to join us.
example_zh: 我们随时欢迎你加入。

example: You may invite any person you like.
example_zh: 你可以邀请任何你喜欢的人。

zh: 动. 包括、使陷于、潜心于
example: Not only you but also I was involved.
example_zh: 不仅你，我也牵涉其中。

zh: 名. 铁、熨斗、铁器；动. 烫平、熨、用铁包
example: The Golden Gate Bridge is made of iron.
example_zh: 金门大桥是用铁建成的。

example: Tell her that I am ironing my clothes.
example_zh: 告诉她我正在熨衣服。

zh: 名. 岛、岛屿、孤立地区
example: We arrived on the island two days later.
example_zh: 两天后我们到达了那座岛。

example: Listen to the facts relative to the issue.
example_zh: 听听与这个问题有关的事实。

example: It's not much of a surprise, is it?
example_zh: 这算不上什么惊喜，对吧？

example: It's not much of a surprise, is it?
example_zh: 这算不上什么惊喜，对吧？

example: The police knew it was a hot item.
example_zh: 警方知道它是一件热门物品。

example: The summer drew near to its end.
example_zh: 夏天接近尾声了。

example: Strange to say, the door opened of itself.
example_zh: 说来奇怪，门自己开了。

example: There was a black jacket on the book.
example_zh: 书上放着一件黑色夹克。

zh: 名. 监牢、监狱、拘留所
example: The police threatened to send her to jail.
example_zh: 警察威胁要把她送进监狱。

zh: 名. 果酱、拥塞之物、堵塞
example: Take the jam down from the top shelf.
example_zh: 把果酱从最上层的架子上拿下来。

zh: 名. 广口瓶、震动、刺耳声
example: He only drinks water from my small jar.
example_zh: 他只喝我小罐子里的水。

example: Modern jazz is not to my taste.
example_zh: 现代爵士乐不合我的口味。

zh: 形. 嫉妒的、羡慕的、留心的
example: I'm jealous that you have a good boss.
example_zh: 我嫉妒你有个好老板。

example: Made in Italy, these jeans were very expensive.
example_zh: 这条牛仔裤是意大利制造的，非常贵。

zh: 名. 喷射流、喷嘴、煤玉
example: They travelled to Paris by jet.
example_zh: 他们乘喷气式飞机去了巴黎。

zh: 名. 宝石、贵重饰物、珠宝
example: Why would Layla wear jewellery on the beach?
example_zh: 莱拉为什么要在海滩上戴首饰呢？

example: You must share your jobs with others.
example_zh: 你必须和别人分担你的工作。

zh: 动. 轻推、(使)蹒跚行进、(使)慢跑
example: I make it a rule to jog every morning.
example_zh: 我给自己定下规矩，每天早上慢跑。

example: Jogging has become the favorite form of exercise.
example_zh: 慢跑已经成为最受喜爱的锻炼方式。

zh: 动. 连接、结合、参加、加入
example: All you have to do is to join us.
example_zh: 你只要加入我们就行了。

zh: 名. 笑话、玩笑、笑柄；动. 开玩笑、取笑、作弄
example: You should not play a joke on me.
example_zh: 你不应该开我的玩笑。

zh: 名. 新闻记者、从事新闻杂志业的人
example: The journalist was calm even in an emergency.
example_zh: 那位记者即使在紧急情况下也很冷静。

example: I can't afford the time for a journey.
example_zh: 我抽不出时间去旅行。

zh: 名. 法官、裁判员、审判官；动. 审理、鉴定、判断、下判断
example: The judge in the case was not fair.
example_zh: 这个案件的法官不公平。

zh: 名. 水壶、监牢、模仿夜莺的叫声
example: I knocked over a jug and broke it.
example_zh: 我打翻了一个罐子，把它摔破了。

example: He drank orange juice out of a bottle.
example_zh: 他从瓶子里喝橙汁。

zh: 动. 跳跃、跃过、突升、跳
example: I was too glad not to jump up.
example_zh: 我高兴得跳了起来。

example: You've got your jumper on inside out!
example_zh: 你的套头衫穿反了！

zh: 名. 丛林、杂乱的一堆、弱肉强食的地方
example: The lion is the king of the jungle.
example_zh: 狮子是丛林之王。

example: I’ve just seen Tom.
example_zh: 我刚看见汤姆。

example: I was tried in a kangaroo court.
example_zh: 我在一个私设法庭受审。

zh: 形. 锋利的、敏锐的、强烈的
example: The kid has a keen sense of hearing.
example_zh: 这个孩子听觉很灵敏。

zh: 动. 保持、保存、遵守、继续不断
example: May I keep this?
example_zh: 我可以留着这个吗？

zh: 名. 监护人、管理人、看守人
example: The goal-keeper took his place in goal.
example_zh: 守门员在球门前就位。

example: She kept the children in as it was so.
example_zh: 因为当时情况如此，她让孩子们待在屋里。

example: He kept on talking.
example_zh: 他不停地说话。

zh: 动. 不低落、维持、继续
example: Keep up the good work!
example_zh: 继续好好干！

example: That's like the pot calling the kettle black.
example_zh: 那就像锅笑壶黑。

example: This is the key to my house.
example_zh: 这是我家的钥匙。

example: I play the keyboard in a band.
example_zh: 我在乐队里弹键盘。

zh: 名. 踢、反冲、后座力；动. 踢、反冲、反抗
example: Kick with your legs straight to go forward.
example_zh: 双腿伸直踢水向前。

example: The kids are playing in the garden.
example_zh: 孩子们正在花园里玩。

zh: 动. 杀、破坏、消灭、杀死
example: I'd be unhappy, but I wouldn't kill myself.
example_zh: 我会不开心，但我不会自杀。

example: This bag weighs about one kilogramme.
example_zh: 这个包大约重一公斤。

example: The school is two kilometres from my house.
example_zh: 学校离我家两公里。

zh: 形. 亲切的、仁慈的、和蔼的；名. 种类、性质、方式
example: That’s very kind of you.
example_zh: 你真好。

example: The king turned out to be naked.
example_zh: 原来国王没穿衣服。

zh: 名. 吻；动. 吻、接吻
example: The mother kissed her baby on the lips.
example_zh: 妈妈亲了宝宝的嘴唇。

zh: 名. 装备、工具箱、成套工具
example: It's a very clever piece of kit.
example_zh: 这是一件非常巧妙的装备。

example: There is a kitchen garden behind my house.
example_zh: 我家后面有一个菜园。

zh: 名. 风筝、筝帆、空头支票
example: There is a kite flying above the tree.
example_zh: 树的上方有一只风筝在飞。

example: The kitten couldn't get down from the tree.
example_zh: 小猫没法从树上下来。

example: He knocked his knee against the chair.
example_zh: 他的膝盖撞到了椅子上。

example: Put that knife down. You're making me nervous.
example_zh: 把那把刀放下。你让我很紧张。

example: She knit him a sweater for his birthday.
example_zh: 她为他织了一件毛衣作为生日礼物。

example: I knocked on the door, but nobody answered.
example_zh: 我敲了门，但没人应门。

zh: 动. 击倒、拆卸、拍卖出
example: He was knocked down by a car.
example_zh: 他被一辆汽车撞倒了。

example: I didn't know where it came from.
example_zh: 我不知道它是从哪里来的。

example: He has said so himself to my knowledge.
example_zh: 据我所知，他自己这么说过。

example: Pull the label off to open the box.
example_zh: 把标签撕下来，打开盒子。

zh: 名. 实验室、研究室、化工厂
example: The students did the test in the laboratory.
example_zh: 学生们在实验室里做了测试。

example: I didn't give up for lack of hope.
example_zh: 我没有因为缺乏希望而放弃。

zh: 名. 梯、梯状物、发迹的途径
example: Take care when you climb up the ladder.
example_zh: 爬梯子时要小心。

example: The old lady walked slowly up the hill.
example_zh: 那位老太太慢慢地走上山。

example: I would often go fishing in the lake.
example_zh: 我过去常常去湖里钓鱼。

example: Right now, Tom is sleeping like a lamb.
example_zh: 现在，汤姆像小羊羔一样睡着。

example: The lamp went out, and all was black.
example_zh: 灯灭了，一片漆黑。

zh: 名. 陆地、地面、地界；动. 使上岸、使登陆、使到达、登陆
example: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.
example_zh: 明天，他将登陆月球。

zh: 名. 风景、山水、风景画
example: He took a picture of the beautiful landscape.
example_zh: 他拍了一张美丽风景的照片。

example: Few people can speak a foreign language perfectly.
example_zh: 很少有人能完美地说一门外语。

example: I do my homework on my laptop.
example_zh: 我用笔记本电脑做作业。

zh: 形. 大的、大量的、宽大的
example: There is a large house on the hill.
example_zh: 山上有一座大房子。

zh: 形. 最后的、末尾的、最近的
example: He changed a lot since the last time.
example_zh: 和上次相比，他变了很多。

zh: 副. 很晚、很迟、晚；形. 迟的、晚的、已故的
example: The train is going to be late.
example_zh: 火车要晚点了。

example: By the way, have you seen him lately?
example_zh: 顺便问一下，你最近见过他吗？

example: I’ll see you later.
example_zh: 待会儿见。

example: He will arrive by eight at the latest.
example_zh: 他最晚八点到。

zh: 动. 以笑表示、笑、大笑
example: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.
example_zh: 不要因为他犯错误就嘲笑他。

zh: 名. 洗衣店、洗好的衣服、洗涤
example: The man does the laundry, not the woman.
example_zh: 是那个男人洗衣服，不是那个女人。

example: We are subject to the laws of nature.
example_zh: 我们受自然规律的约束。

example: I have the right to call my lawyer.
example_zh: 我有权给我的律师打电话。

zh: 动. 放置、产、铺设、下蛋
example: Lay it down on paper so everyone understands better.
example_zh: 把它写在纸上，这样大家更好理解。

zh: 形. 懒惰的、怠惰的、缓慢的
example: Stop being lazy and find something to do.
example_zh: 别偷懒了，找点事做。

zh: 动. 引导、带领、领导、带头
example: This road leads to the station.
example_zh: 这条路通向车站。

zh: 名. 领导者、社论、指挥
example: We look up to him as our leader.
example_zh: 我们尊他为我们的领导。

example: You'll have to turn over a new leaf.
example_zh: 你得改过自新。

example: The League of Nations did not make for peace.
example_zh: 国际联盟无助于和平。

zh: 动. 学习、认识到、得知
example: I thought you liked to learn new things.
example_zh: 我以为你喜欢学新东西。

example: The trip will take at least five days.
example_zh: 这次旅行至少要五天。

zh: 名. 皮革、皮制品、马镫的皮带；形. 皮革的、皮制的
example: This steak is as tough as shoe leather.
example_zh: 这块牛排硬得像鞋皮。

zh: 动. 离开、剩下、遗忘、出发
example: I will have left here before you return.
example_zh: 在你回来之前，我就会离开这里了。

example: The students sat still, listening to the lecture.
example_zh: 学生们坐着不动，听讲座。

example: Are you a lecturer or a student?
example_zh: 你是讲师还是学生？

zh: 形. 左边的、左倾的、左侧的；副. 在左面；名. 左、左面、左派
example: Go to the left.
example_zh: 往左走。

example: The shop is on the left-hand side of the street.
example_zh: 商店在街道的左侧。

example: A ball hit her on the right leg.
example_zh: 一个球打中了她的右腿。

example: In her leisure time, she enjoys swimming and tennis.
example_zh: 在闲暇时间，她喜欢游泳和打网球。

zh: 名. 柠檬、柠檬树、柠檬色
example: I feel better when I drink hot lemon juice.
example_zh: 我喝热柠檬汁时感觉好一些。

example: The police shut down Tom’s lemonade stand.
example_zh: 警察关闭了汤姆的柠檬水摊。

zh: 动. 借、贷款给、增添、贷款
example: I will lend you whatever book you need.
example_zh: 你需要什么书，我就借给你什么书。

example: The length of the lesson/journey was 50 minutes.
example_zh: 这节课/这段路程长达50分钟。

example: Mr Young has no less than six cars.
example_zh: 杨先生至少有六辆车。

example: Did you try to review the English lessons?
example_zh: 你试着复习英语课了吗？

zh: 动. 让、假设、出租、被承包
example: Let’s go to the beach.
example_zh: 我们去海滩吧。

example: You shouldn't read people's private letters without permission.
example_zh: 你不应该未经允许读别人的私人信件。

example: Is it OK to feed my dog lettuce?
example_zh: 我可以给我的狗喂生菜吗？

example: The level of the school is high.
example_zh: 这所学校的水平很高。

example: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.
example_zh: 明天我要在图书馆学习。

zh: 名. 图书馆员、图书管理员
example: The librarian said we needed to be quiet.
example_zh: 图书管理员说我们需要安静。

zh: 名. 执照、许可证、特许
example: A car licence can be held from age 18.
example_zh: 从18岁起就可以持有汽车驾照。

zh: 名. 谎言、假象、位置；动. 谎骗、躺着、说谎、位于
example: He has lied to me again and again.
example_zh: 他一次又一次对我撒谎。

example: I want to lie down for a few minutes.
example_zh: 我想躺几分钟。

example: Are you saying my life is in danger?
example_zh: 你是说我的生命有危险吗？

example: Take the lift to the third floor.
example_zh: 乘电梯到三楼。

zh: 名. 光、光亮、灯；形. 轻的、少量的、轻微的
example: Please turn out the lights when you leave.
example_zh: 你离开时请关灯。

zh: 名. 点火者、点灯工人、打火机
example: He felt in his pocket for his lighter.
example_zh: 他在口袋里摸找打火机。

example: I'm at the hospital. I got struck by lightning.
example_zh: 我在医院。我被闪电击中了。

zh: 副. 可能；介. 象、如同；动. 喜欢、愿意、想、希望
example: What’s the weather like?
example_zh: 天气怎么样？

zh: 形. 有可能的、合适的、前途有望的
example: We'll likely go to the ball game tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们明天可能会去看球赛。

zh: 名. 界限、边界、限度；动. 限制、限定
example: Our knowledge on the problem is rather limited.
example_zh: 我们对这个问题的了解相当有限。

zh: 形. 有限制的、有限的、有限责任的
example: You should make the best of your limited time.
example_zh: 你应该充分利用你有限的时间。

example: You're giving me the same old line.
example_zh: 你又在对我说同样的老话。

example: Click on the link.
example_zh: 点击链接。

zh: 名. 狮子、狮子(星)座、国际狮子会会员
example: The lion ate the rabbit in one bite.
example_zh: 狮子一口吃掉了兔子。

zh: 名. 唇、口缘、唇状构造
example: I have a cold sore on my lip.
example_zh: 我嘴唇上长了唇疱疹。

example: You should not drink a lot of liquid.
example_zh: 你不应该喝太多液体。

zh: 名. 目录、名单、明细表
example: Don't leave my name out of your list.
example_zh: 别把我的名字从你的名单里漏掉。

example: I listen to music every evening.
example_zh: 我每天晚上听音乐。

example: I have a large library on American literature.
example_zh: 我有很多关于美国文学的藏书。

example: They each drank half a litre of wine.
example_zh: 他们每人喝了半升葡萄酒。

example: You can have the pick of the litter.
example_zh: 你可以从这一窝里挑最好的。

zh: 形. 小的、很少的、幼小的
example: You should not think little of this result.
example_zh: 你不应该小看这个结果。

zh: 动. 过着、度过、经历、活
example: I can't live that kind of life.
example_zh: 我过不了那种生活。

zh: 形. 活泼的、鲜明的、生动的
example: The conversation at table is lively and interesting.
example_zh: 餐桌上的谈话生动有趣。

example: We watch television in the living room.
example_zh: 我们在客厅看电视。

example: That is really a load off my mind.
example_zh: 那真让我如释重负。

example: You can get a loan from a bank.
example_zh: 你可以从银行获得贷款。

zh: 形. 地方性的、当地的、局部的
example: Our children all go to the local school.
example_zh: 我们的孩子都上当地的学校。

zh: 动. 找出、设于、位于、定居
example: The company is located on the West Coast.
example_zh: 这家公司位于西海岸。

zh: 名. 位置、场所、特定区域
example: She asked about the location of the house.
example_zh: 她询问了房子的位置。

zh: 名. 锁、刹车、水闸；动. 锁、锁上、拘禁、锁住
example: In opening the door, I broke the lock.
example_zh: 在开门时，我把锁弄坏了。

zh: 名. 抽屉、小柜、上锁人
example: Each of the students has his own locker.
example_zh: 每个学生都有自己的储物柜。

zh: 名. 连合活字、商标、徽标
example: Ziri wanted to create a more professional logo.
example_zh: 齐里想设计一个更专业的标志。

zh: 形. 孤单的、孤寂的、荒凉的
example: When I started traveling, I rarely felt lonely.
example_zh: 我开始旅行时，很少感到孤独。

zh: 形. 长的、长久的、冗长的
example: Ten years is a long time to wait.
example_zh: 等十年是很长的时间。

example: She should smooth out the long jump pit a little.
example_zh: 她应该把跳远沙坑稍微弄平。

zh: 动. 打量、看上去与…一样、以眼色(或脸色)显示、看
example: You must not look upon him as great.
example_zh: 你不能把他看作很伟大。

example: My sister looks after the baby on Fridays.
example_zh: 我姐姐每周五照看宝宝。

example: Look at the board, please.
example_zh: 请看黑板。

example: I am looking for my keys.
example_zh: 我在找我的钥匙。

example: I’m looking forward to the party!
example_zh: 我很期待这次聚会！

zh: 动. 看起来与（某人或某物）相像[相似]、很可能出现[引起]（某事、做某事）
example: She looks like her sister.
example_zh: 她长得像她姐姐。

example: Look out – it’s going to fall!
example_zh: 小心——它要掉下来了！

zh: 动. 向上看、尊敬、仰望
example: Look up the meaning of the word in.
example_zh: 查一下这个词在……里的意思。

zh: 形. 宽松的、松的、宽的
example: We look on her as a loose woman.
example_zh: 我们把她看作一个放荡的女人。

example: I was almost run over by a lorry.
example_zh: 我差点被一辆卡车撞到。

zh: 动. 遗失、损失、丢失、受损失
example: We lost the game.
example_zh: 我们输了比赛。

zh: 形. 失去的、遗失的、迷惑的
example: You should not give him up for lost.
example_zh: 你不应该认为他失踪了而放弃他。

example: There is a lot of homework today.
example_zh: 今天有很多作业。

example: She won ten million yen in the lottery.
example_zh: 她买彩票中了一千万日元。

zh: 形. 大声的、不断的、喧吵的
example: I can't put up with that loud noise.
example_zh: 我受不了那么大的噪音。

zh: 副. 高声地、大声地、吵闹地
example: I spoke loudly so that everyone could hear me.
example_zh: 我大声说话，好让大家都能听见我。

zh: 名. 爱、恋爱、爱情；动. 爱、爱好、爱慕
example: I love you more than you love me.
example_zh: 我爱你胜过你爱我。

example: The weather was lovely when I left home.
example_zh: 我离家时天气很好。

zh: 形. 低的、消沉的、低等的
example: Lots of low trees grow on the hill.
example_zh: 山上长着许多矮树。

example: You're in luck. The plane is on time.
example_zh: 你运气真好。飞机准点。

zh: 副. 幸运地、幸亏、侥幸
example: Luckily, he was on time for the train.
example_zh: 幸运的是，他准时赶上了火车。

zh: 形. 幸运的、吉祥的、好运的
example: How lucky I am to meet you here!
example_zh: 我在这里遇到你，真幸运！

example: She lent them a hand with their luggage.
example_zh: 她帮他们搬行李。

example: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.
example_zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭要迟到了。

example: We should get to Chicago by lunchtime.
example_zh: 我们应当在午饭前到达芝加哥。

example: A television set used to be a luxury.
example_zh: 电视机过去是一种奢侈品。

zh: 名. 机器、机械装置、机构
example: The machine has some of its parts missing.
example_zh: 这台机器少了一些零件。

zh: 形. 疯狂的、发疯的、生气的
example: He was so sad that he almost went mad.
example_zh: 他太伤心了，几乎要发疯了。

example: I'm sorry, madam. There must be some mistake.
example_zh: 对不起，女士。一定是哪里弄错了。

example: Her shirt is made of cotton.
example_zh: 她的衬衫是棉制的。

example: It is foolish to read such a magazine.
example_zh: 读这样的杂志是愚蠢的。

zh: 形. 魔术的、有魔力的、不可思议的；名. 魔术、魔法
example: The prince was changed into a tree by magic.
example_zh: 王子被魔法变成了一棵树。

zh: 形. 华丽的、高尚的、宏伟的
example: The queen was wearing a magnificent silver dress.
example_zh: 女王穿着一件华丽的银色连衣裙。

example: Our letters probably crossed in the mail.
example_zh: 我们的信可能在邮寄途中互相错过了。

zh: 形. 主要的、重要的、全力的
example: We are having fish for our main course.
example_zh: 我们的主菜吃鱼。

zh: 名. 主帆、主要课程、主菜
example: For the main course I had chicken and rice.
example_zh: 主菜我吃了鸡肉和米饭。

example: My success was mainly due to your help.
example_zh: 我的成功主要归功于你的帮助。

zh: 动. 制造、安排、创造、开始
example: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!
example_zh: 住手！你让她感到不舒服了！

example: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
example_zh: 离开前一定要锁门。

example: She never wears make-up to school.
example_zh: 她从不在去学校时化妆。

zh: 形. 男性的、雄性的、有力的；名. 男人、雄性动物
example: A male friend of mine called on me yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我的一位男性朋友来看我。

example: She went to the mall with her friends.
example_zh: 她和朋友们去了购物中心。

example: You are the man I've been looking for.
example_zh: 你就是我一直在找的那个人。

zh: 动. 管理、控制、维持、处理
example: Since I got a raise, I can manage.
example_zh: 我加了薪，所以能应付了。

zh: 名. 经理、管理员、管理器
example: I'd like to talk to the hotel manager.
example_zh: 我想和酒店经理谈谈。

example: I am looking for a mango to eat.
example_zh: 我在找一个芒果吃。

example: There are many words that I don't understand.
example_zh: 有很多词我不懂。

zh: 名. 地图、天体图、映像
example: Please give me a map of the town.
example_zh: 请给我一张城镇地图。

example: Your guess is entirely off the mark.
example_zh: 你的猜测完全不对。

example: London developed into the general market of Europe.
example_zh: 伦敦发展成了欧洲的综合性市场。

example: Marriage is the last thing on my mind.
example_zh: 结婚是我最不考虑的事。

example: It won't be long before they get married.
example_zh: 用不了多久他们就会结婚。

zh: 动. 与…结婚、娶、嫁、结婚
example: It won't be long before they get married.
example_zh: 用不了多久他们就会结婚。

zh: 形. 奇异的、神奇的、奇迹般的
example: It's marvellous to listen to a learned person.
example_zh: 听一个有学问的人讲话真是太好了。

example: No one can match her in speaking French.
example_zh: 在说法语方面没人能比得上她。

example: He was dropped because of his running mate.
example_zh: 他因为他的竞选搭档而被淘汰了。

example: This material is not suitable for a dress.
example_zh: 这种布料不适合做连衣裙。

example: Maths is my favourite subject.
example_zh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目。

zh: 名. 事件、物质、原因；动. 有关系
example: It doesn’t matter.
example_zh: 没关系。

zh: 形. 最高的、最大的、最大极限的；名. 极点、最大量、极大
example: She received the maximum sentence of ten years.
example_zh: 她被判处最高十年的刑期。

example: You may as well prepare for your examination.
example_zh: 你不妨为考试做准备。

example: Maybe they will come and maybe they won't.
example_zh: 也许他们会来，也许不会。

example: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
example_zh: 我要把所有事情解释清楚，得花很长时间。

example: We're going out for a meal on Friday.
example_zh: 我们星期五要出去吃饭。

zh: 动. 意谓、想要、意欲、用意
example: Education means something more than going to school.
example_zh: 教育不只是上学。

example: Everything that has meaning can be called language.
example_zh: 一切有意义的东西都可以被称为语言。

example: Meanwhile you are out and about with her!
example_zh: 与此同时，你却和她在外到处游玩！

zh: 动. 测量、测度、估量、度量
example: Measure the length of the stick with a ruler.
example_zh: 用尺子量这根棍子的长度。

example: None of the meat was fit to eat.
example_zh: 那些肉都不能吃。

example: I'll have a mechanic check the car out.
example_zh: 我会请修理工检查一下这辆车。

example: I'll wait here until my medicine is ready.
example_zh: 我会在这里等我的药准备好。

zh: 形. 半生熟的、中间的
example: The air is a medium for sound.
example_zh: 空气是声音的介质。

zh: 动. 遇见、引见、认识、相遇
example: It's been ten years since we last met.
example_zh: 我们上次见面到现在已经十年了。

example: I look forward to meeting you again soon.
example_zh: 我期待很快再次见到你。

example: The melon smells sweet and tastes very nice.
example_zh: 这个瓜闻起来很甜，味道也很好。

example: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
example_zh: 每个成员每月要付一万日元。

zh: 名. 会员的资格、全体会员、会员数目
example: How much is the annual membership fee?
example_zh: 年度会员费是多少？

zh: 名. 记忆、记忆力、回忆、内存
example: My computer has 100GB of memory.
example_zh: 我的电脑有100GB内存。

zh: 动. 修改、改进、加快、好转
example: He got his wife to mend his shirt.
example_zh: 他让妻子给他补衬衫。

example: Do not mention the accident before the children.
example_zh: 不要在孩子们面前提那场事故。

zh: 名. 菜单、(功能)选择单
example: Choose whatever dish you want from the menu.
example_zh: 从菜单上选你想要的任何菜。

example: My brother leaves his room in a mess.
example_zh: 我弟弟总是把房间弄得乱七八糟。

zh: 名. 消息、通讯、讯息；动. 通知、通报、报告、报信
example: I have a message for you from her.
example_zh: 我有她给你的一个消息。

zh: 形. 散乱的、污秽的、麻烦的
example: Do you have a messy desk at work?
example_zh: 你上班时办公桌很乱吗？

zh: 名. 金属、金属制品、合金；形. 金属制的
example: Iron is a metal with many uses.
example_zh: 铁是一种有很多用途的金属。

example: Our school has adopted a new teaching method.
example_zh: 我们学校采用了一种新的教学方法。

example: It's a thirty-metre-long boat.
example_zh: 这是一艘三十米长的船。

example: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
example_zh: 不知什么原因，麦克风刚才坏了。

example: Don’t put small animals in the microwave!
example_zh: 不要把小型动物放进微波炉！

example: It is midday. The men are eating lunch.
example_zh: 现在是中午。男人们正在吃午饭。

example: In the middle of the lake lies the island.
example_zh: 湖中间有一座岛。

example: A middle-aged man was waiting outside.
example_zh: 一个中年男子在外面等着。

example: The party came to an end at midnight.
example_zh: 派对在午夜结束了。

example: We were worried we might miss the train.
example_zh: 我们担心可能赶不上火车。

zh: 形. 温和的、温柔的、淡味的
example: Spring brings mild weather after the cold winter.
example_zh: 寒冬过后，春天带来了温和的天气。

example: You can see for miles from the roof.
example_zh: 从屋顶上能看到好几英里远。

example: The doctor advised me to drink more milk.
example_zh: 医生建议我多喝牛奶。

example: The wire is two millimetres thick.
example_zh: 这根线有两毫米粗。

example: There are millions of stars in the universe.
example_zh: 宇宙中有数百万颗星星。

zh: 动. 注意、留意、专心于、介意
example: Do you mind if I close the window?
example_zh: 我关窗户你介意吗？

example: Your room is twice the size of mine.
example_zh: 你的房间是我的两倍大。

zh: 名. na. 矿泉水、矿质水
example: Can I have a bottle of mineral water?
example_zh: 我可以要一瓶矿泉水吗？

zh: 形. 最小的、最低的；名. 最小值
example: We have to reduce the cost to a minimum.
example_zh: 我们必须把成本降到最低。

example: The temperature outside is minus four.
example_zh: 外面的温度是零下四度。

example: The school is only a five-minute walk.
example_zh: 学校只有五分钟的步行路程。

example: Its surface was as flat as a mirror.
example_zh: 它的表面像镜子一样平。

zh: 形. 悲惨的、痛苦的、卑鄙的
example: The sight was too miserable to look at.
example_zh: 那景象太悲惨了，让人不忍看。

example: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.
example_zh: 快点，不然你会赶不上火车。

example: The last page of this book is missing.
example_zh: 这本书的最后一页不见了。

example: You made the same mistake as last time.
example_zh: 你犯了和上次一样的错误。

zh: 动. 使混合、弄混、使结合、相混合
example: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
example_zh: 我不喜欢把工作和娱乐混在一起。

example: My mobile phone is in my bag.
example_zh: 我的手机在包里。

zh: 名. 模型、模范、模特儿
example: Those new model cars are on the market.
example_zh: 那些新款汽车已经上市了。

example: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
example_zh: 现代科技让我们的生活更舒适。

example: I’m in England at the moment.
example_zh: 我现在在英国。

zh: 名. 金钱、一笔款、财富
example: Thanks to you, I spent all my money.
example_zh: 因为你，我花光了所有的钱。

example: He climbed up the tree like a monkey.
example_zh: 他像猴子一样爬上了树。

example: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.
example_zh: 一个巨大的怪物正从山上下来。

example: I've been going out with her for months.
example_zh: 我和她交往好几个月了。

zh: 形. 每月的、每月一次的
example: His monthly salary is no less than 500,000 yen.
example_zh: 他的月薪不少于50万日元。

zh: 名. 纪念碑、纪念物、石碑
example: The monument was set up in the park.
example_zh: 这座纪念碑建在公园里。

example: She was in the mood for a walk.
example_zh: 她想去散步。

example: The moon came out from behind the clouds.
example_zh: 月亮从云后面出来了。

zh: 形. 多的、程度较大的、更大的；副. 多、更多、进一步
example: You should pay more attention to what he says.
example_zh: 你应该多注意他说的话。

example: We agreed to start early the next morning.
example_zh: 我们同意第二天一早就开始。

example: I've got mosquito bites all over my arm.
example_zh: 我胳膊上到处都是蚊子咬的包。

zh: 形. 大多数的、几乎全部的、最多的；副. 最、最多、极其
example: What you need the most now is courage.
example_zh: 你现在最需要的是勇气。

zh: 副. 大概、大部分、主要
example: His success was mostly due to good luck.
example_zh: 他的成功主要是因为运气好。

example: You should take care of your sick mother.
example_zh: 你应该照顾你生病的母亲。

zh: 名. 机动脚踏两用车、摩托车
example: My motorbike uses up a lot of gas.
example_zh: 我的摩托车很费油。

example: I don't know how much this motorcycle is.
example_zh: 我不知道这辆摩托车多少钱。

example: He watches motor-racing every weekend.
example_zh: 他每个周末都看赛车比赛。

example: The M7 motorway is not far from us.
example_zh: M7高速公路离我们不远。

example: We stood on the top of the mountain.
example_zh: 我们站在山顶上。

zh: 名. 老鼠、胆小羞怯的人、鼠标
example: I got a new mouse for my laptop.
example_zh: 我给笔记本电脑买了一个新鼠标。

example: A fat guy with moustache just walked in.
example_zh: 一个留着小胡子的胖子刚走进来。

example: You must not speak with your mouth full.
example_zh: 你不可以嘴里塞满食物说话。

zh: 动. 移动、开动、感动、离开
example: Take care not to make a foolish move.
example_zh: 小心别做出愚蠢的举动。

example: It's not like you to cry at movies.
example_zh: 看电影会哭，这不像你。

example: That girl wanted to become a movie star.
example_zh: 那个女孩想成为电影明星。

example: There is a park behind the movie theater.
example_zh: 电影院后面有一个公园。

example: We heard it from Mr Such and such.
example_zh: 我们从某某先生那里听说的。

example: Mrs. North is very proud of her children.
example_zh: 诺斯太太为她的孩子们感到非常自豪。

example: Ms. White ordered that Tom should stay after school.
example_zh: 怀特女士命令汤姆放学后留下来。

zh: 形. 很多的、重要的；副. 多、甚、几乎
example: Do you want to see her very much?
example_zh: 你非常想见她吗？

zh: 名. 有柄大杯、脸、苦读者
example: That's the worst mug shot I've ever seen.
example_zh: 那是我见过的最糟糕的嫌犯照片。

example: My mum is about to take a bath.
example_zh: 我妈妈正要洗澡。

example: This road will take you to the museum.
example_zh: 这条路会带你到博物馆。

zh: 名. 蘑菇形物、蘑菇、暴发户
example: This mushroom is not good to eat.
example_zh: 这种蘑菇不适合吃。

example: I wish she would stop playing that stupid music.
example_zh: 我希望她别再播放那种愚蠢的音乐了。

zh: 形. 音乐的、声音美妙的、喜爱音乐的
example: The musical program has gone off very well.
example_zh: 音乐节目进行得很顺利。

zh: 名. 音乐家、乐师、作曲家
example: I am the first musician in my family.
example_zh: 我是我家第一个音乐家。

example: There are 1000 movies that one must watch before dying.
example_zh: 有一千部电影是人在死前必须看的。

example: What is two and two multiplied by two?
example_zh: 二加二乘以二是多少？

example: My computer has got to be useful for something.
example_zh: 我的电脑总得有点用处。

zh: 代. 我自己、我亲自、我独自
example: I pulled myself together and started my work.
example_zh: 我振作起来，开始工作。

example: Why he killed himself is still a mystery.
example_zh: 他为什么自杀仍然是个谜。

example: You have only to sign your name here.
example_zh: 你只需要在这里签上你的名字。

zh: 形. 狭窄的、仔细的、有限的
example: The gate is too narrow for a car.
example_zh: 这扇门对汽车来说太窄了。

zh: 形. 污秽的、下流的、险恶的
example: I can't get rid of a nasty cold.
example_zh: 我这场重感冒一直好不了。

zh: 形. 国家的、国立的、全国性的
example: The rose is the national flower of this country.
example_zh: 玫瑰是这个国家的国花。

zh: 名. 国籍、国家、民族性
example: I am a person of South African nationality.
example_zh: 我是南非国籍的人。

zh: 形. 天然的、非人造的
example: This juice is made from natural fruit.
example_zh: 这种果汁是用天然水果做的。

zh: 名. 自然、大自然、本性
example: We are subject to the laws of nature.
example_zh: 我们受自然规律的约束。

zh: 形. 深蓝色的、藏青色的
example: I'm looking for a navy blue raincoat, size 36.
example_zh: 我在找一件36码的海军蓝雨衣。

zh: 副. 接近、亲近；介. 靠近、近似于
example: We may meet again in the near future.
example_zh: 我们可能在不久的将来再次见面。

zh: 形. 附近的、近旁的；副. 在附近、近旁地
example: He turned to a tall woman nearby.
example_zh: 他转向旁边一位高个子女人。

example: I was nearly run over by a car.
example_zh: 我差点被一辆汽车撞倒。

zh: 形. 整洁的、巧妙的、匀称的
example: Keep your room as neat as you can.
example_zh: 尽量保持你的房间整洁。

zh: 形. 必要的、必然的、必需的
example: It is necessary for you to start now.
example_zh: 你需要现在开始。

example: The horse broke its neck when it fell.
example_zh: 那匹马摔倒时摔断了脖子。

example: I found the missing piece of your necklace.
example_zh: 我找到了你项链上缺失的那一块。

zh: 动. 需要、必需、贫困、有必要
example: You need not have come here so early.
example_zh: 你本来不必这么早来这里。

zh: 形. 否定的、消极的、负的
example: I don't like a negative sort of man.
example_zh: 我不喜欢消极的男人。

zh: 名. 邻居、邻接的东西、邻国
example: I'll leave the book for you with my neighbour.
example_zh: 我会把书交给我的邻居，让他转交给你。

zh: 名. 邻接、周围、附近一带
example: The price was in the neighbourhood of 50 dollars.
example_zh: 价格大约是50美元。

zh: 副. 皆不、两个都不；代. 两者都不
example: She’s not tall, and neither am I.
example_zh: 她不高，我也不高。

example: He is not my son, but my nephew.
example_zh: 他不是我儿子，是我侄子。

zh: 形. 神经紧张的、不安的、神经的
example: I never make a speech without being nervous.
example_zh: 我每次演讲都会紧张。

example: She carefully watched the bird in the nest.
example_zh: 她仔细地看着巢里的鸟。

example: I found a great website on the net.
example_zh: 我在网上找到了一个很棒的网站。

zh: 名. 网络、广播网、网状物
example: Hell! My network link is down.
example_zh: 糟糕！我的网络连接断了。

example: You will wish you had never seen it.
example_zh: 你会希望自己从没见过它。

zh: 形. 新的、陌生的、最近的
example: He learned the news while reading the newspaper.
example_zh: 他在看报纸时得知了这个消息。

example: I have good news in store for you.
example_zh: 我有好消息要告诉你。

example: Some people read the newspaper while watching television.
example_zh: 有些人一边看电视一边看报纸。

zh: 形. 下一个的、其次的、贴近的；副. 然后、下次、次于
example: The meeting is to be held next Thursday.
example_zh: 会议将在下周四举行。

example: The bank is next to the post office.
example_zh: 银行在邮局旁边。

zh: 形. 美好的、和蔼的、正派的
example: I have a nice present to give you.
example_zh: 我有一份好礼物要给你。

example: To tell the truth, she is my niece.
example_zh: 说实话，她是我侄女。

example: We discussed the problem far into the night.
example_zh: 我们讨论这个问题一直到深夜。

example: Sami used to work at a nightclub.
example_zh: 萨米以前在一家夜总会工作。

example: The nightlife is better in New York.
example_zh: 纽约的夜生活更好。

zh: 名. 梦魇、恶梦、可怕的事物(或情景
example: It was like something out of a nightmare.
example_zh: 那就像是从噩梦中出来的东西。

example: If there's no solution, then there's no problem.
example_zh: 如果没有解决办法，那就没有问题。

example: Nobody knows why he turns down my help.
example_zh: 没人知道他为什么拒绝我的帮助。

example: We can't sleep because of the noise.
example_zh: 因为噪音，我们睡不着。

example: I used to work in a noisy room.
example_zh: 我以前在一个吵闹的房间里工作。

zh: 代. 没有人、无一物、并无一个
example: None of the students were late for school.
example_zh: 没有一个学生上学迟到。

zh: 名. 正午、中午、全盛期
example: We will get to Tokyo Station at noon.
example_zh: 我们将在中午到达东京站。

example: No one was at home when I called.
example_zh: 我去拜访时，没人在家。

zh: 形. 正常的、正规的、标准的
example: I took my temperature, but it was normal.
example_zh: 我量了体温，但体温正常。

zh: 副. 正规地、合规则、正常地
example: People normally breathe 12 to 20 times a minute.
example_zh: 人们通常每分钟呼吸12到20次。

zh: 名. 北方、北；形. 北的、北方的；副. 向北方、在北方
example: The village lies 20 miles north of this town.
example_zh: 那个村庄在这个镇以北20英里处。

zh: 形. 东北的、向东北的、来自东北的；名. 东北
example: The land to the northeast was low-lying.
example_zh: 东北方向的土地地势低洼。

zh: 形. 北方的、向北的、自北方来的
example: We can see the northern lights from our house!
example_zh: 我们从家里就能看到北极光！

zh: 形. 西北的、在西北的、来自西北的；名. 西北、西北方
example: Ziri lives in a small town in northwest Algeria.
example_zh: 齐里住在阿尔及利亚西北部的一个小镇上。

zh: 名. 鼻子、突出部分、嗅觉
example: He did it under my very nose.
example_zh: 他就在我眼皮底下做了这件事。

example: Except that here, it's not so simple.
example_zh: 只不过在这里，事情没那么简单。

zh: 名. 笔记、记录、注解；动. 记录、注解、注意
example: The students took notes during the class.
example_zh: 学生们在课上记笔记。

zh: 名. 笔记本、手册、期票簿
example: The policeman wrote it down in his notebook.
example_zh: 警察把它记在了记事本里。

zh: 名. 信纸、便条纸、笔记用纸
example: Tom reached for the notepaper.
example_zh: 汤姆伸手去拿便条纸。

zh: 名. 无、不关紧要之事、零；副. 毫不、决不
example: Nothing is so pleasant as traveling by air.
example_zh: 没有什么比坐飞机旅行更愉快了。

example: The prices are subject to change without notice.
example_zh: 价格如有变动，恕不另行通知。

example: The information is posted on the noticeboard.
example_zh: 信息贴在布告栏上。

example: The novel has been translated into many languages.
example_zh: 这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。

example: He is not a poet but a novelist.
example_zh: 他不是诗人，而是小说家。

example: It is necessary for you to start now.
example_zh: 你需要现在开始。

example: Nowadays his father goes to work by car.
example_zh: 现在他爸爸开车去上班。

example: That kind of talk will get you nowhere.
example_zh: 那种话不会让你有任何收获。

example: The number of mistakes is ten at most.
example_zh: 错误最多有十个。

example: The girl who Brown married is a nurse.
example_zh: 布朗娶的那个女孩是护士。

example: I don't mean to object to your proposal.
example_zh: 我不是想反对你的提议。

zh: 形. 明显的、明白的、显然的
example: The reason he refused your offer is obvious.
example_zh: 他拒绝你提议的原因很明显。

zh: 副. 显而易见地、明显地
example: Obviously, the server load will increase as a result.
example_zh: 显然，服务器负载会因此增加。

example: I meet him on occasion at the club.
example_zh: 我偶尔在俱乐部遇见他。

example: Let's occasionally change where we go to eat out.
example_zh: 我们偶尔换个地方出去吃饭吧。

zh: 名. 职业、占有、占有期
example: What is your occupation? What do you do here?
example_zh: 你的职业是什么？你在这里做什么？

example: Swimming in the ocean is my greatest pleasure.
example_zh: 在海里游泳是我最大的乐趣。

example: Make sure that you arrive at seven o'clock.
example_zh: 一定要在七点到达。

example: You can't expect me to always think of everything!
example_zh: 你不能指望我总能想到所有事情！

example: Of course you can borrow my pen.
example_zh: 你当然可以借我的笔。

example: I would rather you had a day off.
example_zh: 我宁愿你休一天假。

zh: 名. 给予(物)、出价、提议；动. 提供、出价、奉献、出现
example: I couldn't help but turn down his offer.
example_zh: 我忍不住拒绝了他的提议。

example: Concert tickets are on sale at this office.
example_zh: 音乐会门票在这个办公室出售。

example: This accident has nothing to do with me, officer.
example_zh: 警官，这起事故和我无关。

example: How often do you study English at school?
example_zh: 你在学校多久学一次英语？

zh: 叹. interj. (表示惊讶、恐怖、赞叹)哦
example: Mr. Oh came to Japan to study Japanese.
example_zh: 吴先生来日本学习日语。

zh: 叹. 哎呀（表示惊讶或遗憾）
example: Oh dear! I forgot my homework.
example_zh: 哎呀！我忘了我的作业。

zh: 名. 油、石油、油画颜料
example: We will run short of oil some day.
example_zh: 总有一天我们会缺石油。

example: Is it OK if I open the window?
example_zh: 我打开窗户可以吗？

zh: 形. 老的、旧的、古老的
example: I am too old for this world.
example_zh: 我对这个世界来说太老了。

zh: 形. 旧式的、过时的、保守的
example: My grandmother has an old-fashioned phone.
example_zh: 我奶奶有一部老式电话。

zh: 名. 橄榄、橄榄树、橄榄色
example: We'd like to order 18 tonnes of olive oil.
example_zh: 我们想订购18吨橄榄油。

example: Do you know how to make an omelette?
example_zh: 你知道怎么做煎蛋卷吗？

example: I can't wait to go on a vacation.
example_zh: 我迫不及待想去度假。

zh: 介. 在船/车/飞机上、在公共交通车辆上
example: Dinner will be served on board the plane.
example_zh: 晚餐将在飞机上供应。

example: I have come to see you on business.
example_zh: 我来是找你谈公事的。

example: It is necessary that you start at once.
example_zh: 你有必要马上出发。

example: One million people lost their lives in the war.
example_zh: 一百万人在战争中丧生。

example: I was surprised to find it on fire.
example_zh: 我惊讶地发现它着火了。

example: Will you go on foot or by bus?
example_zh: 你走路去还是坐公交车去？

example: They are all away on holiday this week.
example_zh: 他们这周都外出度假了。

example: I only need one onion for this recipe.
example_zh: 这个食谱我只需要一个洋葱。

example: She is never online, even during her vacation.
example_zh: 她从来不在线，甚至在度假时也不上线。

zh: 副. 只有、仅仅、只能；形. 唯一的、仅有的、最佳的
example: I only wanted to help.
example_zh: 我只是想帮忙。

example: The boy stepped on my foot on purpose.
example_zh: 那个男孩故意踩了我的脚。

example: Other colours are available on request.
example_zh: 如有要求，也可提供其他颜色。

example: Concert tickets are on sale at this office.
example_zh: 音乐会门票在这个办公室出售。

example: You ought to get to work on time.
example_zh: 你应该准时上班。

example: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
example_zh: 跳上行驶中的火车很危险。

example: I can't choose where to go on vacation.
example_zh: 我不能选择去哪里度假。

zh: 形. 开着的、开放的、开阔的；动. 打开、公开、开放、展开
example: I'll open the curtain for you to look out.
example_zh: 我给你拉开窗帘，让你往外看。

zh: 名. 营业时间、开放时间
example: The new opening hours are on the website.
example_zh: 新的营业时间在网站上。

example: We are watching a class at the Paris Opera.
example_zh: 我们正在巴黎歌剧院观看一堂课。

zh: 动. 操作、运转、动手术
example: I don't know how to operate this computer.
example_zh: 我不知道怎么操作这台电脑。

example: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
example_zh: 医生拒绝做第二次手术。

zh: 名. 操作员、行家、经纪人
example: The operator put me through to New York.
example_zh: 接线员帮我接通了纽约的电话。

example: We had a good opinion of your son.
example_zh: 我们对你儿子的评价很高。

example: I'll speak to him at the first opportunity.
example_zh: 我一有机会就会和他谈。

example: They live in the house opposite to ours.
example_zh: 他们住在我们家对面的房子里。

zh: 名. 选择权、挑选、选项
example: Please inform me what options are available to me.
example_zh: 请告诉我我有哪些选择。

example: You can go or stay, as you wish.
example_zh: 你可以走也可以留，随你便。

zh: 形. 橘色的；名. 柑橘、桔子、橘色
example: There is an orange on the table.
example_zh: 桌子上有一个橙子。

zh: 名. 管弦乐队、乐队演奏处
example: All the orchestra were pleased with their success.
example_zh: 管弦乐团全体成员都为他们的成功感到高兴。

zh: 名. 次序、规则、命令、顺序；动. 整理、命令、定购、定货
example: We have received your order.
example_zh: 我们已经收到你的订单。

zh: 形. 平常的、普通的、平凡的
example: Sunday is not an ordinary day to me.
example_zh: 星期天对我来说不是普通的一天。

example: We do not belong to a political organisation.
example_zh: 我们不属于任何政治组织。

zh: 动. 组织、有机化、给予生机
example: How do I organise transport to and from hospital?
example_zh: 我怎样安排往返医院的交通？

zh: 形. 最初的、原始的、有创意的
example: Set your translation against the original once again.
example_zh: 把你的译文再和原文对照一次。

zh: 代. 其他的、他人、另外一个
example: Don't expect others to think for you!
example_zh: 别指望别人替你思考！

zh: 副. 否则、不同地、别的方式
example: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.
example_zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭要迟到了。

example: You ought to have come to our party.
example_zh: 你本应该来参加我们的聚会的。

example: To our surprise, she has gone to Brazil alone.
example_zh: 令我们惊讶的是，她独自去了巴西。

example: This table is just as large as ours.
example_zh: 这张桌子和我们的一样大。

example: That shows how little we know of ourselves.
example_zh: 那说明我们对自己了解得多么少。

example: We're getting out of here. The cops are coming.
example_zh: 我们要离开这里。警察来了。

zh: 形. 户外的、屋外的、露天的
example: It is cold outdoors. Put on your coat.
example_zh: 外面很冷。穿上你的外套。

example: The man and the woman are eating outdoors.
example_zh: 那个男人和那个女人在户外吃饭。

zh: 介. 在…外、离开…、从…里面
example: She took a book out of her bag.
example_zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。

example: This book is a little out of date.
example_zh: 这本书有点过时了。

zh: 介. 次序颠倒、不整齐
example: The elevator seems to be out of order.
example_zh: 电梯好像坏了。

zh: 介. 失业、机器有毛病
example: By 1897, thousands of people were out of work.
