example_zh: 到1897年，成千上万的人失业了。

example: I waited outside on the chance of seeing you.
example_zh: 我在外面等着，希望能见到你。

example: I took the cake out of the oven.
example_zh: 我把蛋糕从烤箱里拿了出来。

zh: 介. 在…之上、遍于…之上、越过；副. 结束、越过、从头到尾
example: What happened? There's water all over the apartment.
example_zh: 发生什么了？公寓里到处都是水。

zh: 形. 通宵的、晚上的、前夜的；副. 在前一夜、整夜、昨晚一晚上
example: I thought Tom would stay overnight in Boston.
example_zh: 我原以为汤姆会在波士顿过夜。

zh: 动. 亏欠、负…债、归功于、欠钱
example: I owe what I am to my father.
example_zh: 我今天的一切都要归功于我的父亲。

zh: 形. 自己的、嫡亲的、同胞的
example: They cook their own meals.
example_zh: 他们自己做饭。

zh: 名. 拥有者、物主、所有人
example: Give the book back to the owner.
example_zh: 把书还给它的主人。

zh: 动. 包装、捆扎、塞满、包装货物
example: Will you help me pack up my suitcase?
example_zh: 你帮我收拾行李箱好吗？

zh: 名. 小包、一批信件、大量
example: This jacket must have cost you a packet.
example_zh: 这件夹克一定花了你很多钱。

example: I always read the sports page first.
example_zh: 我总是先看体育版。

example: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
example_zh: 我胸口一阵剧痛。

zh: 形. 痛苦的、困难的、令人烦恼的
example: At times, he suffered from a painful headache.
example_zh: 有时候，他会头痛得很厉害。

zh: 动. 油漆、绘、画、绘画；名. 油漆、颜料、绘画作品
example: You did not need to have your house painted.
example_zh: 你本不必请人粉刷你的房子。

example: The picture was painted by a famous painter.
example_zh: 这幅画是由一位著名画家画的。

example: The cost of the painting is very high.
example_zh: 这幅画的价格很高。

example: My brother gave me a pair of jeans.
example_zh: 我哥哥给了我一条牛仔裤。

zh: 名. 宫、宫殿、华丽大厦
example: This palace was built for the rich king.
example_zh: 这座宫殿是为那位富有的国王建的。

zh: 形. 苍白的、暗淡的、无力的
example: When she heard the news, she turned pale.
example_zh: 她听到这个消息时，脸色变得苍白。

example: Don't touch that pan! It's very hot.
example_zh: 别碰那个锅！它很烫。

zh: 名. 裤子、长裤、短衬裤
example: Oh, my white pants! And they were new.
example_zh: 哦，我的白裤子！它们还是新的。

zh: 名. 纸、文件、文章；形. 纸做的、纸上的
example: All you have to do is sign this paper.
example_zh: 你只需要在这张纸上签字。

example: I just want to get this paragraph right.
example_zh: 我只想把这一段弄对。

example: Please take this parcel to the post office.
example_zh: 请把这个包裹送到邮局。

zh: 名. 原谅、赦免；动. 宽恕、原谅
example: He asked our pardon for making a mistake.
example_zh: 他因为犯了错误请求我们原谅。

zh: 名. 父母、父母亲、根源
example: Which of your parents do you take after?
example_zh: 你像你父母中的哪一位？

zh: 名. 公园、停车处；动. 停车、置于
example: We sat on a bench in the park.
example_zh: 我们坐在公园里的长椅上。

example: We have a parking lot for the customers.
example_zh: 我们有一个给顾客用的停车场。

example: We have a parking lot for the customers.
example_zh: 我们有一个给顾客用的停车场。

example: Would you like to hear the parrot talk?
example_zh: 你想听鹦鹉说话吗？

example: You do your part and I'll do the rest.
example_zh: 你做你的部分，剩下的我来做。

zh: 副. 部分地、在一定程度上
example: The wall is partly covered with ivy.
example_zh: 墙有一部分被常春藤盖住了。

zh: 形. 特别的、独有的、挑剔的
example: I love this CD - in particular the last.
example_zh: 我很喜欢这张CD，尤其是最后一首。

example: I don't particularly want to see the game.
example_zh: 我不是特别想看这场比赛。

zh: 名. 合伙人、股东、伙伴
example: I'd like you to be my partner.
example_zh: 我想让你做我的搭档。

example: Last summer, I worked part time on the farm.
example_zh: 去年夏天，我在农场做兼职。

zh: 形. 兼任的、半工半读的、部分时间的
example: He has a part-time job in a shop.
example_zh: 他在一家商店做兼职工作。

example: We will soon be ready for the party.
example_zh: 我们很快就会准备好参加聚会。

zh: 动. 经过、越过、通过、变化
example: You pass the station on the left.
example_zh: 你经过左边的车站。

example: I'm going to have to pass on that.
example_zh: 那个我只好算了。

example: There are very few passengers in the train.
example_zh: 火车上的乘客很少。

zh: 名. 护照、手段、通行证
example: You need a passport to enter a foreign country.
example_zh: 你需要护照才能进入外国。

zh: 名. 密码、口令、通行手段
example: I'm trying to break the password of this file.
example_zh: 我正在试着破解这个文件的密码。

zh: 介. 越过、晚于、超越；名. 过去、昔时、往事
example: In the past, people didn’t have laptops.
example_zh: 过去，人们没有笔记本电脑。

example: What happens if you feed your dog pasta?
example_zh: 如果你给你的狗喂意大利面，会发生什么？

example: There's a secret path on the left.
example_zh: 左边有一条秘密小路。

zh: 形. 忍耐的、容忍的、有耐性的；名. 病人、承受者
example: We got her to attend to the patient.
example_zh: 我们让她去照顾病人。

example: The colors of the pattern are very ordinary.
example_zh: 这个图案的颜色很普通。

example: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.
example_zh: 他讲了十分钟，中间没有停顿。

zh: 名. 路面、人行道、铺面路
example: One shouldn't ride a bicycle on the pavement.
example_zh: 不应该在人行道上骑自行车。

zh: 动. 支付、付清、补偿、付款
example: You will be paid according to your ability.
example_zh: 你会根据自己的能力得到报酬。

example: I play games on my PC at the weekend.
example_zh: 我周末用电脑玩游戏。

zh: 名. 豌豆、似豌豆的东西
example: Today the fog is as thick as pea soup.
example_zh: 今天的雾很浓，像豌豆汤一样。

example: We are working in the interest of peace.
example_zh: 我们正在为和平而努力。

zh: 形. 平静的、和平的、和平时期的
example: Never have I seen such a peaceful scene.
example_zh: 我从未见过如此平静的景象。

example: The peach tree is beautiful when in flower.
example_zh: 桃树开花时很美。

example: He climbed to the peak of the mountain.
example_zh: 他爬到了山顶。

zh: 名. 花生、小人物、极小的数额
example: What Tom really wanted was a peanut butter sandwich.
example_zh: 汤姆真正想要的是一个花生酱三明治。

example: Do you prefer the apple or the pear?
example_zh: 你更喜欢苹果还是梨？

example: This cross street is busy with pedestrian traffic.
example_zh: 这条横街上行人很多。

zh: 动. 削…皮、剥去…的壳、蜕皮、剥落
example: Peel the apple before you eat it.
example_zh: 吃苹果前先削皮。

example: Write with a pen, not with a pencil.
example_zh: 用钢笔写，不要用铅笔写。

zh: 名. (非正式)copper便士、(美)分、分币
example: I offered him fifty pence and he accepted.
example_zh: 我提出给他五十便士，他接受了。

example: Put down your pencil and listen to me.
example_zh: 放下铅笔，听我说。

example: My pencil case is full of pens and pencils.
example_zh: 我的铅笔盒里装满了钢笔和铅笔。

example: She wrote letters to her penfriend every week.
example_zh: 她每周给她的笔友写信。

zh: 名. 企鹅、空军地勤人员
example: A penguin is a bird that cannot fly.
example_zh: 企鹅是一种不会飞的鸟。

example: Without a job, I cannot save a penny.
example_zh: 没有工作，我一分钱也存不下来。

zh: 名. 人、人民、民族；动. 使住满人、居住于
example: People should understand that the world is changing.
example_zh: 人们应该明白，世界正在改变。

zh: 名. 胡椒粉、胡椒、辣椒
example: We've just run out of salt and pepper.
example_zh: 我们刚刚用完了盐和胡椒。

example: We have a single for 50 dollars per night.
example_zh: 我们有一间单人房，每晚五十美元。

zh: 名. 百分比、百分数、部分
example: Only 40 percent of students go on to university.
example_zh: 只有百分之四十的学生继续上大学。

zh: 形. 完美的、完好的、理想的
example: We all know that no one is perfect.
example_zh: 我们都知道，没有人是完美的。

zh: 副. 完全地、无瑕疵地、完整地
example: Few people can speak a foreign language perfectly.
example_zh: 很少有人能完美地说一门外语。

example: The children will perform a play for their parents.
example_zh: 孩子们将为父母表演一出戏。

example: The concert was a wonderful performance.
example_zh: 这场音乐会是一场精彩的演出。

zh: 名. 表演者、执行者、完成者
example: I'm really not much of a performer.
example_zh: 我真的不太会表演。

zh: 名. 香水、香气、(悦人的)气氛
example: The flowers give off a very pleasant perfume.
example_zh: 这些花散发出非常宜人的香味。

example: Perhaps it will rain in the afternoon.
example_zh: 也许下午会下雨。

example: Next period I take an exam in German.
example_zh: 下一节课我要参加德语考试。

zh: 形. 永久的、不变的、固定的
example: Do you want your permanent to look natural?
example_zh: 你想让你的烫发看起来自然吗？

example: You shouldn't read people's private letters without permission.
example_zh: 你不应该未经允许读别人的私人信件。

zh: 动. 允许、容许、可能、给以机会
example: Dogs are not permitted here.
example_zh: 这里不允许狗进入。

example: The boy was permitted to go with them.
example_zh: 那个男孩被允许和他们一起去。

example: Each person has his own way of doing things.
example_zh: 每个人都有自己做事的方式。

zh: 形. 私人的、涉及隐私的、有人性的
example: I brought you up under my personal care.
example_zh: 我亲自照顾你，把你养大。

zh: 副. 亲自地、个别地、当面
example: I want to take care of Tom personally.
example_zh: 我想亲自照顾汤姆。

zh: 动. 劝、使相信、恳求、劝服
example: It is difficult for us to persuade him.
example_zh: 我们很难说服他。

zh: 名. 宠物、受宠爱的人、宠坏的孩子
example: They are both working at the pet store.
example_zh: 他们俩都在宠物店工作。

example: The cost of petrol keeps on going up.
example_zh: 汽油的价格一直在上涨。

example: We stopped at a petrol station on the way.
example_zh: 我们在路上停在一个加油站。

zh: 名. 药房、配药学、制药业
example: The young chemist decided to open a pharmacy.
example_zh: 那位年轻的药剂师决定开一家药店。

zh: 动. 打电话给、打电话；名. 电话、受话器、耳机
example: A Mr Brown wants you on the phone.
example_zh: 有一位布朗先生打电话找你。

example: This is a photo of my family.
example_zh: 这是我家的全家福。

example: Do you make photocopies? I need ten of them.
example_zh: 你们复印吗？我需要十份。

zh: 名. 相片、照片、逼真的描绘；动. 照相、摄影
example: Attach a recent photograph to your application form.
example_zh: 把一张近照贴在申请表上。

example: I know the photographer who took this picture.
example_zh: 我认识拍这张照片的摄影师。

example: Photography is now considered a new form of art.
example_zh: 摄影现在被认为是一种新的艺术形式。

zh: 名. 惯用语、词组、成语
example: Look up the phrase in your dictionary.
example_zh: 在词典里查这个短语。

zh: 名. 物理学、物理过程、物理现象
example: Some students like English, and others like physics.
example_zh: 有些学生喜欢英语，另一些学生喜欢物理。

example: I was able to play piano very well.
example_zh: 我那时钢琴弹得很好。

example: You can pick out any book you like.
example_zh: 你可以挑选任何你喜欢的书。

example: I pick up my little brother from school.
example_zh: 我去学校接我弟弟。

zh: 名. 野餐、远足、愉快的经历
example: The picnic was called off because of rain.
example_zh: 因为下雨，野餐被取消了。

example: I hope to see his picture soon.
example_zh: 我希望很快看到他的照片。

example: You have to have a piece of pie.
example_zh: 你必须吃一块馅饼。

example: I'll give you a piece of my mind.
example_zh: 我要对你说说我的看法。

zh: 名. 猪、猪肉、贪婪的人
example: I used to eat like a pig.
example_zh: 我以前吃饭像猪一样。

example: This car is a pile of rubbish.
example_zh: 这辆车就是一堆垃圾。

example: I'm giving a pill to the cat.
example_zh: 我正在给这只猫喂一颗药。

zh: 名. 枕头、靠垫、枕状岩
example: She laid her head down on the pillow.
example_zh: 她把头放在枕头上。

zh: 名. 飞行员、领航员、航船者
example: I have a friend who is a pilot.
example_zh: 我有一个朋友是飞行员。

zh: 名. 大头针、针、别针；动. 将…用针别住、钉住、压住
example: The picture was held on by a pin.
example_zh: 那幅画是用一枚图钉固定住的。

zh: 名. 凤梨、菠萝、失业救济金
example: I don't like pineapple. It smells pretty sour.
example_zh: 我不喜欢菠萝。它闻起来很酸。

zh: 形. 粉红的、石竹科的、比较激进的
example: Who is the girl in the pink dress?
example_zh: 那个穿粉色连衣裙的女孩是谁？

example: He spoke with a pipe in his mouth.
example_zh: 他嘴里叼着烟斗说话。

zh: 名. 海盗、盗印者、侵犯专利权者
example: The parrot and the pirate are best friends.
example_zh: 鹦鹉和海盗是最好的朋友。

example: I wish you could have seen him pitch.
example_zh: 我真希望你能看到他投球。

example: It's a pity that you should leave Japan.
example_zh: 你要离开日本，真遗憾。

example: My work was to deliver pizza by motorcycle.
example_zh: 我的工作是骑摩托车送披萨。

example: I'd be glad to go in your place.
example_zh: 我很乐意代替你去。

zh: 形. 简单的、明白的、平常的
example: It’s plain to me. (clear).
example_zh: 这对我来说很清楚。

zh: 名. 计划、方案、策略；动. 计划、设计、意欲、订计划
example: You ought to have adopted his plan.
example_zh: 你本应该采纳他的计划。

zh: 名. 平面、扁平物、机翼
example: The plane was late.
example_zh: 飞机晚点了。

zh: 名. 行星、命运星辰、杰出的人
example: The Earth is a small but beautiful planet.
example_zh: 地球是一颗小而美丽的行星。

example: Many workers were laid off at that plant.
example_zh: 那家工厂的许多工人被解雇了。

zh: 名. 塑料、可塑体、可塑性物质；形. 塑料的、塑造的、有可塑性的
example: Could I have a plastic bag for those?
example_zh: 能给我一个塑料袋装那些东西吗？

example: You'd better eat everything that's on your plate.
example_zh: 你最好把盘子里的东西都吃完。

example: She came close to falling off the platform.
example_zh: 她差点从站台上摔下来。

zh: 动. 玩、游戏、假装；名. 游戏、游玩、玩笑
example: You should not play a joke on me.
example_zh: 你不应该捉弄我。

zh: 名. 竞赛者、上场队员、游戏者
example: Each player on the team has his own bat.
example_zh: 队里的每个球员都有自己的球棒。

zh: 名. 运动场、操场、度假胜地
example: I saw them play baseball in the playground.
example_zh: 我看见他们在操场上打棒球。

zh: 形. 愉快的、可爱的、活泼的
example: It is pleasant to sleep under the tree.
example_zh: 在树下睡觉很舒服。

zh: 动. 使高兴、合…的心意、取悦、使人满意
example: I’m very pleased for you.
example_zh: 我为你感到非常高兴。

zh: 形. 高兴的、喜欢的、满足的
example: I am far from pleased with your behavior.
example_zh: 我对你的行为很不满意。

zh: 名. 快乐、愉快、令人高兴的事
example: To see you is always a great pleasure.
example_zh: 见到你总是一件非常愉快的事。

zh: 名. 充分、很多、丰富；形. 很多的、足够的、丰富的
example: There were plenty of guests in the hall.
example_zh: 大厅里有很多客人。

zh: 名. 小块土地、地区图、图
example: I didn't like the plot of the movie.
example_zh: 我不喜欢这部电影的情节。

zh: 名. 塞子、栓、插头；动. 插入、塞住、接插头、被塞住
example: We must find something to plug up this hole.
example_zh: 我们必须找点东西把这个洞堵上。

example: One plus two is equal to three.
example_zh: 一加二等于三。

example: We have a football match at three p.m.
example_zh: 我们下午三点有一场足球赛。

example: Show me what you have in your pocket.
example_zh: 把你口袋里的东西给我看看。

example: Ziri did that work for pocket money.
example_zh: 齐里做那份工作是为了挣零花钱。

example: I'm listening to a podcast in French.
example_zh: 我正在听一个法语播客。

zh: 名. 诗、诗般美的事物
example: The students learned this poem by heart.
example_zh: 学生们把这首诗背熟了。

example: You are made to be a poet.
example_zh: 你天生就是当诗人的。

zh: 名. 诗、韵文、诗歌艺术
example: His poetry does not translate into Japanese.
example_zh: 他的诗无法翻译成日语。

zh: 动. 弄尖、强调、指出、指
example: I cannot agree with you on this point.
example_zh: 在这一点上我不能同意你。

zh: 名. 警察、警察当局、治安
example: In case of an emergency, call the police.
example_zh: 遇到紧急情况，打电话报警。

example: The policeman cut me short in my talk.
example_zh: 警察打断了我的讲话。

example: The police officer helped us cross the road.
example_zh: 警察帮助我们过马路。

example: The police station is in the town centre.
example_zh: 警察局在市中心。

example: I haven't seen the policewoman yet.
example_zh: 我还没见到那位女警察。

zh: 形. 有礼貌的、文雅的、客气的
example: It is polite to open doors for people.
example_zh: 为别人开门是有礼貌的。

zh: 形. 政治的、政治上的、政党的
example: Last year saw a big political change in Japan.
example_zh: 去年日本发生了一次重大的政治变化。

zh: 名. 政客、政治家、从事党派政治的人
example: The politician lost his position in the end.
example_zh: 那位政治家最后失去了职位。

zh: 名. 政治、政治学、政见
example: My son took an early interest in politics.
example_zh: 我儿子很早对政治产生了兴趣。

example: Why has Japan let pollution get so bad?
example_zh: 为什么日本让污染变得这么严重？

example: The swimming pool is open to the public.
example_zh: 游泳池向公众开放。

zh: 形. 贫穷的、贫乏的、不幸的
example: Were I rich, I would help the poor.
example_zh: 如果我富有，我会帮助穷人。

zh: 名. 砰然声、枪击、含气饮料
example: I feel I'm growing out of pop music.
example_zh: 我觉得自己渐渐不喜欢流行音乐了。

zh: 形. 通俗的、流行的、受欢迎的
example: Winter sports are very popular in our country.
example_zh: 冬季运动在我国很受欢迎。

example: How large is the population of this city?
example_zh: 这座城市的人口有多少？

example: The ship at length reached the home port.
example_zh: 那艘船终于到达了母港。

example: I'm not in a position to answer.
example_zh: 我没有立场回答。

zh: 形. 肯定的、积极的、有把握的
example: He gave a positive answer to my question.
example_zh: 他对我的问题给了肯定的回答。

zh: 名. 可能性、可能的事
example: There is no possibility of our finding him.
example_zh: 我们不可能找到他。

zh: 形. 可能的、潜在的、合适的
example: We should read as many books as possible.
example_zh: 我们应该尽可能多地读书。

example: Get up as early as you possibly can.
example_zh: 尽可能早点起床。

zh: 动. 张帖、邮递、公布、快速行进；名. 柱、杆、准星
example: Bill was too young to take the post.
example_zh: 比尔太年轻，不能担任这个职位。

example: I want to send this postcard to Japan.
example_zh: 我想把这张明信片寄到日本。

example: Sami's innocent face appeared on a missing poster.
example_zh: 萨米天真无邪的脸出现在一张寻人海报上。

example: Today the postman brought your very sweet gift.
example_zh: 今天邮递员送来了你非常贴心的礼物。

example: I buy stamps at the post office.
example_zh: 我在邮局买邮票。

zh: 动. 延迟、使延期、缓办、延缓
example: You may as well postpone your departure.
example_zh: 你不妨推迟出发。

example: There is little coffee left in the pot.
example_zh: 壶里剩下的咖啡不多了。

example: I want some potatoes. Do you have any?
example_zh: 我想要一些土豆。你有吗？

example: This pottery is made by a local artist.
example_zh: 这件陶器是由一位当地艺术家制作的。

example: The book costs ten pounds.
example_zh: 这本书要十英镑。

example: The excited crowd poured out of the stadium.
example_zh: 兴奋的人群从体育场涌了出来。

example: I put the washing powder behind the bathtub.
example_zh: 我把洗衣粉放在浴缸后面。

example: It is a task beyond my power.
example_zh: 这项任务超出了我的能力。

zh: 形. 有力的、有权力的、强大的
example: His powerful speech carried the audience with him.
example_zh: 他有力的演讲感染了听众。

example: The practice has long been done away with.
example_zh: 这种做法早已被废除了。

example: You must practise if you want to play well.
example_zh: 如果你想做得好，就必须练习。

example: She used to pray before going to bed.
example_zh: 她过去常在睡觉前祈祷。

example: Ceremony is not needed for prayer, trust is.
example_zh: 祈祷不需要仪式，需要的是信任。

example: Some people say they can predict the future.
example_zh: 有些人说他们能预测未来。

zh: 动. 宁可、较喜欢、提出
example: I prefer going out to staying at home.
example_zh: 比起待在家里，我更喜欢出去。

zh: 形. 怀孕的、充满的、思想丰富的
example: I discussed baby names with my pregnant sister.
example_zh: 我和我怀孕的姐妹讨论了宝宝的名字。

example: There are 10 weeks of preparation for the exam.
example_zh: 这次考试有10周的准备时间。

zh: 动. 准备、筹备、使在思想上有准备、预备
example: You should prepare a room for the visitor.
example_zh: 你应该为客人准备一个房间。

zh: 形. 准备好的、特制的
example: We must always be prepared for the worst.
example_zh: 我们必须始终为最坏的情况做好准备。

example: Go to the doctor to get your prescription!
example_zh: 去看医生拿处方！

example: All the members were present at the meeting.
example_zh: 所有成员都出席了会议。

example: It was a successful presentation of a play.
example_zh: 那是一次成功的戏剧演出。

zh: 名. 节目主持人、奉献者、提出者
example: No wonder that the presenter sounded weird, she was sick.
example_zh: 难怪主持人听起来怪怪的，她生病了。

zh: 名. 总统、总裁、董事长
example: It was named after the first American president.
example_zh: 它以美国第一任总统的名字命名。

zh: 动. 压、压榨、紧抱、重压
example: Press the red button if something strange happens.
example_zh: 如果发生奇怪的事，就按红色按钮。

zh: 形. 漂亮的、优美的、机灵的
example: You are not less pretty than her.
example_zh: 你不比她丑。

example: We must prevent a war by all possible means.
example_zh: 我们必须用一切可能的手段防止战争。

zh: 形. 早先的、前面的、过急的
example: The accident happened previous to my arrival.
example_zh: 事故在我到达之前发生了。

example: The suspect was not previously known to police.
example_zh: 警方以前不知道这名嫌疑人。

example: Hard work is the price of success.
example_zh: 努力是成功的代价。

zh: 名. 小学、初等学校、参见：elementary school
example: That primary school has a strong soccer team.
example_zh: 那所小学有一支很强的足球队。

example: The prince learned English from the American lady.
example_zh: 王子向那位美国女士学英语。

zh: 名. 公主、王妃、女巨头
example: The soldier has died for you. Sweet princess.
example_zh: 那名士兵为你而死。亲爱的公主。

zh: 形. 主要的、最重要的、首要的
example: The principal of our school is an American.
example_zh: 我们学校的校长是美国人。

example: My new book is not yet in print.
example_zh: 我的新书还没有出版。

example: The printer in my office is broken.
example_zh: 我办公室的打印机坏了。

zh: 名. 监狱、监禁、拘留所
example: This was before John was put in prison.
example_zh: 这是在约翰被关进监狱之前。

example: The prisoner who escaped is still at large.
example_zh: 逃跑的囚犯仍然在逃。

zh: 形. 私人的、秘密的、私立的
example: I'd like to talk with you in private.
example_zh: 我想和你私下谈谈。

example: The first prize may be won by him.
example_zh: 一等奖可能会被他赢得。

example: This book probably won't be all that useful.
example_zh: 这本书可能不会那么有用。

example: There's a problem there that you don't see.
example_zh: 那里有个你看不到的问题。

zh: 动. 产生、生产、提出、制造
example: The factory will begin to produce next year.
example_zh: 这家工厂明年将开始生产。

example: Cheese and butter are products made from milk.
example_zh: 奶酪和黄油是用牛奶制成的产品。

example: The factory had to cut back its production.
example_zh: 这家工厂不得不减少生产。

example: I am way too honest for this profession.
example_zh: 对这份职业来说，我太诚实了。

zh: 名. 专业人才；形. 专业的、职业的
example: The house is being painted by a professional.
example_zh: 房子正由一位专业人员粉刷。

example: The professor seemed to be lost in thought.
example_zh: 教授似乎陷入了沉思。

zh: 名. 节目、节目单、程序
example: At any rate, the program was a success.
example_zh: 不管怎样，这个节目是成功的。

example: A good programmer will influence everyone around him.
example_zh: 一个好的程序员会影响他周围的每个人。

example: The students are making good progress in English.
example_zh: 学生们在英语上取得了很好的进步。

example: Religious education is prohibited at a public school.
example_zh: 公立学校禁止宗教教育。

example: The man is not concerned in this project.
example_zh: 这个人没有参与这个项目。

zh: 名. 诺言、约定的事情、有指望；动. 允诺、约定、预示、有前途
example: She promised to help me with my English.
example_zh: 她答应帮我学英语。

example: We must work hard to promote world peace.
example_zh: 我们必须努力促进世界和平。

example: I'm not sure how to pronounce the word.
example_zh: 我不确定这个单词怎么发音。

example: This course will help you master correct pronunciation.
example_zh: 这门课程会帮助你掌握正确的发音。

zh: 形. 适当的、固有的、高尚的
example: He needs proper medical attention at a hospital.
example_zh: 他需要在医院接受适当的治疗。

example: You've been properly led up the garden path.
example_zh: 你被彻底骗了。

zh: 名. 财产、所有权、性质
example: The storm did great damage to her property.
example_zh: 这场暴风雨给她的财产造成了很大损失。

example: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
example_zh: 我们应该告诉孩子们如何保护自己。

zh: 形. 骄傲的、自大的、自豪的
example: Mrs. North is very proud of her children.
example_zh: 诺斯太太为她的孩子们感到非常自豪。

zh: 动. 证明、查验、检验、证明是
example: Further study will prove that the theory is right.
example_zh: 进一步的研究将证明这个理论是正确的。

zh: 动. 提供、供应、规定、作准备
example: I will come provided I feel well enough.
example_zh: 只要我感觉身体够好，我就会来。

zh: 形. 公众的、公共的、公立的；名. 公众、民众
example: The event has become known to the public.
example_zh: 这件事已经为公众所知。

zh: 名. 公共交通、公共交通工具、公交车辆
example: There is no public transport in this town.
example_zh: 这个镇上没有公共交通。

example: Professor White published his first book last year.
example_zh: 怀特教授去年出版了他的第一本书。

example: The publisher said my book is too long.
example_zh: 出版商说我的书太长了。

example: You cannot pull the wool over my eyes.
example_zh: 你骗不了我。

example: I love my yellow pullover very much.
example_zh: 我非常喜欢我的黄色套头衫。

zh: 名. 抽水机、打气筒、泵
example: The pump did not act as it should have.
example_zh: 水泵没有像应该的那样工作。

zh: 动. 处罚、惩罚、严厉对待
example: I was afraid of her having been punished.
example_zh: 我担心她已经受到惩罚了。

zh: 名. 学生、门生、未成年人
example: The pupil was half asleep in class.
example_zh: 那个学生在课上半睡半醒。

zh: 名. 小狗、小动物、自负的年轻人
example: My father gave me a puppy for my birthday.
example_zh: 我爸爸在我生日时送给我一只小狗。

zh: 形. 纯的、纯净的、纯洁的
example: Pure water is necessary to our daily life.
example_zh: 纯净水对我们的日常生活是必需的。

zh: 形. 紫色的、帝王的、华而不实的
example: The purple bicycle costs less than the yellow.
example_zh: 紫色的自行车比黄色的便宜。

example: He did it on purpose. (deliberately).
example_zh: 他故意这样做的。

zh: 名. 钱包、小钱袋、金钱
example: I had my purse stolen in the bus.
example_zh: 我在公交车上钱包被偷了。

zh: 动. 推、推动、使伸出、推进
example: In case of an emergency, push this button.
example_zh: 遇到紧急情况时，按这个按钮。

example: I put on a little weight last year.
example_zh: 我去年胖了一点。

zh: 动. 放好、储存…备用、抛弃
example: He put the book away.
example_zh: 他把书收起来了。

zh: 动. 放下、不赞成、镇压
example: She put her name down for the trip.
example_zh: 她报名参加了这次旅行。

example: The meeting was put off until the.
example_zh: 会议被推迟到那个时间。

zh: 动. 把…放上去、穿上、假装
example: Put on your coat, it is cold outside.
example_zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

example: The fire was quickly put out.
example_zh: 火很快被扑灭了。

example: The pilot will be put through a drug test.
example_zh: 飞行员将接受药检。

example: The company had to put up its prices.
example_zh: 公司不得不提高价格。

example: I can't finish this part of the puzzle.
example_zh: 我拼不完拼图的这一部分。

example: Sami and Layla were both in their pyjamas.
example_zh: 萨米和莱拉都穿着睡衣。

example: We agreed to the plan without qualification.
example_zh: 我们无条件同意了这个计划。

example: He is not qualified to take the examination.
example_zh: 他没有资格参加考试。

example: This computer is second to none in quality.
example_zh: 这台电脑的质量是最好的。

example: Today, paper is used in quantity every day.
example_zh: 如今，纸每天都被大量使用。

zh: 名. 四分之一、一刻钟、季度
example: It looks like it's quarter past ten now.
example_zh: 看起来现在是十点一刻。

example: The rose is called the queen of flowers.
example_zh: 玫瑰被称为花中皇后。

example: You can always ask a question in return.
example_zh: 你总是可以问一个问题作为回应。

example: Let me know when you complete the questionnaire.
example_zh: 你填完问卷时告诉我。

zh: 名. 辫子、一队人、队列
example: There wasn't a long queue at the stadium.
example_zh: 体育场没有排长队。

zh: 形. 快的、迅速的、敏捷的
example: Be quick, or you will miss the train.
example_zh: 快点，否则你会错过火车。

example: Time goes by quickly when you're having fun.
example_zh: 玩得开心时，时间过得很快。

zh: 形. 安静的、静止的、寂静的
example: The boy cannot keep quiet for ten minutes.
example_zh: 这个男孩没法安静十分钟。

zh: 副. 安静地、沉着地、秘密地
example: She sat next to him and listened quietly.
example_zh: 她坐在他旁边，静静地听着。

zh: 动. 离开、放弃、使解除、辞职
example: Any doctor will tell you to quit smoking.
example_zh: 任何医生都会告诉你戒烟。

example: Are you quite sure?
example_zh: 你十分确定吗？

zh: 名. 考查、课堂测验、恶作剧
example: The quiz competition was a piece of cake.
example_zh: 这次问答比赛简直小菜一碟。

example: A lot of boys ran after the rabbit.
example_zh: 许多男孩追着那只兔子跑。

zh: 名. 种族、人种、赛跑；动. 与…赛跑、使疾走、使猛转、赛跑
example: No less than 3 men fell in that race.
example_zh: 在那场比赛中摔倒的男子不少于三人。

example: Welcome to the world of drag racing.
example_zh: 欢迎来到直线竞速赛的世界。

zh: 名. 球拍、喧闹、杂乱无章
example: Can I borrow your tennis racket?
example_zh: 我可以借你的网球拍吗？

zh: 名. 无线电、收音机、无线电报
example: While listening to the radio, I fell asleep.
example_zh: 我听收音机时睡着了。

example: We went to the coast by rail.
example_zh: 我们乘火车去了海边。

example: He works on the railroad as a driver.
example_zh: 他在铁路上当司机。

example: We met at the railway station at nine.
example_zh: 我们九点在火车站碰面了。

zh: 名. 雨、下雨、雨天；动. 使大量落下、下雨
example: We had a lot of rain last year.
example_zh: 去年下了很多雨。

example: You had better put on a raincoat.
example_zh: 你最好穿上雨衣。

example: The dog tracked Sami through 20 miles of rainforest.
example_zh: 那只狗穿过20英里的雨林追踪萨米。

example: Anyone with an opinion please raise their hand.
example_zh: 有意见的人请举手。

example: I'm not moving out of range of that telephone.
example_zh: 我不会走出那部电话的范围。

example: I'm starting to write a rap song today.
example_zh: 我今天开始写一首说唱歌曲。

zh: 形. 稀罕的、罕有的、珍奇的
example: I see a rare flower in the vase.
example_zh: 我看见花瓶里有一朵稀有的花。

example: When writing English, she rarely makes a mistake.
example_zh: 写英语时，她很少出错。

example: I'd rather be a bird than a fish.
example_zh: 我宁愿做鸟也不愿做鱼。

zh: 形. 生的、未加工的、生疏的
example: To my surprise, they ate the meat raw.
example_zh: 令我惊讶的是，他们生吃了肉。

zh: 动. 到达、达到、伸出、延伸
example: It was dark when I reached the hotel.
example_zh: 我到达旅馆时天已经黑了。

zh: 动. 起反应、起作用、反攻
example: How did he react to the bad news?
example_zh: 他对这个坏消息有什么反应？

example: He spent the evening reading a book.
example_zh: 他看了一晚上书。

example: A careful reader would have noticed the mistake.
example_zh: 细心的读者会注意到这个错误。

example: I spend what time I can spare reading.
example_zh: 我把能抽出的时间都用来读书。

zh: 形. 准备好的、备用的、可以使用的
example: When will it be ready?
example_zh: 它什么时候能准备好？

zh: 形. 真的、真实的、实际的
example: That used refrigerator was a real dog.
example_zh: 那台二手冰箱真是糟透了。

zh: 动. 实现、认识到、体会到
example: He realised it was true.
example_zh: 他意识到这是真的。

zh: 形. 现实的、逼真的、现实主义的
example: We need to be more realistic than that.
example_zh: 我们需要比那更现实一些。

example: It is not always easy to face reality.
example_zh: 面对现实并不总是容易的。

zh: 副. 实际上、真实地、实在
example: I really wasn't expecting that from you.
example_zh: 我真的没想到你会这样。

example: The reason is because I can speak Chinese.
example_zh: 原因是因为我会说中文。

zh: 形. 合理的、明理的、适当的
example: The price of this used car is reasonable.
example_zh: 这辆二手车的价格是合理的。

example: You can reasonably expect her to come.
example_zh: 你可以合理地期望她会来。

example: Sami and Layla tried to rebuild their family.
example_zh: 萨米和莱拉试图重建他们的家庭。

example: I am in receipt of your letter.
example_zh: 我已收到你的信。

zh: 动. 收到、接到、得到、会客
example: I received your letter the day before yesterday.
example_zh: 我前天收到了你的信。

zh: 形. 最近的、近代的、最新的
example: I'm really not up on recent TV shows.
example_zh: 我真的不太了解最近的电视节目。

zh: 名. 接待、接受、招待会
example: There were beautiful flowers on the reception desk.
example_zh: 接待台上有漂亮的花。

example: Sami went to the receptionist and checked out.
example_zh: 萨米走到接待员那里办理了退房手续。

example: I want the recipe for this. It's delicious.
example_zh: 我想要这道菜的做法。它很好吃。

example: Can you recognise the person in this picture?
example_zh: 你能认出这张照片里的人吗？

example: That's why I recommend him for the post.
example_zh: 这就是我推荐他担任这个职位的原因。

zh: 动. 记录、记载、标明、录音
example: This is the record which I bought yesterday.
example_zh: 这是我昨天买的唱片。

example: Sami has been recording his conversation with Layla.
example_zh: 萨米一直在录他和莱拉的谈话。

zh: 动. 重新获得、恢复、复原、痊愈
example: The doctor told me that I would recover soon.
example_zh: 医生告诉我我会很快康复。

zh: 动. 使再循环、重新利用、再制
example: We buy toilet paper made from recycled paper.
example_zh: 我们买用再生纸做的卫生纸。

zh: 动. 回收利用、再利用、再次应用
example: This table is made out of recycled wood.
example_zh: 这张桌子是用再生木材做的。

example: Algeria has to get serious about recycling trash.
example_zh: 阿尔及利亚必须认真对待垃圾回收。

zh: 形. 红的、红色的、红肿的
example: Press the red button if something strange happens.
example_zh: 如果发生奇怪的事，就按红色按钮。

zh: 动. 减少、分解、降低、减肥
example: Therefore, it is necessary to reduce the cost.
example_zh: 因此，降低成本是必要的。

zh: 形. 减少的、简化的、缩减的
example: I've reduced the amount of meat I eat.
example_zh: 我已经减少了我吃的肉的量。

example: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
example_zh: 我们会在用些简单茶点后继续开会。

example: There isn't much butter left in the refrigerator.
example_zh: 冰箱里剩下的黄油不多了。

example: Please cancel my order and refund the money.
example_zh: 请取消我的订单并把钱退给我。

example: You should have refused such an unfair proposal.
example_zh: 你本应该拒绝这么不公平的提议。

example: They have a different opinion regarding your problem.
example_zh: 关于你的问题，他们有不同的意见。

example: Please give my best regards to your parents.
example_zh: 请代我向你父母问好。

example: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
example_zh: 每次他逃跑后，都会回到这个地区。

zh: 动. 记录、注册、提示、登记
example: There's a long line at every cash register.
example_zh: 每个收银台前都排着长队。

example: Please show me your license and registration.
example_zh: 请给我看你的驾照和登记证。

zh: 名. 遗憾、后悔、悔恨；动. 为…感到遗憾、后悔、惋惜、感到抱歉
example: The time will come when you'll regret it.
example_zh: 总有一天你会后悔的。

zh: 形. 规则的、常例的、有秩序的
example: You must take up a regular occupation.
example_zh: 你必须从事一份固定的职业。

zh: 副. 有规则地、一丝不苟地、正式地
example: You should practice playing the piano regularly.
example_zh: 你应该定期练习弹钢琴。

example: In relation to this, I am to blame.
example_zh: 关于这件事，我应受责备。

example: There is close relationship between supply and demand.
example_zh: 供应和需求之间有密切的关系。

example: A relative came to stay with us last week.
example_zh: 上周一位亲戚来我们家住。

example: I relax by listening to music.
example_zh: 我通过听音乐来放松。

example: You can fish for sport or for relaxation.
example_zh: 你可以为了运动或放松去钓鱼。

zh: 形. 松懈的、不严密的、不严格的
example: He feels relaxed when he's playing the guitar.
example_zh: 他弹吉他时感到放松。

zh: 形. 可靠的、可信赖的
example: As far as I know, he is reliable.
example_zh: 据我所知，他很可靠。

zh: 形. 宽慰的、解除的、减轻的
example: I am very much relieved to know that.
example_zh: 知道那件事，我非常放心。

example: You'd better avoid discussion of religion and politics.
example_zh: 你最好避免讨论宗教和政治。

example: You can rely on me to help.
example_zh: 你可以依靠我来帮忙。

example: He remains calm in the face of danger.
example_zh: 面对危险，他保持冷静。

zh: 动. 记得、回忆起、记住
example: Whatever happens, please remember I'll stand by you.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，请记住我会支持你。

example: Please remind me to call John at nine.
example_zh: 请提醒我九点给约翰打电话。

example: The TV remote control is under the couch.
example_zh: 电视遥控器在沙发下面。

zh: 动. 移动、调动、除去、迁移
example: Remove your hat when you go inside.
example_zh: 进去时请摘下帽子。

example: I am looking for a house to rent.
example_zh: 我正在找出租的房子。

example: The roof is really in need of repair.
example_zh: 屋顶确实需要修理。

example: He did not repeat the truth to anyone.
example_zh: 他没有向任何人重复真相。

example: I look around but it's you I can't replace.
example_zh: 我环顾四周，但你是无法替代的。

zh: 名. 答复、回答、答辩；动. 回答、答复、回击
example: I'm sorry I didn't reply to you sooner.
example_zh: 很抱歉我没有早点回复你。

zh: 名. 报告、报道、传说；动. 报告、汇报、转述、写报道
example: Your report is pretty good, if not excellent.
example_zh: 你的报告相当不错，即使算不上优秀。

example: The reporter took down everything that was said.
example_zh: 记者把说过的一切都记录下来了。

zh: 名. 请求、需要、申请书；动. 请求、要求、邀请
example: I am willing to agree to your request.
example_zh: 我愿意同意你的请求。

example: The professor requires excellent work of his students.
example_zh: 教授要求学生们交出优秀的作业。

zh: 名. 援救、解救、营救；动. 援救、救出、营救
example: He was still alive when the rescue party arrived.
example_zh: 救援队到达时，他还活着。

zh: 名. 研究、调查、考察；动. 研究、调查
example: The results of the research were quite satisfactory.
example_zh: 研究结果相当令人满意。

zh: 名. 保留、预定、保留品
example: I'd like to make a reservation for tonight.
example_zh: 我想为今晚预订一下。

zh: 名. 储备品、贮量、后备军；动. 保留、保存、预订
example: She was a reserve for the team.
example_zh: 她是球队的替补队员。

zh: 名. 度假胜地、手段、凭借
example: Access to the resort is quite easy.
example_zh: 去度假村很方便。

zh: 名. 尊敬、尊重、问候；动. 尊敬、注意、遵守
example: I respect you for what you have done.
example_zh: 我为你所做的事而尊重你。

zh: 形. 有责任的、负责的、责任重大的
example: You are responsible for what you have done.
example_zh: 你要对你所做的事负责。

zh: 名. 休息、睡眠、安息；动. 使休息、使支撑、把…寄托于、休息
example: You should have a rest after the long walk.
example_zh: 走了这么远，你应该休息一下。

example: A welcome party took place in the restaurant.
example_zh: 一场欢迎会在餐厅举行了。

example: You should not think little of this result.
example_zh: 你不应该小看这个结果。

zh: 动. 使…撤退、辞退、引退、退役
example: Grandfather has retired because he is getting old.
example_zh: 爷爷已经退休了，因为他年纪大了。

example: They gave me a vase on my retirement.
example_zh: 我退休时他们送了我一个花瓶。

zh: 名. 回来、返回、来回票；动. 归还、还、回报、返回
example: I am glad that you have returned safe.
example_zh: 很高兴你平安回来了。

example: All entries are subject to review once added.
example_zh: 所有条目添加后都要接受审核。

example: I have to revise for a biology test.
example_zh: 我得为生物考试复习。

zh: 名. 校订、修正、修订本
example: The revision of this dictionary took six years.
example_zh: 这本词典的修订花了六年时间。

example: He wasn't given any reward for his service.
example_zh: 他因自己的服务没有得到任何奖励。

example: Do you know how to cook rice well?
example_zh: 你知道怎样把米饭煮好吗？

zh: 形. 富裕的、富饶的、浓厚的
example: If I get rich, I will buy it.
example_zh: 如果我发财了，我就买它。

zh: 名. 骑马、乘坐、乘车；动. 骑、乘坐、压迫、骑马
example: I had a terrible accident riding this bike.
example_zh: 我骑这辆自行车时出了很严重的事故。

zh: 名. 骑手、(文件后的)附件、扶手
example: Then he would give his letters to another rider.
example_zh: 然后他会把他的信交给另一位骑手。

example: The boy riding a bicycle is my brother.
example_zh: 骑自行车的那个男孩是我兄弟。

zh: 名. 权利、右边、正义；形. 正确的、对的、恰当的；副. 正确地、以有利结果、一直
example: He swam to the right.
example_zh: 他向右游去。

zh: 形. 用右手的、右侧的
example: The shop is on the right-hand side.
example_zh: 那家商店在右手边。

zh: 名. 环、环形物、拳击场；动. 包围、套住、按铃、成环形
example: He bought her a gold ring.
example_zh: 他给她买了一枚金戒指。

zh: 动. 回电话、再打电话
example: Sami put the ring back in the box.
example_zh: 萨米把戒指放回盒子里。

zh: 动. (英)打电话、(美)把款项打在现金收入记录机上、在现金收入机上记录所付钱款
example: Ziri picked the ring up from the floor.
example_zh: 齐里从地板上捡起了戒指。

zh: 动. 使飞起、升起、起身、起立
example: There was a sharp rise in prices last year.
example_zh: 去年物价急剧上涨。

example: Fish have stopped living in this river.
example_zh: 鱼已经不再生活在这条河里了。

example: Look out! There's a hole in the road.
example_zh: 小心！路上有个洞。

zh: 动. 烤、炙、烘焙；形. 烘烤的、烤过的
example: Dad uses fire to roast a chicken.
example_zh: 爸爸用火烤鸡。

example: It was Tom's idea to rob the bank.
example_zh: 抢劫银行是汤姆的主意。

zh: 名. 机械人、自动机械、机械般工作的人
example: That computer is what we call a robot.
example_zh: 那台电脑就是我们所说的机器人。

example: Rock is the music of the young.
example_zh: 摇滚乐是年轻人的音乐。

example: They sent a rocket into space.
example_zh: 他们把一枚火箭送入了太空。

example: Sports play an important role in social life.
example_zh: 体育运动在社会生活中起着重要作用。

example: The teacher called the roll in class.
example_zh: 老师在课堂上点名。

zh: 名. 冒险故事、浪漫史、传奇文学
example: His romance was the talk of the town.
example_zh: 他的恋情成了镇上的热门话题。

zh: 形. 浪漫的、风流的、传奇性的
example: I knew Tom would do something romantic.
example_zh: 我知道汤姆会做些浪漫的事。

example: Look at the house with the red roof.
example_zh: 看那座红屋顶的房子。

example: I made the best of my small room.
example_zh: 我尽量利用了我的小房间。

example: I didn't know you had a roommate.
example_zh: 我不知道你有个室友。

example: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.
example_zh: 这根绳子不够结实，支撑不住他。

zh: 名. 玫瑰、蔷薇、玫瑰色
example: There are some beautiful roses in the vase.
example_zh: 花瓶里有一些美丽的玫瑰。

zh: 形. 粗糙的、粗暴的、蓬乱的
example: I have a rough idea where it is.
example_zh: 我大致知道它在哪里。

zh: 形. 圆的、球形的、丰满的
example: The gate is closed all the year round.
example_zh: 这扇门一年到头都关着。

example: Keep going until you get to the roundabout.
example_zh: 继续走，直到你到达环岛。

example: I can't decide which route to take to Boston.
example_zh: 我决定不了去波士顿该走哪条路线。

zh: 名. 常规、日常工作、惯例
example: Don't worry, it is part of my routine.
example_zh: 别担心，这是我日常安排的一部分。

example: Yes! I won twice in a row!
example_zh: 太好了！我连续赢了两次！

zh: 名. 橡皮、橡胶、做摩擦动作的人
example: Sorry, I won't do it without a rubber.
example_zh: 对不起，没有橡皮我就不做。

example: Can you throw the rubbish in the bin?
example_zh: 你能把垃圾扔进垃圾桶吗？

zh: 形. 粗鲁无礼的、粗陋的、粗暴的
example: It is rude of you to say so.
example_zh: 你这样说很无礼。

zh: 名. 小块地毯、揭露某人
example: I put down a rug under my desk.
example_zh: 我在书桌下面铺了一块地毯。

zh: 名. 橄榄球、橄榄球赛
example: I like such sports as soccer and rugby.
example_zh: 我喜欢足球和橄榄球这样的运动。

example: He ruined his health by working too much.
example_zh: 他工作太多，把身体搞坏了。

zh: 名. 规则、统治、控制；动. 规定、统治、管理、管辖
example: The rules require us all to be present.
example_zh: 规则要求我们所有人都到场。

zh: 名. 统治者、管理者、尺、划线板
example: I bought a book and he a ruler.
example_zh: 我买了一本书，他买了一把尺子。

zh: 动. 使跑、参赛、追究、跑
example: Generally speaking, boys can run faster than girls.
example_zh: 一般来说，男孩跑得比女孩快。

zh: 名. 跑步者、赛跑者、送信人
example: She was a strong, fast runner then.
example_zh: 她那时是个强壮、跑得快的跑步者。

example: A mouse is running about in the room.
example_zh: 一只老鼠在房间里跑来跑去。

example: He ran out of time and didn’t finish.
example_zh: 他时间不够了，没有完成。

example: The movie was so sad that everybody cried.
example_zh: 这部电影太悲伤了，每个人都哭了。

zh: 形. 安全的、可靠的、平安的
example: I have some things in the hotel safe.
example_zh: 我在酒店保险箱里有些东西。

example: He returned home safely, which pleased his parents.
example_zh: 他平安回到家，这让他的父母很高兴。

zh: 动. 航行于、驾船、航行、启航
example: There was a ship sailing on the sea.
example_zh: 有一艘船在海上航行。

zh: 名. 航行、航海术、启航
example: There were white clouds sailing in the sky.
example_zh: 天上有白云飘过。

example: A sailor is at sea much of the time.
example_zh: 水手大部分时间都在海上。

example: You have the choice of soup or salad.
example_zh: 你可以选择汤或沙拉。

example: We can hardly keep alive on this salary.
example_zh: 靠这份工资我们几乎活不下去。

example: I bought this T-shirt on sale.
example_zh: 我买了这件打折的T恤。

example: The salesman showed us three different cars.
example_zh: 推销员给我们看了三辆不同的汽车。

example: Salmon lay their eggs in fresh water.
example_zh: 鲑鱼在淡水中产卵。

example: He asked me to pass him the salt.
example_zh: 他让我把盐递给他。

zh: 形. 相同的、同样的；代. 相同的人(或事物)
example: Maybe it will be exactly the same for him.
example_zh: 也许对他来说会完全一样。

example: The bottle was filled with what looked like sand.
example_zh: 瓶子里装满了看起来像沙子的东西。

zh: 名. 凉鞋、拖鞋、檀香木
example: The boy lost his sandal in the field.
example_zh: 男孩在田里丢了一只凉鞋。

zh: 名. 三明治、夹心面包、夹层板
example: You really put that much in the sandwich?
example_zh: 你真的在三明治里放了那么多吗？

example: That house is not satisfactory for my needs.
example_zh: 那所房子不能满足我的需要。

example: I was less than satisfied with the results.
example_zh: 我对结果不太满意。

example: What sauce do you use for this dish?
example_zh: 这道菜你用什么酱？

zh: 名. (长柄有盖)深平底锅、炖锅
example: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her saucepan.
example_zh: 齐里问里玛能不能借她的炖锅。

example: We believed it to be a flying saucer.
example_zh: 我们相信它是一个飞碟。

example: He dropped the sausage on the ground.
example_zh: 他把香肠掉在地上了。

zh: 动. 解救、挽救、储蓄、节省
example: The doctor arrived in time to save her.
example_zh: 医生及时赶到救了她。

example: Did you say that I could never win?
example_zh: 你说过我不可能赢吗？

zh: 形. 害怕的、担惊受怕的、惊慌的
example: I was scared that you might leave me.
example_zh: 我害怕你可能会离开我。

example: The girl has a scarf around her neck.
example_zh: 那个女孩脖子上围着一条围巾。

zh: 形. 容易受惊的、胆小的、提心吊胆的
example: I have never read such a scary novel.
example_zh: 我从未读过这么恐怖的小说。

example: The scene from the hotel was very beautiful.
example_zh: 从旅馆看到的景色非常美。

zh: 名. 风景、景色、舞台布景
example: The beauty of the scenery is beyond description.
example_zh: 风景之美无法形容。

example: Hurry up, or you'll be late for school.
example_zh: 快点，否则你上学要迟到了。

example: Every schoolchild has to wear a uniform here.
example_zh: 这里每个学生都必须穿校服。

example: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
example_zh: 科学给我们的生活带来了许多变化。

zh: 名. 科幻、科学幻想小说、科幻小说
example: He is a big science fiction fan.
example_zh: 他是个超级科幻迷。

zh: 形. 科学的、系统的、符合科学规律的
example: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
example_zh: 这些说法没有科学依据。

example: Scientists began to find answers to these questions.
example_zh: 科学家们开始寻找这些问题的答案。

example: I found nothing but a pair of scissors.
example_zh: 我只找到了一把剪刀。

zh: 名. 小型摩托车、踏板车
example: Benedito enjoys riding his scooter to work.
example_zh: 贝内迪托喜欢骑他的踏板车去上班。

zh: 名. 得分、抓痕、二十个；动. 刻划、划线、获得、刻痕
example: The lower a golf score is, the better.
example_zh: 高尔夫球分数越低越好。

zh: 名. 尖叫声；动. 尖叫着说、大叫大嚷着要求、尖叫、大笑
example: All at once, I heard a scream.
example_zh: 突然，我听到一声尖叫。

example: The words would appear on his computer screen.
example_zh: 这些字会出现在他的电脑屏幕上。

example: There is a glass sculpture in the garden.
example_zh: 花园里有一座玻璃雕塑。

example: There is a low hill near the sea.
example_zh: 海边有一座低矮的小山。

zh: 名. 搜寻、查究；动. 搜寻、搜查、探求
example: Many men went west in search of gold.
example_zh: 许多男人去西部寻找金子。

example: In the summer, people go to the seaside.
example_zh: 夏天，人们去海边。

zh: 名. 季节、时节、当令期
example: The dry season will set in soon.
example_zh: 旱季很快就要开始了。

example: Stick the bag down under the seat.
example_zh: 把包塞到座位下面。

example: Fasten your seat belt when you drive.
example_zh: 开车时系好安全带。

zh: 形. 第二的、其次的、次要的；名. 秒、瞬间、第二名
example: He is second to none in his English class.
example_zh: 在他的英语班上，他是最好的。

zh: 形. 中级的、中等的、次要的
example: I am a teacher in the secondary school.
example_zh: 我是一所中学的老师。

zh: 形. 用过的、旧货的、旧的
example: I bought a second-hand bicycle.
example_zh: 我买了一辆二手自行车。

zh: 形. 秘密的、极机密的、隐蔽的；名. 秘密、机密、秘诀
example: You may as well keep it a secret.
example_zh: 你不妨保守这个秘密。

example: Mr Wood has his secretary type his letters.
example_zh: 伍德先生让秘书打他的信。

example: The bus fare here is 90 yen a section.
example_zh: 这里的公交车费是每段90日元。

zh: 名. 安全、安全性、防护物
example: State your name and social security number, please.
example_zh: 请说出你的姓名和社会安全号码。

example: Dan got a job as a security guard.
example_zh: 丹找到了一份保安的工作。

zh: 动. 看见、查看、参观、看
example: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
example_zh: 如果你看到错误，请改正它。

example: The professor seemed to be lost in thought.
example_zh: 教授似乎陷入了沉思。

example: We must select a suitable person for any post.
example_zh: 我们必须为每个职位挑选合适的人。

example: Can I take a selfie with you?
example_zh: 我可以和你拍一张自拍吗？

zh: 形. 自私的、利己主义的、自我中心的
example: Perhaps you are right, I have been selfish.
example_zh: 也许你是对的，我一直很自私。

zh: 名. 自我服务、自助式销售
example: It is a self-service restaurant.
example_zh: 这是一家自助餐厅。

example: I should sell it while it still runs.
example_zh: 我应该趁它还能用的时候把它卖掉。

zh: 动. 发送、使进入、寄、寄信
example: Send me a racket and my tennis shoes.
example_zh: 给我寄一把球拍和我的网球鞋。

example: What you are saying does not make sense.
example_zh: 你说的话没有道理。

zh: 形. 有感觉的、敏感的、明智的
example: What he says sounds very sensible to me.
example_zh: 他说的话在我听来很有道理。

example: Make a sentence with each of these words.
example_zh: 用这些单词各造一个句子。

zh: 形. 分开的、各别的、单独的
example: She finally decided to separate from her husband.
example_zh: 她最后决定和丈夫分开。

example: Which drama series do you like best?
example_zh: 你最喜欢哪部电视剧？

zh: 形. 严肃的、认真的、重要的
example: She is a very serious person.
example_zh: 她是一个非常严肃的人。

zh: 副. 严肃地、认真地、严重地
example: It is foolish to take his word seriously.
example_zh: 把他的话当真很愚蠢。

zh: 动. 可作…用、服务、经历、服役
example: We must always try to serve others.
example_zh: 我们必须一直努力为别人服务。

zh: 名. 服伺者、上菜用具、发球员、服务器
example: The new server should have much better performance.
example_zh: 新服务器的性能应该好得多。

example: That bank over there would do the service.
example_zh: 那边那家银行可以办理这项业务。

zh: 名. 期间、开庭期、会议
example: They held a special session on trade problems.
example_zh: 他们召开了一次关于贸易问题的特别会议。

example: Hurry up and set the table for dinner.
example_zh: 快点摆好桌子准备吃晚饭。

example: She set off early for work.
example_zh: 她早早出发去上班。

example: They set out on the long journey.
example_zh: 他们踏上了漫长的旅程。

example: I hear you'll set up a new company.
example_zh: 我听说你要创办一家新公司。

example: I haven't heard from him in several months.
example_zh: 我好几个月没收到他的消息了。

example: Would you sew a button on my shirt?
example_zh: 你能在我的衬衫上缝一颗纽扣吗？

example: She is well spoken of among her own sex.
example_zh: 她在女性当中很受好评。

example: They sat in the shade of a tree.
example_zh: 他们坐在树荫下。

example: The girl was afraid of her own shadow.
example_zh: 那个女孩害怕自己的影子。

zh: 动. 摇动、动摇、使震动、震动
example: Our eyes should meet when we shake hands.
example_zh: 我们握手时应该目光相对。

example: I shall not change my mind, whatever happens.
example_zh: 不管发生什么，我都不会改变主意。

example: He is dead to all sense of shame.
example_zh: 他完全不知羞耻。

zh: 名. 洗头、洗发剂；动. 洗头、洗发
example: I don't shampoo my hair in the morning.
example_zh: 我早上不洗头。

example: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.
example_zh: 火势呈扇形蔓延开来。

example: My brother and I shared the room.
example_zh: 我和我兄弟合住这个房间。

example: God has been very kind to the shark.
example_zh: 上帝对鲨鱼一直很好。

zh: 形. 锋利的、明显的、敏锐的
example: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
example_zh: 我胸口一阵剧痛。

zh: 动. 修面、剃、修剪、刮脸
example: It is pleasant to shave off my beard.
example_zh: 刮掉我的胡子很舒服。

example: Either you or she has to go there.
example_zh: 你或者她得去那里。

example: He tried to take hold of the sheep.
example_zh: 他试图抓住那只羊。

example: Did you have a sheet of paper then?
example_zh: 你当时有一张纸吗？

example: You have too many books on the shelf.
example_zh: 你书架上的书太多了。

zh: 动. 使发光、照耀、发光、发亮
example: The game will be played rain or shine.
example_zh: 比赛将风雨无阻地进行。

zh: 形. 有光泽的、发光的、辉煌的
example: I had never seen such a shiny star.
example_zh: 我从没见过如此闪亮的星星。

example: We could see the ship in the distance.
example_zh: 我们能看见远处的船。

example: You must change your shirt - it's got wet.
example_zh: 你得换件衬衫——你的衬衫湿了。

example: It must have been a shock to you.
example_zh: 这对你来说一定是个打击。

example: We were so shocked at his sudden death.
example_zh: 我们对他的突然去世感到非常震惊。

zh: 形. 令人震惊的、极坏的、不正当的
example: I wish I could say this was shocking.
example_zh: 我希望我可以说这很令人震惊。

example: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
example_zh: 你的鞋子和这套西装不搭。

zh: 动. 射击、射中、损毁、射出
example: It took several months to shoot that film.
example_zh: 拍摄那部电影花了好几个月。

zh: 名. 商店、工厂、车间；动. 选购、购物、到处寻找
example: Is there a photo shop in the hotel?
example_zh: 酒店里有照片冲印店吗？

example: The shop assistant was very helpful.
example_zh: 那个店员非常乐于助人。

example: I'm not wealthy enough to afford a personal shopper.
example_zh: 我没有那么有钱，雇不起私人购物顾问。

example: Let’s go shopping tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们明天去购物吧。

zh: 名. 海岸、海滨、斜撑柱
example: We walked along the shore of the lake.
example_zh: 我们沿着湖岸散步。

example: To make a long story short, we married.
example_zh: 长话短说，我们结婚了。

zh: 副. 不久、简短、唐突地
example: He waited until ten and left shortly afterwards.
example_zh: 他等到十点，不久后就离开了。

zh: 名. 短裤、(美)男人的短衬裤
example: Today was definitely shorts and T-shirt weather.
example_zh: 今天绝对是穿短裤和T恤的天气。

example: You should have helped him with his work.
example_zh: 你本应该帮他做他的工作。

example: The rich friend gave him the cold shoulder.
example_zh: 那个有钱的朋友对他很冷淡。

zh: 动. 高喊、呼喊、喊叫、嚷
example: Don't shout like that. I can hear you perfectly.
example_zh: 别那样大喊。我完全听得见你。

zh: 动. 表示、显示、展现、露面；名. 显示、表现、展览
example: I will show you how to solve it.
example_zh: 我会给你演示怎么解决它。

example: He showed up at the party.
example_zh: 他出现在聚会上。

example: I was caught in a shower just now.
example_zh: 我刚才被阵雨淋到了。

zh: 动. 关上、闭起、幽禁、停止营业
example: A door must be either shut or open.
example_zh: 门要么关着，要么开着。

zh: 形. 胆怯的、畏缩的、迟疑的
example: She seems the least shy of the three.
example_zh: 她似乎是三个人中最不害羞的。

zh: 形. 不舒服、有病的、恶心的
example: We came on account of your sick mother.
example_zh: 我们是因为你生病的母亲来的。

example: There is a small shop on this side of the street.
example_zh: 街道这边有一家小商店。

example: Her sight is better with glasses.
example_zh: 她戴上眼镜后视力更好。

example: Canada is a great place for sightseeing.
example_zh: 加拿大是观光的好地方。

example: There is no sign of life on Mars.
example_zh: 火星上没有生命的迹象。

zh: 名. 信号、暗号、近因；动. 向…作信号、标志、用信号通知、发信号
example: The taxi stopped dead at the traffic signal.
example_zh: 出租车在红绿灯前突然停住了。

zh: 名. 签字、识别标志、调号
example: Please return one set to us with your signature.
example_zh: 请把一套签上你的名字后还给我们。

zh: 名. 招牌柱、广告柱、路标
example: There's a signpost at the crossroads.
example_zh: 十字路口有一个路标。

zh: 动. 签约参加工作、签约雇用
example: My mother signed up for the art course.
example_zh: 我妈妈报名了美术课。

example: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
example_zh: 说话是银，沉默是金。

zh: 形. 沉默的、安静的、无声的
example: Not knowing what to say, he remained silent.
example_zh: 不知道该说什么，他保持沉默。

zh: 形. 丝的、丝织的；名. 丝、绸、绸锻类
example: This beautiful dress is made of silk.
example_zh: 这条漂亮的连衣裙是丝绸做的。

example: I need to ask you a silly question.
example_zh: 我需要问你一个傻问题。

zh: 名. 银、银币、银器；形. 银的、银制的、银器的
example: They wanted to deal in gold and silver.
example_zh: 他们想做金银买卖。

example: I remember hearing a very similar story to that.
example_zh: 我记得听过一个和那非常相似的故事。

zh: 形. 简单的、普通的、朴素的
example: This is a story written in simple English.
example_zh: 这是一个用简单英语写的故事。

example: Since I got a raise, I can manage.
example_zh: 我加了薪，所以能应付了。

example: I sincerely hope it won't come to that.
example_zh: 我真心希望不会到那一步。

zh: 动. 唱、歌颂、唱歌、演唱
example: We want you to sing the song.
example_zh: 我们想让你唱这首歌。

example: The singer is going to be a hit.
example_zh: 这位歌手会大受欢迎。

example: The girl singing over there is my sister.
example_zh: 在那边唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。

zh: 形. 单身的、单程的、单一的
example: A single mistake, and you are a failure.
example_zh: 只要犯一个错，你就是失败者。

zh: 名. 藏垢的场所、沟渠、污水槽
example: I wish I could sink through the floor.
example_zh: 我真希望能钻进地缝里。

example: How many are there in your party, sir?
example_zh: 先生，你们一行有几个人？

example: My older sister often drinks tea with milk.
example_zh: 我姐姐经常喝加牛奶的茶。

zh: 动. 使就座、骑、坐、就座
example: The neighbors took turns sitting up with him.
example_zh: 邻居们轮流熬夜陪着他。

zh: 动. 坐下、占据、参加静坐罢工(或示威)
example: Please sit down and have some tea.
example_zh: 请坐下喝点茶。

example: This is the site of a castle.
example_zh: 这里是一座城堡的遗址。

example: The children are watching TV in the sitting room.
example_zh: 孩子们在客厅里看电视。

zh: 形. 位于…的、坐落在…的、处于某种境地的
example: Their hut is situated in the valley.
example_zh: 他们的小屋位于山谷中。

example: We made the best of that bad situation.
example_zh: 我们在那个糟糕的情况下尽力而为了。

example: They are more or less the same size.
example_zh: 它们的大小差不多。

example: I would often go skating on the lake.
example_zh: 我以前经常去湖上滑冰。

example: I told Tom that I'd buy him another skateboard.
example_zh: 我告诉汤姆我会给他再买一个滑板。

example: I would like to go skateboarding on the weekend.
example_zh: 我想周末去滑滑板。

example: I go ice skating every chance I get.
example_zh: 我一有机会就去滑冰。

example: You will soon be able to ski well.
example_zh: 你很快就能滑好雪了。

zh: 名. 滑雪运动、滑雪术
example: Which do you like better, skating or skiing?
example_zh: 滑冰和滑雪，你更喜欢哪个？

example: The girl has to match me in skill.
example_zh: 那个女孩在技能上必须比得上我。

example: Take the skin off before you eat the apple.
example_zh: 吃苹果前先把皮去掉。

example: It was yesterday that Mary bought this skirt.
example_zh: 玛丽是昨天买这条裙子的。

example: Seen against the sky, the mountain looked really beautiful.
example_zh: 在天空的衬托下，这座山看起来真美。

zh: 动. 睡、睡觉、睡眠、静止
example: I think I'm gonna go to sleep.
example_zh: 我想我要去睡觉了。

example: As I was sleepy, I went to bed.
example_zh: 因为我困了，所以去睡觉了。

example: I'm sure he has something up his sleeve.
example_zh: 我肯定他藏着什么花招。

example: He's wearing a sleeveless shirt and a trucker hat.
example_zh: 他穿着一件无袖衬衫，戴着一顶卡车司机帽。

zh: 名. 薄的切片、一部分、菜刀
example: He cut off a slice of meat.
example_zh: 他切下一片肉。

example: Would you please slide the van door open?
example_zh: 请你把面包车的车门滑开好吗？

example: But his name is slightly familiar to me.
example_zh: 但他的名字对我来说有点熟悉。

zh: 形. 瘦的、苗条的、微小的
example: She grew up to be a slim girl.
example_zh: 她长成了一个苗条的女孩。

zh: 动. 使滑动、滑过、摆脱、滑动
example: I've just let slip that he is sick.
example_zh: 我刚刚不小心说漏嘴，说他生病了。

zh: 形. 慢的、缓慢的、迟缓的
example: My health makes me a very slow worker.
example_zh: 我的健康状况让我做事很慢。

example: Drive more slowly, or you'll get a ticket.
example_zh: 开慢点，否则你会被开罚单。

zh: 形. 小的、少的、小型的
example: Our income is small, but we get by.
example_zh: 我们收入很少，但还能过得去。

example: You look smart in that new jacket.
example_zh: 你穿那件新夹克看起来很精神。

example: I'm still not used to my new smartphone!
example_zh: 我还不习惯我的新智能手机！

zh: 名. 味道、气味、嗅觉；动. 闻、探出、察觉、嗅
example: The smell of roses hung in the air.
example_zh: 空气中弥漫着玫瑰的香味。

zh: 名. 微笑、喜色、笑容；动. 微笑着表示、微笑、觉得好笑
example: Not knowing what to say, she just smiled.
example_zh: 不知道该说什么，她只是笑了笑。

zh: 动. 以烟熏、抽烟而导致…、吸烟、冒烟
example: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
example_zh: 你应该努力戒烟。

example: It is necessary for you to stop smoking.
example_zh: 你有必要戒烟。

zh: 形. 平滑的、平稳的、流畅的
example: It's nice to drive on a smooth road.
example_zh: 在平坦的路上开车很舒服。

example: I just had a snack at the bar.
example_zh: 我刚在酒吧吃了点小吃。

example: She drew back when she saw a snake.
example_zh: 她看到蛇时往后退了。

zh: 名. 雪、积雪、下雪；动. 使雪白、用雪覆盖、使像雪般落下、下雪
example: We had a lot of snow last year.
example_zh: 去年我们这里下了很多雪。

example: I think snowboarding is more fun than skiing.
example_zh: 我觉得单板滑雪比滑雪更有趣。

zh: 名. 单板滑雪、滑板滑雪、滑雪板
example: Felix wanted to have a weekend of snowboarding.
example_zh: 费利克斯想过一个单板滑雪的周末。

example: The train was delayed because of heavy snowfall.
example_zh: 火车因为大雪晚点了。

zh: 连. 所以、因此；副. 如此、如是、如…那样
example: So, I think it’s right.
example_zh: 所以，我认为这是对的。

example: Wash your hands with a bar of soap.
example_zh: 用一块肥皂洗手。

example: He was really good on that soap opera.
example_zh: 他在那部肥皂剧里演得真好。

example: Some boys play tennis and others play soccer.
example_zh: 一些男孩打网球，另一些踢足球。

zh: 形. 好交际的、社交的、过社会生活的
example: I attended the party just to be sociable.
example_zh: 我参加那个聚会只是为了社交。

zh: 形. 社会的、群居的、社交的
example: We discussed gun control in social studies class.
example_zh: 我们在社会课上讨论了枪支管制。

example: He spends too much time on social media.
example_zh: 他在社交媒体上花太多时间。

zh: 名. 社会、社交界、交往
example: Such men count for much in the society.
example_zh: 这样的人在社会上很重要。

example: I have socks, but I have no shoes.
example_zh: 我有袜子，但没有鞋。

example: That sofa is less expensive than this table.
example_zh: 那张沙发比这张桌子便宜。

zh: 形. 软的、温和的、柔和的
example: I like to sleep on a soft bed.
example_zh: 我喜欢睡在柔软的床上。

example: She showed him how to use the new software.
example_zh: 她教他怎么用这个新软件。

example: My grandfather was a soldier during the war.
example_zh: 我爷爷在战争期间是一名士兵。

example: If there's no solution, then there's no problem.
example_zh: 如果没有解决办法，那就没有问题。

zh: 动. 解决、付给、溶解、求解
example: I will show you how to solve it.
example_zh: 我会给你演示怎么解决它。

zh: 代. 一些、一部分、若干
example: There may be some truth in your story.
example_zh: 你的故事里可能有些真实的成分。

example: There's somebody here who did it, isn't there?
example_zh: 这里有人做了这件事，不是吗？

example: We'll get along without that much money somehow.
example_zh: 没有那么多钱，我们也总能想办法过下去。

example: I heard someone calling me from a distance.
example_zh: 我听到有人在远处叫我。

example: He felt that something was about to happen.
example_zh: 他感觉有什么事要发生。

example: Sometimes he can be a strange guy.
example_zh: 有时候他会是个怪人。

example: I want to go somewhere on a trip.
example_zh: 我想去某个地方旅行。

example: Mr. Young wishes his son would study harder.
example_zh: 杨先生希望他儿子学习更努力。

example: What kind of songs are popular these days?
example_zh: 现在流行什么样的歌曲？

example: You will soon be convinced I am right.
example_zh: 你很快就会相信我是对的。

zh: 形. 悲伤的、痛的、引起痛苦的
example: She was sore at me for being late.
example_zh: 她因为我迟到而生我的气。

zh: 形. 难过的、悲哀的、遗憾的
example: I’m sorry I’m late.
example_zh: 对不起，我迟到了。

example: I don't care for that sort of thing.
example_zh: 我不喜欢那种东西。

zh: 形. 平常的、还过得去的、马马虎虎的
example: The film was only so-so.
example_zh: 那部电影只是一般般。

example: He put all his heart and soul into it.
example_zh: 他把全部心血都投入其中。

zh: 动. 使发声、宣告、听诊、发出声音
example: Strange as it may sound, this is true.
example_zh: 听起来可能奇怪，但这是真的。

example: The film’s soundtrack has music by.
example_zh: 这部电影的配乐有……创作的音乐。

example: Boil the soup down until it becomes thick.
example_zh: 把汤煮浓，直到变稠。

zh: 形. 酸的、酸臭的、发酵的
example: If you add lemon, it will become sour.
example_zh: 如果你加柠檬，它会变酸。

zh: 名. 南方、南；形. 南的、向南的；副. 在南方
example: The island is to the south of Japan.
example_zh: 这个岛在日本南边。

zh: 形. 东南的、向东南的、来自东南的；名. 东南、东南地区
example: This story takes place in southeast Algeria.
example_zh: 这个故事发生在阿尔及利亚东南部。

zh: 形. 向南方的、来自南方的
example: The Southern Cross can't be seen from Japan.
example_zh: 从日本看不到南十字星。

zh: 形. 西南的、来自西南方的；名. 西南、西南方、西南地区
example: I go to the southwest of the village.
example_zh: 我去村庄的西南部。

example: Is there a souvenir shop in the hotel?
example_zh: 酒店里有纪念品商店吗？

example: Seen from space, the earth is very beautiful.
example_zh: 从太空看，地球非常美丽。

example: The spaceship was never to return to Earth.
example_zh: 那艘宇宙飞船再也不会返回地球了。

zh: 形. 多余的、备用的、空闲的
example: I read a lot in my spare time.
example_zh: 我在空闲时间读很多书。

zh: 形. 闪闪发光的、闪烁的、闪烁着才华的
example: I prefer drinking sparkling water to still water.
example_zh: 比起无气泡水，我更喜欢喝气泡水。

example: To my surprise, she spoke English very well.
example_zh: 让我惊讶的是，她英语说得非常好。

zh: 名. 说话人、讲演者、发言人
example: What a good speaker of English you are!
example_zh: 你英语说得真好！

zh: 形. 特别的、专门的、特殊的
example: Special care should be taken on this point.
example_zh: 这一点需要特别注意。

example: Thanks for coming specially to see me off.
example_zh: 谢谢你特地来为我送行。

example: Environmental changes gave rise to new species.
example_zh: 环境变化导致了新物种的产生。

zh: 形. 公开展示的、惊人的、壮观的
example: The view from the mountain top was spectacular.
example_zh: 山顶的景色非常壮观。

example: The students met here to hear the speech.
example_zh: 学生们在这里集合听演讲。

example: This is the car with the most speed.
example_zh: 这是速度最快的汽车。

zh: 动. 拼写、拼成、琢磨、轮换
example: Please tell me how to spell your name.
example_zh: 请告诉我你的名字怎么拼写。

example: You have made only a few spelling mistakes.
example_zh: 你只犯了几个拼写错误。

zh: 动. 花费、浪费、度过、用尽
example: A student spends a lot of time studying.
example_zh: 一个学生花很多时间学习。

example: Sami was looking to spice up his life.
example_zh: 萨米想让自己的生活更有趣。

zh: 形. 香的、多香料的、辛辣的
example: A dish can be spicy without being hot.
example_zh: 一道菜可以有香料味，但不一定辣。

zh: 动. 使溢出、使散落、洒、溢出
example: She spilled her drink all over my dress.
example_zh: 她把饮料洒得我裙子上到处都是。

zh: 名. 菠菜、货币、胡说八道
example: I hated spinach when I was a kid.
example_zh: 我小时候讨厌菠菜。

zh: 名. 恶意、怨恨、使人烦恼的事物
example: We played golf in spite of the rain.
example_zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是打了高尔夫球。

zh: 动. <非正>瓜分、劈成、（使）分成若干小部分
example: She’s just split up with her boyfriend.
example_zh: 她刚和男朋友分手。

zh: 动. 损坏、破坏、溺爱、腐坏
example: As long as it doesn't spoil the weekend!
example_zh: 只要这不会毁掉周末就行！

zh: 名. 匙、调羹、匙形工具
example: The baby cannot use a spoon yet.
example_zh: 宝宝还不会用勺子。

example: Oh, you must be good at sports.
example_zh: 哦，你一定很擅长运动。

zh: 名. 体育运动中心、运动场
example: I play badminton at the sports centre.
example_zh: 我在体育中心打羽毛球。

example: The dog is called Spot by the family.
example_zh: 这家人把这只狗叫作斯波特。

example: The man was arrested as a spy.
example_zh: 那名男子作为间谍被捕。

zh: 名. 正方形、街区、广场；形. 正方形的、正直的、公正的
example: The shape of a box is usually square.
example_zh: 盒子的形状通常是方形的。

zh: 名. 挤压、压碎的东西、南瓜属植物
example: I'd like to play a game of squash.
example_zh: 我想打一局壁球。

zh: 名. 露天大型运动场
example: There were lots of people in the stadium.
example_zh: 体育场里有很多人。

zh: 名. 全体人员、工作班子、棍棒
example: I get along well with all the staff.
example_zh: 我和所有员工都相处得很好。

example: I may put this story on the stage.
example_zh: 我可能会把这个故事搬上舞台。

example: Watch your step when going down the stairs.
example_zh: 下楼梯时小心脚下。

zh: 名. 厩、停车处、牧师职位
example: Can you stall Tom till I get there?
example_zh: 你能拖住汤姆直到我到那儿吗？

example: Put a stamp on the envelope.
example_zh: 在信封上贴一张邮票。

zh: 动. 忍受、使站立、抵挡、站
example: She was standing at the bus stop.
example_zh: 她站在公交车站。

zh: 名. 星、恒星、星形物；动. 以星状物装饰、用星号标、使成为明星、变成明星
example: I wondered why people were staring at me.
example_zh: 我想知道为什么人们盯着我看。

zh: 动. 使惊起、开动、发动、开始
example: They will have arrived there before you start.
example_zh: 到你开始的时候，他们就已经到那里了。

example: The train was about to leave the station.
example_zh: 火车就要离站了。

example: This statue is as large as life.
example_zh: 这座雕像和真人一样大。

zh: 动. 制止、延缓、坚持、停留
example: I can’t stay long.
example_zh: 我不能待很久。

example: She stayed behind after the lesson to.
example_zh: 下课后她留了下来。

example: He ate up the steak and ordered another.
example_zh: 他吃完了牛排，又点了一份。

zh: 动. 剽窃、偷偷地做、偷窃
example: I would rather die than steal from others.
example_zh: 我宁愿死也不偷别人的东西。

zh: 形. 险峻的、陡峭的、急剧升降的
example: From this point the climb suddenly became steep.
example_zh: 从这里开始，攀登突然变陡了。

example: Watch your step when going down the stairs.
example_zh: 下楼梯时小心脚下。

zh: 动. 向前走、站出来、迈步
example: Please step forward when your name is called.
example_zh: 叫到你的名字时，请向前一步。

example: Be careful not to step in the water.
example_zh: 小心不要踩进水里。

zh: 名. 棍、棒、刺；动. 插进、刺入、钉住、粘住
example: You should stick those pictures in your album.
example_zh: 你应该把那些照片贴进你的相册里。

zh: 形. 粘的、有粘性的、顽固的
example: She helped me in a very sticky situation.
example_zh: 她在一个非常棘手的处境中帮助了我。

example: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
example_zh: 你还太年轻，不能考驾照。

zh: 动. 移动、摇动、激起、走动
example: Stir, and you are a dead man.
example_zh: 动一下，你就死定了。

example: Something seems to be wrong with my stomach.
example_zh: 我的胃好像有点不舒服。

example: I have a stomach ache because I ate too much.
example_zh: 我胃疼，因为我吃得太多了。

example: Don't beat your head against a stone wall.
example_zh: 不要白费力气。

zh: 名. 停止、车站、逗留；动. 塞住、堵塞、阻止、停止
example: There is a bus stop near our school.
example_zh: 我们学校附近有一个公交车站。

example: There used to be a store right here.
example_zh: 这里以前有一家商店。

zh: 名. 暴风雨、骚动、风波
example: We fought for our lives in the storm.
example_zh: 我们在暴风雨中拼命求生。

example: Strange as it is, the story is true.
example_zh: 虽然很奇怪，但这个故事是真的。

zh: 形. 直的、笔直的、正直的；副. 直接地、立即、不断地
example: Go straight ahead until you reach the church.
example_zh: 一直往前走，直到你到教堂。

zh: 形. 奇怪的、陌生的、生疏的
example: That’s a strange story!
example_zh: 那是个奇怪的故事！

example: How did a total stranger know his name?
example_zh: 一个完全陌生的人怎么知道他的名字？

example: The children told me they loved strawberry ice cream.
example_zh: 孩子们告诉我他们很喜欢草莓冰淇淋。

example: We climbed along the stream in the mountains.
example_zh: 我们沿着山里的溪流攀爬。

example: By chance, I met her in the street.
example_zh: 我偶然在街上遇到了她。

example: He didn’t want the stress of a new job.
example_zh: 他不想要新工作的压力。

zh: 形. 感到有压力的、紧张的
example: The teacher stressed the importance of daily practice.
example_zh: 老师强调了每天练习的重要性。

example: Half of the Japanese people lead stressful lives.
example_zh: 一半的日本人过着压力很大的生活。

zh: 形. 严厉的、绝对的、详尽的
example: Our English teacher is both strict and kind.
example_zh: 我们的英语老师既严格又和蔼。

zh: 名. 罢工、打击、殴打；动. 打、撞击、冲击、打击
example: The workers went on strike for better pay.
example_zh: 工人们为了更高的工资举行了罢工。

example: His striped suit and checked tie didn't match.
example_zh: 他的条纹西装和格子领带不搭配。

zh: 形. 强壮的、坚固的、坚强的
example: The strong should take care of the weak.
example_zh: 强者应该照顾弱者。

zh: 名. 学生、研究者、学者
example: The professor requires excellent work of his students.
example_zh: 教授要求学生们交出优秀的作业。

zh: 名. 工作室、画室、演播室
example: The singer was standing by in the studio.
example_zh: 歌手在录音室里待命。

example: My brother studies as hard as I do.
example_zh: 我兄弟学习和我一样努力。

zh: 动. 学习、读书、研究、思索
example: He will be studying when you get up.
example_zh: 你起床的时候，他会在学习。

example: That’s where I keep all my stuff.
example_zh: 那是我放我所有东西的地方。

example: She was stupid to make such a mistake.
example_zh: 她犯这样的错误真傻。

zh: 名. 风格、时尚、文体、样式
example: I'd like the same style as this one.
example_zh: 我想要和这个一样的款式。

zh: 形. 现代风格的、流行的、潇洒的
example: That's a stylish hat you are wearing.
example_zh: 你戴的那顶帽子很时髦。

example: Give me any books you have on the subject.
example_zh: 把你有的关于这个主题的任何书都给我。

zh: 动. 减去、扣掉、减少、做减法
example: Subtract three from eight and you get five.
example_zh: 八减去三得五。

example: Is it dangerous to take a subway alone?
example_zh: 独自坐地铁危险吗？

zh: 动. 继承、接替、成功、继续
example: You are sure to succeed, whatever you do.
example_zh: 无论你做什么，你一定会成功。

example: I'm sure your efforts will result in success.
example_zh: 我确信你的努力会带来成功。

zh: 形. 成功的、一帆风顺的、顺利的
example: I hope your business trip to France was successful.
example_zh: 我希望你去法国的出差很成功。

example: You should read such books as you consider important.
example_zh: 你应该读那些你认为重要的书。

zh: 形. 突然的、意外的、快速的
example: I felt a sudden pain in my side.
example_zh: 我感到身体一侧突然一阵疼痛。

example: The old man stopped suddenly and looked back.
example_zh: 老人突然停下来，回头看了看。

zh: 动. 遭受、经历、忍受、受痛苦
example: We all suffer from it to some degree.
example_zh: 我们都在某种程度上受它困扰。

zh: 名. 糖、糖块、甜言蜜语
example: There is much sugar in this black box.
example_zh: 这个黑盒子里有很多糖。

example: I suggest having the meeting in the office.
example_zh: 我建议在办公室开会。

example: Your suggestion came up at the meeting.
example_zh: 你的建议在会上被提出来了。

example: This suit is too good for me.
example_zh: 这套西装对我来说太好了。

example: The job is not suitable for young girls.
example_zh: 这份工作不适合年轻女孩。

example: I had my suitcase carried to my room.
example_zh: 我让人把我的手提箱搬到了我的房间。

example: The plan requires a large sum of money.
example_zh: 这个计划需要一大笔钱。

example: The sky is clear and the sun is bright.
example_zh: 天空晴朗，阳光明亮。

example: Sunbathing isn't as popular as it used to be.
example_zh: 日光浴不如以前那么流行了。

zh: 名. 太阳镜、墨镜、太阳眼镜
example: Sunglasses protect our eyes from the sun.
example_zh: 太阳镜保护我们的眼睛不受阳光伤害。

zh: 形. 阳光充足的、乐观的、快乐的
example: It looks like it's going to be sunny.
example_zh: 看起来会是晴天。

example: She got up early to see the sunrise.
example_zh: 她早起去看日出。

example: We could see the sunset from the window.
example_zh: 我们从窗户可以看到日落。

example: This room gets a lot of sunshine.
example_zh: 这个房间阳光很充足。

example: The girl spends hours drawing superhero stories.
example_zh: 这个女孩花好几个小时画超级英雄故事。

example: The store lost its trade to the supermarket.
example_zh: 这家商店的生意被那家超市抢走了。

example: Mother had prepared supper when I got home.
example_zh: 我到家时，妈妈已经准备好晚饭了。

zh: 动. 补给、供给、提供、替代
example: Have a good supply of drinking water.
example_zh: 要储备充足的饮用水。

zh: 名. 支持、支撑、援助；动. 支援、支撑、帮助
example: She gave me a lot of support during my.
example_zh: 在我……期间，她给了我很多支持。

zh: 名. 支持者、后盾、迫随者
example: I'm not a big supporter of the radio.
example_zh: 我不是广播的忠实支持者。

zh: 动. 推想、假设、以为、料想
example: You are not supposed to smoke at school.
example_zh: 你不应该在学校抽烟。

zh: 形. 确信、必然的、必定的
example: I’m (not) sure.
example_zh: 我（不）确定。

example: I like surfing (on) the internet.
example_zh: 我喜欢上网。

zh: 名. 冲浪板、用冲浪板滑水
example: He couldn't wait to try out his new surfboard.
example_zh: 他迫不及待地想试用他的新冲浪板。

example: When was the last time you went surfing?
example_zh: 你上次去冲浪是什么时候？

example: I don't even know what Tom's surname is.
example_zh: 我甚至不知道汤姆姓什么。

example: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
example_zh: 整个社区的人都对这条消息感到惊讶。

example: No matter what happens, I won't be surprised.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都不会感到惊讶。

zh:
形. n. 惊讶、惊奇
v. 使…惊讶
example: The result was really surprising.
example_zh: 结果真的很令人惊讶。

example: The cottage is surrounded by.
example_zh: 这座小屋被……环绕着。

zh: 名. 毛衣、毛线衫、运动衫
example: What shall I put on over my sweater?
example_zh: 我该在毛衣外面穿什么？

zh: 名. 园领长袖运动衫
example: I think you've put your sweatshirt on inside out.
example_zh: 我想你把卫衣穿反了。

zh: 名. 甜蜜、糖果、情人；形. 甜的、芳香的、悦耳的
example: The sound of the violin is very sweet.
example_zh: 小提琴的声音很甜美。

zh: 动. 游过、使浮起、游泳、游；名. 游泳、漂浮、潮流
example: I swim in the college team.
example_zh: 我在大学队里游泳。

example: I thought I was a fairly good swimmer.
example_zh: 我原以为自己游泳游得相当好。

example: It was so hot that we went swimming.
example_zh: 天气太热了，所以我们去游泳了。

example: I'm wearing my swimming costume under my clothes.
example_zh: 我在衣服里面穿着泳衣。

example: The swimming pool opens at nine o'clock.
example_zh: 游泳池九点开门。

example: That swimsuit looks really good on you.
example_zh: 那件泳衣穿在你身上真好看。

zh: 名. 开关、电闸、转换；动. 转变、切换、摆动、转换
example: On no account must you touch that switch.
example_zh: 你无论如何都不能碰那个开关。

example: It is a system of direct exchange of goods.
example_zh: 这是一种直接交换货物的制度。

zh: 名. 桌子、餐桌、工作台
example: Could we have a table in the corner?
example_zh: 我们能要一张角落里的桌子吗？

example: She put a clean table-cloth on the table.
example_zh: 她在桌子上铺了一块干净的桌布。

zh: 名. 平板、门牌、笔记簿
example: You can take notes using your tablet.
example_zh: 你可以用平板电脑做笔记。

example: We play table tennis after school.
example_zh: 我们放学后打乒乓球。

zh: 动. 拿、取、抓、吃掉对方棋子
example: I’ll take it to your room.
example_zh: 我会把它拿到你的房间去。

zh: 名. 外卖食品的餐馆、外卖食品的商店
example: There's a nice takeaway on the corner over there.
example_zh: 那边拐角处有一家不错的外卖店。

example: He took away what little money I had.
example_zh: 他拿走了我仅有的一点钱。

example: Could you take care of my cat this weekend?
example_zh: 这个周末你能帮我照顾我的猫吗？

example: She took off her shoes.
example_zh: 她脱下了鞋子。

example: I want to take part in the school competition.
example_zh: 我想参加学校的比赛。

example: The meeting took place at six.
example_zh: 会议在六点举行。

zh: 动. 拿起、开始从事、继续
example: He decided to take up a new hobby.
example_zh: 他决定开始一项新爱好。

zh: 名. 天才、才能、有才干的人
example: Talent for music runs in their blood.
example_zh: 音乐天赋在他们的血脉中流传。

zh: 形. 天资高的、有才能的
example: She is what we call a talented woman.
example_zh: 她就是我们所说的才女。

zh: 名. 谈话、交谈、会谈；动. 讲、说、讨论、讲话
example: Let's have a serious talk about your future.
example_zh: 我们认真谈谈你的未来吧。

example: The guests were not typical talk show guests.
example_zh: 这些客人不是典型的脱口秀嘉宾。

zh: 形. 高的、长的、夸大的
example: One is tall and the other is short.
example_zh: 一个高，另一个矮。

example: Most Japanese drink water from the tap.
example_zh: 大多数日本人喝自来水。

zh: 名. 味道、品味、味觉；动. 尝、察觉…的味道、体会、品尝
example: She has good taste in clothes.
example_zh: 她在穿衣方面很有品味。

example: I know that her bread will be tasty.
example_zh: 我知道她的面包会很好吃。

example: The work is a heavy tax on my health.
example_zh: 这项工作对我的健康是沉重的负担。

example: There is a taxi stand near the station.
example_zh: 车站附近有一个出租车停靠站。

example: Let's have a tea break somewhere around there.
example_zh: 我们在那附近喝杯茶休息一下吧。

zh: 动. 教、讲授、教导、教书
example: With teaching and studying, my time is taken up.
example_zh: 教学和学习占用了我的时间。

example: You should talk to the teacher yourself.
example_zh: 你应该自己去和老师谈谈。

example: All our teachers were young and loved teaching.
example_zh: 我们所有的老师都很年轻，并且热爱教学。

example: Our team has the game on ice.
example_zh: 我们队稳赢这场比赛。

zh: 名. 泪滴、眼泪、撕；动. 撕裂、戳破、拉掉、流泪
example: The good news brought tears to her eyes.
example_zh: 这个好消息让她热泪盈眶。

example: It is the correct approach to modern ski technique.
example_zh: 这是现代滑雪技巧的正确方法。

zh: 名. 技术、工业技术、术语
example: Modern technology gives us many new things.
example_zh: 现代科技给我们带来许多新东西。

zh: 名. 十三岁到十九岁的少年
example: The teenager insisted she was innocent of cheating.
example_zh: 那个青少年坚称自己没作弊。

zh: 名. 电话、电话机；动. 打电话
example: In case of fire, telephone the fire station.
example_zh: 万一发生火灾，请打电话给消防站。

example: We watch television after dinner.
example_zh: 我们晚饭后看电视。

zh: 动. 告诉、说、吩咐、讲述
example: This is the town I told you about.
example_zh: 这就是我跟你说过的那个小镇。

example: The temperature was below zero.
example_zh: 温度在零度以下。

example: You must be the temporary we asked for.
example_zh: 你一定是我们要找的临时工。

example: I haven't touched a tennis racket in years.
example_zh: 我好几年没碰过网球拍了。

example: He was lying there very still and tense.
example_zh: 他躺在那里，一动不动，十分紧张。

example: You are used to sleeping in a tent.
example_zh: 你习惯在帐篷里睡觉。

zh: 名. 术语、专有名词、期限
example: I was busy studying for the term exam.
example_zh: 我忙着复习期末考试。

zh: 形. 可怕的、令人恐惧的、极坏的
example: Never have I heard so terrible a story.
example_zh: 我从没听过这么可怕的故事。

zh: 副. 可怕地、甚为、非常
example: At that time, the train was terribly crowded.
example_zh: 那时火车非常拥挤。

zh: 形. 非常好的、极端的、可怕的
example: I think what Tom is doing is terrific.
example_zh: 我认为汤姆做的事很棒。

zh: 形. 受惊吓的、感到恐惧的
example: Love is terrified of everything that is not itself.
example_zh: 爱害怕一切不是它自身的东西。

example: Ten to one you can pass the test.
example_zh: 十有八九你能通过考试。

example: There's not so much text in this book.
example_zh: 这本书里的文字没有那么多。

example: The original was written as a school textbook.
example_zh: 原版是作为学校教科书写的。

example: She sent me a text message this morning.
example_zh: 她今天早上给我发了一条短信。

zh: 介. 比；连. 比、除…外
example: The situation is worse than we believed.
example_zh: 情况比我们以为的更糟。

example: I don't know how to express my thanks.
example_zh: 我不知道该如何表达我的感谢。

example: Thanks. Could I return it to you instead?
example_zh: 谢谢。我可以改为把它还给你吗？

example: Thank you for your help.
example_zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

zh: 连. 以致、因为；代. 那
example: I think I have a theory about that.
example_zh: 我想我对那件事有一个理论。

example: Let's consider the worst that could happen.
example_zh: 让我们考虑一下可能发生的最坏情况。

example: This shop is just in front of the theatre.
example_zh: 这家商店就在剧院前面。

example: Most people write about their daily life.
example_zh: 大多数人写他们的日常生活。

example: This is not our car, it is theirs.
example_zh: 这不是我们的车，是他们的。

example: Before buying shoes, you should try them on.
example_zh: 买鞋之前，你应该试穿一下。

zh: 代. 他们自己、她们自己、它们自己
example: These days many old people live by themselves.
example_zh: 如今许多老人独自生活。

example: I wish you had told me the truth then.
example_zh: 我真希望你当时告诉了我真相。

example: There are too many things to do!
example_zh: 要做的事情太多了！

example: I don't think, therefore I am not.
example_zh: 我不思考，所以我不存在。

example: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.
example_zh: 这双鞋太紧了，穿着脚疼。

example: Don't ask what they think. Ask what they do.
example_zh: 不要问他们怎么想。要问他们怎么做。

zh: 形. 厚的、粗壮的、浓的
example: The ice is thick enough to walk on.
example_zh: 冰够厚，可以在上面走。

example: The policeman took the thief by the arm.
example_zh: 警察抓住了小偷的胳膊。

example: In such thin clothes, are you warm enough?
example_zh: 穿这么薄的衣服，你够暖和吗？

example: You never have time for important things!
example_zh: 你从来都没有时间做重要的事情！

zh: 动. 想、考虑、想起、思考
example: Sorry, I don't think I'm gonna be able to.
example_zh: 抱歉，我觉得我做不到。

zh: 形. 口渴的、渴望的、干燥的
example: I'm thirsty. Please give me a cold drink.
example_zh: 我渴了。请给我一杯冷饮。

example: This is what I would have said.
example_zh: 这是我本来要说的话。

example: Those who were present were disappointed at the report.
example_zh: 在场的人对这份报告感到失望。

zh: 连. 虽然、纵然；副. 然而、可是
example: Though she is rich, she is not happy.
example_zh: 虽然她很有钱，但她不快乐。

example: I have some thoughts about your plan.
example_zh: 我对你的计划有一些想法。

zh: 名. 使人激动的东西、使人毛骨悚然的东西、使人毛骨悚然的小说
example: I would rather watch an exciting thriller.
example_zh: 我宁愿看一部刺激的惊悚片。

example: I have a sore throat from a cold.
example_zh: 我因为感冒喉咙痛。

example: You must go through with your plan.
example_zh: 你必须把计划进行到底。

example: Take care not to throw away this chance.
example_zh: 注意别浪费这次机会。

example: He threw away the old TV.
example_zh: 他把旧电视扔掉了。

example: The glove has a hole in the thumb.
example_zh: 这只手套的拇指上有个洞。

example: We had a lot of thunder that summer.
example_zh: 那年夏天有很多雷声。

example: The match was stopped due to a thunderstorm.
example_zh: 比赛因为雷雨而停止了。

zh: 名. 滴答声、一瞬间、壁虱；动. 滴答地记录、标记号于、滴答响、活动
example: I just can't work out what makes Tom tick.
example_zh: 我就是弄不明白汤姆为什么会这样。

example: Do you have a return ticket to Japan?
example_zh: 你有去日本的往返票吗？

zh: 形. 整齐的、有条理的；动. 弄整齐、收拾、整理
example: I cannot tidy my room. I don't have time.
example_zh: 我没法收拾我的房间。我没有时间。

example: Please tidy up your room before lunch.
example_zh: 请在午饭前收拾好你的房间。

example: Hold still a moment while I fix your tie.
example_zh: 我给你整理领带的时候，请保持不动一会儿。

zh: 名. 老虎、虎、凶暴的人
example: Which is stronger, a tiger or a lion?
example_zh: 老虎和狮子，哪个更强壮？

zh: 形. 紧的、密封的、吝啬的
example: Hold on tight, otherwise you will fall off.
example_zh: 抓紧，否则你会掉下去。

example: In winter, I put on thick tights.
example_zh: 冬天，我穿厚厚的紧身裤。

example: I waited for her till it got dark.
example_zh: 我等她一直等到天黑。

example: What have you been doing all this time!
example_zh: 你这段时间都在做什么！

example: That timetable is not in use any more.
example_zh: 那个时刻表不再用了。

example: He was playing football with an old tin.
example_zh: 他在用一个旧罐头盒踢足球。

example: We have just a tiny bit of garden.
example_zh: 我们只有一小块花园。

example: It's on the tip of my tongue.
example_zh: 它就在我嘴边。

example: Here is a useful tip for learning new words.
example_zh: 这是一个学习新单词的有用小窍门。

zh: 形. 疲累的、疲乏的、厌倦的
example: When I got home, I was very tired.
example_zh: 我到家时，非常累。

zh: 形. 引起疲劳的、累人的
example: It's going to be tiring to do that.
example_zh: 做那件事会很累。

zh: 名. 薄的织物、薄纱、棉纸
example: Sami found tissue paper all over the place.
example_zh: 萨米发现到处都是纸巾。

example: I couldn't remember the title of that song.
example_zh: 我记不起那首歌的歌名。

example: Humans were never meant to live forever.
example_zh: 人类从来就不是要永远活着的。

zh: 名. 吐司、烤面包、干杯
example: I always have coffee and toast for breakfast.
example_zh: 我早饭总是吃吐司喝咖啡。

zh: 名. 今天、当今、现在；副. 今天、当今
example: I won't ask you anything else today.
example_zh: 我今天不会再问你别的了。

example: I have a pain in my little toe.
example_zh: 我的小脚趾疼。

example: We got together for short meeting after dinner.
example_zh: 晚饭后我们聚在一起开了个短会。

example: It's my habit to read on the toilet.
example_zh: 我习惯在马桶上看书。

example: Is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable?
example_zh: 西红柿是水果还是蔬菜？

zh: 名. 明天、未来；副. 明天、未来地
example: According to the radio, it will snow tomorrow.
example_zh: 据广播说，明天会下雪。

zh: 名. 舌、语言能力、讲话方式
example: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
example_zh: 你得学会管住自己的嘴。

zh: 名. 今晚、今夜；副. 今晚、今夜
example: This train gets to Chicago at 9 o'clock tonight.
example_zh: 这趟火车今晚9点到达芝加哥。

example: Whenever I find something I like, it's too expensive.
example_zh: 每当我找到自己喜欢的东西，它都太贵了。

zh: 名. 牙齿、齿状物、爱好
example: The dentist checked every tooth.
example_zh: 牙医检查了每一颗牙。

example: I've got a toothache. The pain is killing me.
example_zh: 我牙疼。疼死我了。

example: This toothbrush is not used by my mother.
example_zh: 这把牙刷不是我妈妈用的。

example: You can't put toothpaste back in the tube.
example_zh: 你不能把牙膏放回牙膏管里。

example: Don't put anything on top of the box.
example_zh: 别在箱子上面放任何东西。

example: Politics was the main topic of their conversation.
example_zh: 政治是他们谈话的主要话题。

example: The torch does not light its own stand.
example_zh: 火炬不会照亮自己的底座。

zh: 形. 全体的、总的、全然的；名. 总数、全体、合计
example: How much money did you spend in total?
example_zh: 你总共花了多少钱？

example: Their ideas seem totally alien to us.
example_zh: 他们的想法对我们来说似乎完全陌生。

zh: 动. 接触、触摸、触及、接近
example: A bear will not touch a dead body.
example_zh: 熊不会碰尸体。

zh: 名. 旅游、观光旅行、任期
example: The band are on tour this month.
example_zh: 这个月乐队在巡回演出。

example: The tour guide showed us the old city.
example_zh: 导游带我们看了老城。

example: Tourism is important to the economy of my country.
example_zh: 旅游业对我国的经济很重要。

example: Tourists take over this island in the summer.
example_zh: 夏天游客会占据这个岛。

example: Ask at the tourist information centre for a map.
example_zh: 去旅游信息中心要一张地图。

zh: 名. 比赛、竞赛、锦标赛
example: Who do you think will win the tournament?
example_zh: 你觉得谁会赢得这次比赛？

example: She walked towards the door.
example_zh: 她朝门口走去。

example: Don't put the wet towel in the bag.
example_zh: 别把湿毛巾放进包里。

example: The clock in the church tower struck nine.
example_zh: 教堂塔楼上的钟敲响了九点。

example: You will soon come to like this town.
example_zh: 你很快就会喜欢上这个小镇。

zh: 名. 玩具、小玩艺儿、小型的东西
example: He will soon be past playing with toys.
example_zh: 他很快就不再玩玩具了。

example: I think you're on the right track.
example_zh: 我觉得你的方向是对的。

example: You look absolutely hot in this tracksuit.
example_zh: 你穿这套运动服看起来非常性感。

example: The store lost its trade to the supermarket.
example_zh: 这家商店的生意被那家超市抢走了。

example: It was a very traditional ceremony.
example_zh: 那是一个非常传统的仪式。

example: To make matter worse, the traffic was bad.
example_zh: 更糟的是，交通很糟糕。

example: We met a traffic jam on the way.
example_zh: 我们在路上遇到了交通堵塞。

example: Turn left at the traffic light.
example_zh: 在红绿灯处向左转。

example: Hurry up, and you can catch the train.
example_zh: 快点，你就能赶上火车。

example: I've often thought that about my personal trainer.
example_zh: 我经常对我的私人教练这样想。

example: The team has training every Tuesday afternoon.
example_zh: 这个队每周二下午训练。

zh: 名. 电车轨道、煤车、纬纱
example: You can take a bus or a tram.
example_zh: 你可以坐公交车或有轨电车。

zh: 动. 使转移、调转、调任、转移
example: I'll transfer you to the right person.
example_zh: 我会把你转接给合适的人。

zh: 动. 翻译、解释、转化、被译
example: Don't translate English into Japanese word for word.
example_zh: 不要逐字把英语翻译成日语。

example: The translation is quite true to the original.
example_zh: 这个翻译相当忠实于原文。

zh: 名. 运输、运输工具、激动
example: What form of transport will we take?
example_zh: 我们要坐哪种交通工具？

example: Sami put the towel in the trash can.
example_zh: 萨米把毛巾放进了垃圾桶。

zh: 动. 旅行、通过、使移动、行进
example: Traveling abroad is one of my favorite things.
example_zh: 出国旅行是我最喜欢的事情之一。

example: The travel agent will advise you where to stay.
example_zh: 旅行社代理人会建议你住在哪里。

example: With great effort he climbed up the tree.
example_zh: 他费了很大力气爬上了树。

example: There's a trend these days towards small families.
example_zh: 如今有一种向小家庭发展的趋势。

example: It's just a trick of the wind.
example_zh: 这只是风的把戏。

example: You must be tired after such a long trip.
example_zh: 经过这么长的旅程，你一定累了。

example: You need not take the trouble to go there.
example_zh: 你不用费事去那里。
